 348 // $start_times is an array of start_times that have been created/modified/deleted.
 349 // If not specified the function works them out for itself from the repeat data
 350 function create_body(array $data, ?array $mail_previous, bool $compare, bool $series, string $action, array $start_times, bool $as_html=false, ?string $note=null) : string
 351 {
 352   global $mrbs_company;
 353   global $enable_periods, $approval_enabled, $confirmation_enabled;
 354   global $mail_settings, $standard_fields;
 355   global $select_options, $booking_types;
 356 
 357   // If we haven't got a previous entry just give it one.   It won't get used,
 358   // but will prevent a series if undefined index notices.
 359   if (empty($mail_previous))
 360   {
 361     $mail_previous = $data;
 362   }
 363 
 364   // set up the body
 365   $body = "";
 366 
 367   if ($as_html)
 368   {
 369     $body .= DOCTYPE . MAIL_EOL;
 370     $body .= '<html lang="' . convert_to_BCP47(get_mail_lang()) . '">' . MAIL_EOL;
 371     $body .= '<head>' . MAIL_EOL;
 372     $body .= '<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=' . get_mail_charset() . '">' . MAIL_EOL;
 373     $body .= '<title>' . escape_html($mrbs_company) . '</title>' . MAIL_EOL;
 374     $body .= '<style type="text/css">' . MAIL_EOL;
 375     $css_file = 'css/mrbs-mail.css.php';
 376     if (is_file($css_file) && is_readable($css_file))
 377     {
 378       ob_start();
 379       include $css_file;
 380       $css = ob_get_clean();
 381       //  Remove any whitespace from the beginning
 382       $css = preg_replace('/^\s+/', '', $css);
 383       // Remove comments
 384       $css = preg_replace('!/\*.*?\*/!s', '', $css);
 385       // Remove blank lines and also replace all new line sequences with the preferred
 386       // EOL sequence - hence the '+'.  Note that the CSS file will probably have Unix LF
 387       // endings, so these will need to be converted.
 388       $css = preg_replace("/(?:\R\h*)+/", MAIL_EOL, $css);
 389       $body .= $css;
 390     }
 391     $body .= '</style>' . MAIL_EOL;
 392     $body .= '</head>' . MAIL_EOL;
 393     $body .= '<body id="mrbs">' . MAIL_EOL;
 394     $body .= '<div id="header">' . escape_html($mrbs_company . ' - ' . get_mail_vocab('mrbs')) . '</div>' . MAIL_EOL;
 395     $body .= '<div id="contents">' . MAIL_EOL;
 396   }
 397 
 398   $body .= ($as_html) ? "<p>" : "";
 399 
 400   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 401   if (isset($mrbs_user))
 402   {
 403     $user_escaped = ($as_html) ? escape_html($mrbs_user->display_name) : $mrbs_user->display_name;
 404   }
 405   else
 406   {
 407     $user_escaped = '';
 408   }
 409 
 410   switch ($action)
 411   {
 412     case "approve":
 413       $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_approved", $user_escaped);
 414       break;
 415     case "more_info":
 416       $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_more_info", $user_escaped);
 417       $body .= ($as_html) ? '</p><p>' : MAIL_EOL . MAIL_EOL;
 418       $body .= get_mail_vocab("info_requested") . ": ";
 419       $body .= $note ?? '';
 420       break;
 421     case "remind":
 422       $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_reminder");
 423       break;
 424     case "reject":
 425       $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_rej_entry", $user_escaped);
 426       $body .= ($as_html) ? '</p><p>' : MAIL_EOL . MAIL_EOL;
 427       $body .= get_mail_vocab("reason") . ': ';
 428       $body .= $note ?? '';
 429       break;
 430     case "delete":
 431       $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_del_entry", $user_escaped);
 432       break;
 433     default:
 434       if ($compare)
 435       {
 436         $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_changed_entry", $user_escaped);
 437       }
 438       else
 439       {
 440         $body .= get_mail_vocab("mail_body_new_entry", $user_escaped);
 441       }
 442       break;
 443   }
 444 
 445   // Create a link to the entry, unless we're deleting it of course,
 446   // because then there won't be one.
 447   if (($action != "delete") && ($action != "reject"))
 448   {
 449     $body .= ($as_html) ? '</p><p>' : MAIL_EOL . MAIL_EOL;
 450     $body .= ($as_html) ? '<a target="_blank" href="' : '';
 451     // Set the link to view entry page
 452     $body .= url_base() . multisite('view_entry.php?id=' . $data['id']);
 453     if ($series)
 454     {
 455       $body .= '&series=1';
 456     }
 457     $body .= ($as_html) ? '">' . escape_html($data['name']) . '</a>' : '';
 458   }
 459   $body .= ($as_html) ? '</p>' . MAIL_EOL : MAIL_EOL . MAIL_EOL;
 460 
 461   $body .= ($as_html) ? '<table>' : '';
 462   $body .= MAIL_EOL;
 463 
 464   if ($compare && $as_html)
 465   {
 466     $body .= '<thead>' . MAIL_EOL;
 467     $body .= '<tr>' . MAIL_EOL;
 468     $body .= '<th>&nbsp;</th>' . MAIL_EOL;
 469     $body .= '<th>' . get_vocab("new_value") . '</th>' . MAIL_EOL;
 470     $body .= '<th>(' . get_vocab("old_value") . ')</th>' . MAIL_EOL;
 471     $body .= '</tr>' . MAIL_EOL;
 472     $body .= '</thead>' . MAIL_EOL;
 473   }
 474 
 475   $body .= ($as_html) ? '<tbody>' . MAIL_EOL : '';
 476 
 477 
 478   // Always display the brief description
 479   $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("namebooker"),
 480                                   $data['name'],
 481                                   $mail_previous['name'],
 482                                   $compare, $as_html);
 483 
 484   // Displays/don't displays entry details
 485   if ($mail_settings['details'])
 486   {
 487     // Description:
 488     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("description"),
 489                                     $data['description'],
 490                                     $mail_previous['description'],
 491                                     $compare, $as_html);
 492 
 493     if ($confirmation_enabled)
 494     {
 495       // Confirmation status:
 496       $new_status = ($data['tentative']) ? get_mail_vocab("tentative") : get_mail_vocab("confirmed");
 497       $old_status = ($mail_previous['tentative']) ? get_mail_vocab("tentative") : get_mail_vocab("confirmed");
 498       $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("confirmation_status"),
 499                                       $new_status,
 500                                       $old_status,
 501                                       $compare, $as_html);
 502     }
 503 
 504     if ($approval_enabled)
 505     {
 506       // Approval status:
 507       $new_status = ($data['awaiting_approval']) ? get_mail_vocab("awaiting_approval") : get_mail_vocab("approved");
 508       $old_status = ($mail_previous['awaiting_approval']) ? get_mail_vocab("awaiting_approval") : get_mail_vocab("approved");
 509       $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("approval_status"),
 510                                       $new_status,
 511                                       $old_status,
 512                                       $compare, $as_html);
 513     }
 514 
 515     // Room:
 516     $new_room = $data['area_name'] . " - " . $data['room_name'];
 517     $old_room = $mail_previous['area_name'] . " - " . $mail_previous['room_name'];
 518     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("room"),
 519                                     $new_room,
 520                                     $old_room,
 521                                     $compare, $as_html);
 522 
 523     // Start time
 524     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("start_date"),
 525                                     getMailDateString($data['start_time']),
 526                                     getMailDateString($mail_previous['start_time']),
 527                                     $compare, $as_html);
 528 
 529     // Duration
 530     $new_duration = $data['duration'] . " " . get_mail_vocab($data['dur_units']);
 531     $old_duration = $mail_previous['duration'] . " " . get_mail_vocab($mail_previous['dur_units']);
 532     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("duration"),
 533                                     $new_duration,
 534                                     $old_duration,
 535                                     $compare, $as_html);
 536 
 537     // End time
 538     $this_endtime = $data['end_time'];
 539     $previous_endtime = ($compare) ? $mail_previous['end_time'] : 0;
 540     if ($enable_periods)
 541     {
 542       // If we are using periods then the end_time is the end of the last
 543       // period.   We therefore need to subtract 60 seconds from it so that
 544       // we get the name of that period, rather than the name of the next one.
 545       $this_endtime = $this_endtime - 60;
 546       $previous_endtime = $previous_endtime - 60;
 547     }
 548     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("end_date"),
 549                                     getMailDateString($this_endtime),
 550                                     getMailDateString($previous_endtime),
 551                                     $compare, $as_html);
 552 
 553     // Type of booking
 554     if (isset($booking_types) && (count($booking_types) > 1))
 555     {
 556       $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("type"),
 557                                       get_type_vocab($data['type']),
 558                                       get_type_vocab($mail_previous['type']),
 559                                       $compare, $as_html);
 560     }
 561 
 562     // Created by
 563     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("createdby"),
 564                                     auth()->getDisplayName($data['create_by']),
 565                                     auth()->getDisplayName($mail_previous['create_by']),
 566                                     $compare, $as_html);
 567 
 568     // Custom fields
 569     $columns = Columns::getInstance(_tbl('entry'));
 570     foreach ($columns as $column)
 571     {
 572       if (!in_array($column->name, $standard_fields['entry']))
 573       {
 574         $key = $column->name;
 575         $value = $data[$key];
 576         // Convert any booleans or pseudo-booleans to text strings (in the mail language)
 577         if ($column->isBooleanLike())
 578         {
 579           $value = ($value) ? get_mail_vocab("yes") : get_mail_vocab("no");
 580           if ($compare)
 581           {
 582             $mail_previous[$key] = ($mail_previous[$key]) ? get_mail_vocab("yes") : get_mail_vocab("no");
 583           }
 584         }
 585         // For any associative arrays we want the value rather than the key
 586         if (isset($select_options["entry.$key"]) &&
 587             is_assoc($select_options["entry.$key"]) &&
 588             array_key_exists($value, $select_options["entry.$key"]))
 589         {
 590           $value = $select_options["entry.$key"][$value];
 591           if ($compare &&
 592               array_key_exists($mail_previous[$key], $select_options["entry.$key"]))
 593           {
 594             $mail_previous[$key] = $select_options["entry.$key"][$mail_previous[$key]];
 595           }
 596         }
 597         $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_field_name(_tbl('entry'), $key),
 598                                         $value,
 599                                         ($compare) ? $mail_previous[$key] : '',
 600                                         $compare, $as_html);
 601       }
 602     }
 603 
 604     // Last updated
 605     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("lastupdate"),
 606                                     getMailTimeDateString(time()),
 607                                     ($compare) ? getMailTimeDateString($mail_previous['last_updated']) : '',
 608                                     $compare, $as_html);
 609 
 610     // Repeat Type
 611     $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("rep_type"),
 612                                     get_mail_vocab("rep_type_" . $data['repeat_rule']->getType()),
 613                                     get_mail_vocab("rep_type_" . $mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getType()),
 614                                     $compare, $as_html);
 615 
 616     // Details if a series
 617     if ($data['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE)
 618     {
 619 
 620       if ($data['repeat_rule']->getType() == RepeatRule::WEEKLY)
 621       {
 622         // Repeat days
 623         // Display day names according to language and preferred weekday start.
 624         $opt = $data['repeat_rule']->getDaysAsNames(true);
 625         $opt_previous = ($compare) ? $mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getDaysAsNames(true) : '';
 626         $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("rep_rep_day"),
 627                                         $opt,
 628                                         $opt_previous,
 629                                         $compare, $as_html);
 630       }
 631 
 632       if ($data['repeat_rule']->getType() == RepeatRule::MONTHLY)
 633       {
 634         $previous_repeat_day = ($mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getType() == RepeatRule::MONTHLY) ? get_monthly_repeat_day($mail_previous) : '';
 635         $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("repeat_on"),
 636                                         get_monthly_repeat_day($data),
 637                                         $previous_repeat_day,
 638                                         $compare, $as_html);
 639       }
 640 
 641       // Repeat interval
 642       $repeat_interval = $data['repeat_rule']->getInterval();
 643       $new = $repeat_interval . ' ' . $data['repeat_rule']->getIntervalUnits(true);
 644 
 645       $previous_repeat_interval = $mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getInterval();
 646       if (isset($previous_repeat_interval))
 647       {
 648         $old = $previous_repeat_interval . ' ' . $mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getIntervalUnits(true);
 649       }
 650       else
 651       {
 652         $old = '';
 653       }
 654 
 655       $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("rep_interval"),
 656                                       $new,
 657                                       $old,
 658                                       $compare, $as_html);
 659 
 660       // Repeat end date
 661       $end_previous = ($mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getType() == RepeatRule::NONE) ? '' : getMailTimeDateString($mail_previous['repeat_rule']->getEndDate()->getTimestamp(), false);
 662       $body .= create_body_table_row (get_mail_vocab("rep_end_date"),
 663                                       getMailTimeDateString($data['repeat_rule']->getEndDate()->getTimestamp(), false),
 664                                       $end_previous,
 665                                       $compare, $as_html);
 666 
 667     }
 668   }
 669 
 670   if ($as_html)
 671   {
 672     $body .= '</tbody>' . MAIL_EOL;
 673     $body .= '</table>' . MAIL_EOL;
 674   }
 675 
 676   // Add in a list of repeat dates.  Although we've given them the repeat characteristics
 677   // above, it's often helpful to have this expanded out into a list of actual dates to
 678   // avoid any confusion.    The repeat list also gives a list of dates that could not
 679   // be booked due to conflicts.
 680   if ($data['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE)
 681   {
 682     $body .= create_repeat_list($data, $action, $as_html, $start_times);
 683   }
 684 
 685   if ($as_html)
 686   {
 687     $body .= '</div>' . MAIL_EOL;
 688     $body .= '</body>' . MAIL_EOL;
 689     $body .= '</html>' . MAIL_EOL;
 690   }
 691 
 692   return $body;
 693 }
 694 
 695 
 696 // Merges a comma separated string of addresses (could be a single address) into
 697 // an array of addresses
 698 // TODO: simplify all address handling
 699 function address_merge(array $addresses, string $address_string) : array
 700 {
 701   $result = $addresses;
 702 
 703   $new_addresses = parse_addresses($address_string);
 704   $mailer = new PHPMailer();
 705   $mailer->CharSet = get_mail_charset();
 706 
 707   foreach ($new_addresses as $new_address)
 708   {
 709     $result[] = $mailer->addrFormat(array($new_address['address'], $new_address['name']));
 710   }
 711 
 712   return $result;
 713 }
 714 
 715 
 716 // create_addresses($data, $action)
 717 //
 718 // Returns an array indexed by 'from', 'reply_to', 'to' and 'cc' with each element
 719 // consisting of a comma separated list of email addresses.
 720 //
 721 // Parameters:
 722 //   $data     an array containing all the data concerning this booking
 723 //   $action   the action that has caused this email to be sent
 724 //
 725 function create_addresses(array $data, string $action) : array
 726 {
 727   global $approval_enabled, $mail_settings;
 728 
 729   $reply_to = array();
 730   $to = array();
 731   $cc = array();
 732 
 733   if (!empty($mail_settings['cc']))
 734   {
 735     $cc = address_merge($cc, $mail_settings['cc']);
 736   }
 737 
 738   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 739   if (isset($mrbs_user))
 740   {
 741     // Set the Reply-To address
 742     if ($mail_settings['use_reply_to'] && !empty($mrbs_user->email))
 743     {
 744       $reply_to[] = $mrbs_user->mailbox();
 745     }
 746     // Set the From address.  If this is a reminder email or a request for more info,
 747     // then set the From address to be the user's - unless we've configured MRBS not
 748     // to do this (to avoid the email being rejected as spam), in which case we'll
 749     // put the user's address on the Cc line, which will enable the recipient to
 750     // use it in a reply.
 751     if (in_array($action, array('more_info', 'remind')))
 752     {
 753       if ($mail_settings['use_from_for_all_mail'])
 754       {
 755         $cc[] = $mrbs_user->mailbox();
 756       }
 757       else
 758       {
 759         $from = $mrbs_user->mailbox();
 760       }
 761     }
 762   }
 763 
 764   if (empty($from))
 765   {
 766     $from = (isset($mail_settings['from'])) ? $mail_settings['from'] : null;
 767   }
 768 
 769   // if we're requiring bookings to be approved and this user needs approval
 770   // for this room, then get the email addresses of the approvers
 771   if (!in_array($action, array('delete', 'reject')) &&
 772       $approval_enabled &&
 773       !is_book_admin($data['room_id']))
 774   {
 775     $email = get_approvers_email($data['room_id']);
 776     if (!empty($email))
 777     {
 778       $to = address_merge($to, $email);
 779     }
 780   }
 781 
 782   $to = address_merge($to, get_admin_email());
 783 
 784   if ($mail_settings['area_admin_on_bookings'])
 785   {
 786     // Look for list of area admins email addresses
 787     if (empty($data['area_admin_email']))
 788     {
 789       $email = get_area_admin_email($data['id'], ($data['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE));
 790     }
 791     else
 792     {
 793       $email = $data['area_admin_email'];
 794     }
 795     if (!empty($email))
 796     {
 797       $to = address_merge($to, $email);
 798     }
 799   }
 800 
 801   if ($mail_settings['room_admin_on_bookings'])
 802   {
 803     // Look for list of room admins email addresses
 804     if (empty($data['room_admin_email']))
 805     {
 806       $email = get_room_admin_email($data['id'], ($data['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE));
 807     }
 808     else
 809     {
 810       $email = $data['room_admin_email'];
 811     }
 812     if (!empty($email))
 813     {
 814       $to = address_merge($to, $email);
 815     }
 816   }
 817 
 818   if ($mail_settings['booker'])
 819   {
 820     if (in_array($action, array("approve", "more_info", "reject")))
 821     {
 822       // Put the addresses on the cc line and the booker will go
 823       // on the to line
 824       $cc = array_merge($cc, $to);
 825       $to = array();
 826     }
 827     $booker = auth()->getUser($data['create_by']);
 828     if (!empty($booker->email))
 829     {
 830       $to[] = $booker->mailbox();
 831     }
 832   }
 833 
 834   $addresses = array();
 835   $addresses['from'] = $from;
 836   $addresses['reply_to'] = (empty($reply_to)) ? '' : get_address_list($reply_to);
 837   $addresses['to'] = (empty($to)) ? '' : get_address_list($to);
 838   $addresses['cc'] = (empty($cc)) ? '' : get_address_list($cc);
 839 
 840   return $addresses;
 841 }

 844 // }}}
 845 // {{{ notifyAdminOnBooking()
 846 
 847 /**
 848  * Send email to administrator to notify a new/changed entry.
 849  *
 850  * @param array   $data          contains the data for this entry
 851  * @param array   $mail_previous contains the data for the previous entry, or is an empty array
 852  * @param bool    $new_entry     whether this is a new entry or not
 853  * @param bool    $series        whether this is a series or not
 854  * @param array   $start_times   an array of start times that have been made
 855  * @param string  $action        the booking action (eg "delete", "more_info", etc.)
 856  * @param string  $note          a note that is used with "more_info"
 857  */
 858 function notifyAdminOnBooking(array $data, array $mail_previous, bool $new_entry, bool $series, array $start_times, string $action='book', ?string $note=null) : void
 859 {
 860   global $mail_settings, $enable_periods;
 861   global $mrbs_company;
 862 
 863   mail_debug('Preparing email for new or changed booking ...');
 864 
 865   // Add some values to the $data array before we go and create the addresses
 866   if (!$new_entry)
 867   {
 868     $data['area_admin_email'] = (!empty($mail_previous['area_admin_email'])) ? $mail_previous['area_admin_email'] : NULL;
 869     $data['room_admin_email'] = (!empty($mail_previous['room_admin_email'])) ? $mail_previous['room_admin_email'] : NULL;
 870   }
 871 
 872   // Set up the addresses (from, to and cc)
 873   $addresses = create_addresses($data, $action);
 874   if (empty($addresses['to']) && empty($addresses['cc']))
 875   {
 876     mail_debug('Email abandoned: no addresses.');
 877     return;
 878   }
 879 
 880   // Set up the subject
 881   //
 882   // If we're sending iCalendar notifications, then it seems that some calendar
 883   // applications use the email subject as the booking title instead of the iCal
 884   // SUMMARY field.   As far as I can see this is wrong, but as a circumvention
 885   // we'll put the booking title in the email subject line.   (See also
 886   // SF Tracker id 3297799)
 887   if ($mail_settings['icalendar'] && !$enable_periods)
 888   {
 889     $subject = $data['name'];
 890   }
 891   else
 892   {
 893     switch ($action)
 894     {
 895       case "approve":
 896         $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_approved", $mrbs_company);
 897         break;
 898       case "more_info":
 899         $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_more_info", $mrbs_company);
 900         break;
 901       case "remind":
 902         $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_reminder", $mrbs_company);
 903         break;
 904       default:
 905         if ($new_entry)
 906         {
 907           $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_new_entry", $mrbs_company);
 908         }
 909         else
 910         {
 911           $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_changed_entry", $mrbs_company);
 912         }
 913         break;
 914     }
 915   }
 916 
 917   // Create the text body
 918   $compare = !$new_entry;
 919   $text_body = create_body($data, $mail_previous, $compare, $series, $action, $start_times, false, $note);
 920 
 921   // Create the HTML body
 922   if ($mail_settings['html'])
 923   {
 924     $html_body = create_body($data, $mail_previous, $compare, $series, $action, $start_times, true, $note);
 925   }
 926 
 927   // Create the iCalendar if required
 928   // Don't add an iCalendar if we're using periods, because MRBS doesn't know when periods
 929   // occur in the day, so can't construct a VEVENT.
 930   // Don't add an iCalendar if this is a reminder or a request for more info because then
 931   // the recipient probably won't be able to reply to the email: we just want an ordinary
 932   // email and not a calendar notification.
 933   $attachment = array();
 934   if ($mail_settings['icalendar'] &&
 935       !$enable_periods &&
 936       !in_array($action, array('more_info', 'remind')))
 937   {
 938     $attachment['method']   = "REQUEST";
 939     $ical_components = array();
 940     // TODO: the addresses have by this stage been MIME-encoded.  It would probably be better to
 941     // TODO: pass unencoded addresses to create_ical_event() so that we don't have to decode them,
 942     // TODO: as mb_decode_mimeheader() isn't guaranteed to exist.
 943     $ical_components[] = create_ical_event($attachment['method'], $data, $addresses, $series);
 944     $attachment['content']  = create_icalendar($attachment['method'], $ical_components);
 945     $attachment['name']     = $mail_settings['ics_filename'] . ".ics";
 946   }
 947 
 948   MailQueue::add(
 949       $addresses,
 950       $subject,
 951       $text_body,
 952       $html_body ?? null,
 953       $attachment,
 954       get_mail_charset()
 955     );
 956 }
 957 
 958 // }}}
 959 // {{{ notifyAdminOnDelete()
 960 
 961 /**
 962  * Send email to administrator to notify a new/changed entry.
 963  *
 964  * @param   array   $data      contains deleted entry data for email body
 965  * @param   array   $start_times an array of start times that have been deleted
 966  * @param   bool    $series    whether this is a series or not
 967  * @param   string  $action    the booking action (eg 'delete', 'more_info', etc.)
 968  * @param   string  $note      a note that is used with 'reject'
 969  */
 970 function notifyAdminOnDelete($data, $start_times, bool $series=false, string $action='delete', ?string $note=null)
 971 {
 972   global $mail_settings, $enable_periods;
 973   global $mrbs_company;
 974 
 975   if ($mail_settings['debug'])
 976   {
 977     mail_debug('Preparing email for deleted booking');
 978   }
 979 
 980   // As we are going to cancel this booking we need to increment the iCalendar
 981   // sequence number
 982   $data['ical_sequence']++;
 983 
 984   // Set up the addresses (from, to and cc)
 985   $addresses = create_addresses($data, $action);
 986   if (empty($addresses['to']) && empty($addresses['cc']))
 987   {
 988     mail_debug('Email abandoned: no addresses.');
 989     return;
 990   }
 991 
 992   // Set the subject
 993   //
 994   // If we're sending iCalendar notifications, then it seems that some calendar
 995   // applications use the email subject as the booking title instead of the iCal
 996   // SUMMARY field.   As far as I can see this is wrong, but as a circumvention
 997   // we'll put the booking title in the email subject line.   (See also
 998   // SF Tracker id 3297799)
 999   if ($mail_settings['icalendar'] && !$enable_periods)
1000   {
1001     $subject = $data['name'];
1002   }
1003   elseif ($action == "reject")
1004   {
1005     $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_rejected", $mrbs_company);
1006   }
1007   else
1008   {
1009     $subject = get_mail_vocab("mail_subject_delete", $mrbs_company);
1010   }
1011 
1012   // Create the text body
1013   $text_body = create_body($data, null, false, $series, $action, $start_times, false, $note);
1014 
1015   // Create the HTML body
1016   if ($mail_settings['html'])
1017   {
1018     $html_body = create_body($data, null, false, $series, $action, $start_times, true, $note);
1019   }
1020 
1021   // Set up the attachment
1022   $attachment = array();
1023   if ($mail_settings['icalendar'] && !$enable_periods)
1024   {
1025     $attachment['method']   = "CANCEL";
1026     $ical_components = array();
1027     $ical_components[] = create_ical_event($attachment['method'], $data, $addresses, $series);
1028     $attachment['content']  = create_icalendar($attachment['method'], $ical_components);
1029     $attachment['name']     = $mail_settings['ics_filename'] . ".ics";
1030   }
1031 
1032   MailQueue::add(
1033       $addresses,
1034       $subject,
1035       $text_body,
1036       $html_body ?? null,
1037       $attachment,
1038       get_mail_charset()
1039     );
1040 }

1043 function debug_output(string $message) : void
1044 {
1045   global $mail_settings;
1046 
1047   if (isset($mail_settings['debug_output']) &&
1048       ($mail_settings['debug_output'] == 'browser'))
1049   {
1050     echo escape_html($message) . "<br>\n";
1051     // flush in case they have output_buffering configured on
1052     if (ob_get_length() !== FALSE)
1053     {
1054       ob_flush();
1055     }
1056     flush();
1057   }
1058   else  // anything else goes to the error log
1059   {
1060     error_log($message);
1061   }
1062 }

1066 {

1068 
1069   if ($mail_settings['debug'])

1071     debug_output('[DEBUG] ' . $message);
1072   }

   1 <?php
   2 declare(strict_types=1);
   3 namespace MRBS;
   4 
   5 // +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   6 // | Meeting Room Booking System.
   7 // +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   8 // | Grabs the names and values of the $_POST and $_GET variables.
   9 // |---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  10 // | This library grabs the names and values of the variables sent or posted to
  11 // | a script in the $_POST and $_GET variables.
  12 // | It does the same work for other external variables used in MRBS.
  13 // | USE : This file should be included in all files where external variables
  14 // |       are used, preferably before other included files.
  15 // | :WARNING: thierry_bo 030216: if any new external variable is used,
  16 // |           it must also be added here.
  17 // +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  18 // | @author    Original Authors : PhpMyAdmin project.
  19 // +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  20 
  21 
  22 // Gets a form variable.
  23 //    $var        The variable name
  24 //    $var_type   The type of the variable ('bool', 'decimal', 'float', 'int', 'string').  Arrays of these
  25 //                types are also supported by enclosing the types in square brackets, eg '[int]'.
  26 //                For backwards compatibility 'array' is also supported and is equivalent to '[string]'.
  27 //    $default    The default value for the variable
  28 //    $source     If set, then restrict the search to this source.  Can be INPUT_GET or INPUT_POST.
  29 function get_form_var(string $var, string $var_type='string', $default=null, ?int $source=null)
  30 {
  31   // We use some functions from here
  32   require_once "functions.inc";
  33 
  34   global $cli_params, $allow_cli, $get, $post;
  35 
  36   // For backwards compatibility
  37   if ($var_type == 'array')
  38   {
  39     $var_type = '[string]';
  40   }
  41 
  42   // Parse $var_type
  43   list('element_type' => $element_type, 'is_array' => $is_array) = parse_var_type($var_type);
  44 
  45   // Set the default value, and make sure it's the right type
  46   if ($is_array)
  47   {
  48     $result = isset($default) ? (array) $default : [];
  49   }
  50   else
  51   {
  52     $result = $default;
  53   }
  54 
  55   // Get the command line arguments if any (and we're allowed to),
  56   // otherwise get the POST variables
  57   if ($allow_cli && (!empty($cli_params) && isset($cli_params[$var])))
  58   {
  59     $result = $cli_params[$var];
  60   }
  61   else if ((!isset($source) || ($source === INPUT_POST)) &&
  62            (!empty($post) && isset($post[$var])))
  63   {
  64     $result = $post[$var];
  65   }
  66 
  67   // Then get the GET variables
  68   if ((!isset($source) || ($source === INPUT_GET)) &&
  69       (!empty($get) && isset($get[$var])))
  70   {
  71     $result = $get[$var];
  72   }
  73 
  74   // Clean up the result
  75   if ($is_array)
  76   {
  77     if (isset($result))
  78     {
  79       $result = (array) $result;
  80       foreach ($result as $key => $value)
  81       {
  82         $result[$key] = clean_value($value, $element_type);
  83       }
  84     }
  85   }
  86   else
  87   {
  88     $result = clean_value($result, $element_type);
  89   }
  90 
  91   return $result;
  92 }
  93 
  94 
  95 // Get the type that should be used with get_form_var() for
  96 // a field which is a member of the array returned by get_field_info()
  97 function get_form_var_type(array $field) : string
  98 {
  99   // "Level" is an exception because we've forced the value to be a string
 100   // so that it can be used in an associative array
 101   if ($field['name'] == 'level')
 102   {
 103     return 'string';
 104   }
 105 
 106   switch($field['nature'])
 107   {
 108     case 'character':
 109       $type = 'string';
 110       break;
 111     case 'integer':
 112       // Smallints and tinyints are considered to be booleans
 113       $type = (isset($field['length']) && ($field['length'] <= 2)) ? 'bool' : 'int';
 114       break;
 115     case 'real':
 116       $type = 'float';
 117       break;
 118     // We can only really deal with the types above at the moment
 119     default:
 120       $type = 'string';
 121       break;
 122   }
 123   return $type;
 124 }
 125 
 126 
 127 function clean_value($value, string $element_type)
 128 {
 129   // Checkboxes return null if not set, so we want them to be converted to false below
 130   if (($element_type !== 'bool') && ($value === null))
 131   {
 132     return null;
 133   }
 134 
 135   switch ($element_type)
 136   {
 137     case 'bool':
 138       $value = (bool) $value;
 139       break;
 140     case 'decimal':
 141       // This isn't a very good sanitisation as it will let through thousands separators and
 142       // also multiple decimal points.  It needs to be improved, but care needs to be taken
 143       // over, for example, whether a comma should be allowed for a decimal point.  So for
 144       // the moment it errs on the side of letting through too much.
 145       $value = filter_var($value, FILTER_SANITIZE_NUMBER_FLOAT,
 146         FILTER_FLAG_ALLOW_FRACTION | FILTER_FLAG_ALLOW_THOUSAND);
 147       if ($value === '')
 148       {
 149         $value = null;
 150       }
 151       break;
 152     case 'float':
 153       $value = ($value === '') ? null : floatval($value);
 154       break;
 155     case 'int':
 156       $value = ($value === '') ? null : intval($value);
 157       break;
 158     default:
 159       break;
 160   }
 161 
 162   return $value;
 163 }
 164 
 165 
 166 function parse_var_type(string $var_type) : array
 167 {
 168   if (false === preg_match('/^\[(.*)]$/', $var_type, $matches))
 169   {
 170     throw new \Exception("preg_match() failed");
 171   }
 172 
 173   $is_array = (isset($matches[1]));
 174   $element_type = $matches[1] ?? $var_type;
 175 
 176   // Validate
 177   if (!in_array($element_type, ['bool', 'decimal', 'float', 'int', 'string']))
 178   {
 179     throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Invalid argument '$var_type'");
 180   }
 181 
 182   return [
 183     'element_type' => $element_type,
 184     'is_array' => $is_array,
 185   ];
 186 }
 187 
 188 
 189 // Check that the WordPress files haven't already been included (and therefore
 190 // that $_POST and $_GET haven't already been tampered with).
 191 if (defined('ABSPATH'))  // standard test for WordPress
 192 {
 193   die('MRBS internal error: Wordpress files have already been included.');
 194 }
 195 
 196 // Unfortunately, in WordPress all $_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE and $_SERVER superglobals are
 197 // slashed, regardless of the setting of magic_quotes.   So if we are using the
 198 // WordPress authentication and session schemes then this will happen when the WordPress
 199 // files are included.  To get round this we take a local copy of $_GET and $_POST
 200 // before the WordPress files are included.   (There's no need to do this with $_SERVER
 201 // because we process $_SERVER when this file is included and we make sure that the
 202 // WordPress files haven't already been included).  For more details of the problem see
 203 // https://wordpress.org/support/topic/wp-automatically-escaping-get-and-post-etc-globals and
 204 // https://core.trac.wordpress.org/ticket/18322
 205 
 206 // Take clean copies of $_GET, $_POST and $_SERVER  before WordPress alters them
 207 // ($_COOKIE isn't a problem because if we are using WordPress auth and session then
 208 // we won't be using $_COOKIE).
 209 
 210 $get = $_GET;
 211 $post = $_POST;
 212 $server = $_SERVER;
 213 
 214 // If we're operating from the command line then build
 215 // an associative array of the command line parameters
 216 // (assumes they're in the form 'parameter=value')
 217 if (!empty($argc))
 218 {
 219   $cli_params = array();
 220   for ($i=1; $i<$argc; $i++)
 221   {
 222     parse_str($argv[$i], $param);
 223     $cli_params = array_merge($cli_params, $param);
 224   }
 225 }

  36 // Get the available compression wrappers that we can use.
  37 // Returns an array
  38 function get_compression_wrappers() : array
  39 {
  40   $result = array();
  41   if (function_exists('stream_get_wrappers'))
  42   {
  43     $wrappers = stream_get_wrappers();
  44     foreach ($wrappers as $wrapper)
  45     {
  46       if ((($wrapper == 'zip') && class_exists('ZipArchive')) ||
  47           (mb_strpos($wrapper, 'compress.') === 0))
  48       {
  49         $result[] = $wrapper;
  50       }
  51     }
  52   }
  53   return $result;
  54 }

  57 // Gets the id of the area/room with the LOCATION property value of $location,
  58 // creating an area and room if allowed.
  59 // Returns FALSE if it can't find an id or create an id, with an error message in $error
  60 function get_room_id($location, &$error)
  61 {
  62   global $area_room_order, $area_room_delimiter, $area_room_create;
  63 
  64   // If there's no delimiter we assume we've just been given a room name (that will
  65   // have to be unique).   Otherwise we split the location into its area and room parts
  66   if (mb_strpos($location, $area_room_delimiter) === false)
  67   {
  68     $location_area = '';
  69     $location_room = $location;
  70   }
  71   elseif ($area_room_order == 'area_room')
  72   {
  73     list($location_area, $location_room) = explode($area_room_delimiter, $location, 2);
  74   }
  75   else
  76   {
  77     list($location_room, $location_area) = explode($area_room_delimiter, $location, 2);
  78   }
  79   $location_area = trim($location_area);
  80   $location_room = trim($location_room);
  81 
  82   // Now search the database for the room
  83 
  84   // Case 1:  we've just been given a room name, in which case we hope it happens
  85   // to be unique, because if we find more than one we won't know which one is intended
  86   // and if we don't find one at all we won't be able to create it because we won't
  87   // know which area to put it in.
  88   if ($location_area == '')
  89   {
  90     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*)
  91               FROM " . _tbl('room') . "
  92              WHERE room_name=?";
  93     $count = db()->query1($sql, array($location_room));
  94 
  95     if ($count == 0)
  96     {
  97       $error = "'$location_room': " . get_vocab("room_does_not_exist_no_area");
  98       return false;
  99     }
 100     elseif ($count > 1)
 101     {
 102       $error = "'$location_room': " . get_vocab("room_not_unique_no_area");
 103       return false;
 104     }
 105     else // we've got a unique room name
 106     {
 107       $sql = "SELECT id
 108                 FROM " . _tbl('room') . "
 109                WHERE room_name=?
 110                LIMIT 1";
 111       $id = db()->query1($sql, array($location_room));
 112       return $id;
 113     }
 114   }
 115 
 116   // Case 2:  we've got an area and room name
 117   else
 118   {
 119     // First of all get the area id
 120     $sql = "SELECT id
 121               FROM " . _tbl('area') . "
 122              WHERE area_name=?
 123              LIMIT 1";
 124     $area_id = db()->query1($sql, array($location_area));
 125     if ($area_id < 0)
 126     {
 127       // The area does not exist - create it if we are allowed to
 128       if (!$area_room_create)
 129       {
 130         $error = get_vocab("area_does_not_exist") . " '$location_area'";
 131         return false;
 132       }
 133       else
 134       {
 135         echo get_vocab("creating_new_area") . " '$location_area'<br>\n";
 136         $error_add_area = '';
 137         $area_id = mrbsAddArea($location_area, $error_add_area);
 138         if ($area_id === false)
 139         {
 140           $error = get_vocab("could_not_create_area") . " '$location_area'";
 141           return false;
 142         }
 143       }
 144     }
 145   }
 146   // Now we've got the area_id get the room_id
 147   $sql = "SELECT id
 148             FROM " . _tbl('room') . "
 149            WHERE room_name=?
 150              AND area_id=?
 151            LIMIT 1";
 152   $room_id = db()->query1($sql, array($location_room, $area_id));
 153   if ($room_id < 0)
 154   {
 155     // The room does not exist - create it if we are allowed to
 156     if (!$area_room_create)
 157     {
 158       $error = get_vocab("room_does_not_exist") . " '$location_room'";
 159       return false;
 160     }
 161     else
 162     {
 163       echo get_vocab("creating_new_room") . " '$location_room'<br>\n";
 164       $error_add_room = '';
 165       $room_id = mrbsAddRoom($location_room, $area_id, $error_add_room);
 166       if ($room_id === false)
 167       {
 168         $error = get_vocab("could_not_create_room") . " '$location_room'";
 169         return false;
 170       }
 171     }
 172   }
 173   return $room_id;
 174 }

 177 // Turn an EXDATE property into an array of timestamps
 178 function get_skip_list(string $values, array $params) : array
 179 {
 180   $result = array();
 181 
 182   $tzid = $params['TZID'] ?? 'UTC';
 183   $date_time_zone = new DateTimeZone($tzid);
 184   $exdates = explode(',', $values);
 185 
 186   foreach ($exdates as $exdate)
 187   {
 188     $date = new DateTime($exdate, $date_time_zone);
 189     $result[] = $date->getTimestamp();
 190   }
 191 
 192   return $result;
 193 }

 195 // Get the next line, after unfolding, from the stream.
 196 // Returns FALSE when EOF is reached
 197 function get_unfolded_line($handle)
 198 {
 199   static $buffer_line;
 200 
 201   // If there's something in the buffer line left over
 202   // from the last call, then start with that.
 203   if (isset($buffer_line))
 204   {
 205     $unfolded_line = $buffer_line;
 206     $buffer_line = null;
 207   }
 208 
 209   // Theoretically the line should be folded if it's longer than 75 octets
 210   // but just in case the file has been created without using folding we
 211   // will read a large number (4096) of bytes to make sure that we get as
 212   // far as the CRLF.
 213   while (false !== ($line = stream_get_line($handle, 4096, "\r\n")))
 214   {
 215     if (!isset($unfolded_line))
 216     {
 217       $unfolded_line = $line;
 218     }
 219     else
 220     {
 221       $first_char = mb_substr($line, 0, 1);
 222       // If the first character of the line is a space or tab then it's
 223       // part of a fold
 224       if (($first_char == " ") || ($first_char == "\t"))
 225       {
 226         $unfolded_line .= mb_substr($line, 1);
 227       }
 228       // Otherwise we've reached the start of the next unfolded line, so
 229       // save it for next time and finish
 230       else
 231       {
 232         $buffer_line = $line;
 233         break;
 234       }
 235     }
 236   }
 237 
 238   return (isset($unfolded_line)) ? $unfolded_line : false;
 239 }
 240 
 241 
 242 // Get the next event from the stream.
 243 // Returns FALSE if EOF has been reached, or else an array
 244 // of lines for the event.  The BEGIN:VEVENT and END:VEVENT
 245 // lines are not included in the array.
 246 function get_event($handle)
 247 {
 248   // Advance to the beginning of the event
 249   while ((false !== ($ical_line = get_unfolded_line($handle))) && ($ical_line != 'BEGIN:VEVENT'))
 250   {
 251   }
 252 
 253   // No more events
 254   if ($ical_line === false)
 255   {
 256     return false;
 257   }
 258   // Get the event
 259   $vevent = array();
 260   while ((false !== ($ical_line = get_unfolded_line($handle))) && ($ical_line != 'END:VEVENT'))
 261   {
 262     $vevent[] = $ical_line;
 263   }
 264 
 265   return $vevent;
 266 }

 268 
 269 // Add a VEVENT to MRBS.   Returns TRUE on success, FALSE if the event wasn't added
 270 function process_event(array $vevent) : bool
 271 {
 272   global $import_default_room, $import_default_type, $import_past, $skip;
 273   global $morningstarts, $morningstarts_minutes, $resolution;
 274   global $booking_types;
 275   global $ignore_location, $add_location;
 276   global $default_type;
 277 
 278   // We are going to cache the settings ($resolution etc.) for the rooms
 279   // in order to avoid lots of database lookups
 280   static $room_settings = array();
 281 
 282   $registration_keys = array(
 283     'allow_registration',
 284     'registrant_limit',
 285     'registrant_limit_enabled',
 286     'registration_opens',
 287     'registration_opens_enabled',
 288     'registration_closes',
 289     'registration_closes_enabled'
 290   );
 291 
 292   // Set up the booking with some defaults
 293   $registrants = array();
 294   $booking = array();
 295   $booking['awaiting_approval'] = false;
 296   $booking['private'] = false;
 297   $booking['tentative'] = false;
 298   $repeat_rule = new RepeatRule();
 299   $repeat_rule->setType(RepeatRule::NONE);
 300   $booking['repeat_rule'] = $repeat_rule;
 301   $booking['type'] = $import_default_type;
 302   $booking['room_id'] = $import_default_room;
 303 
 304   // Parse all the lines first because we'll need to get the start date
 305   // for calculating some of the other settings
 306   $properties = array();
 307   $problems = array();
 308 
 309   $line = current($vevent);
 310   while ($line !== false)
 311   {
 312     $property = RFC5545::parseProperty($line);
 313     // Ignore any sub-components (eg a VALARM inside a VEVENT) as MRBS does not
 314     // yet handle things like reminders.  Skip through to the end of the sub-
 315     // component.   Just in case you can have sub-components at a greater depth
 316     // than 1 (not sure if you can), make sure we've got to the matching END.
 317     if ($property['name'] != 'BEGIN')
 318     {
 319       $properties[] = $property;
 320       // Get the start time because we'll need it later
 321       if ($property['name'] == 'DTSTART')
 322       {
 323         $booking['start_time'] = RFC5545::getTimestamp($property['value'], $property['params']);
 324       }
 325     }
 326     else
 327     {
 328       $component = $property['value'];
 329       while (!(($property['name'] == 'END') && ($property['value'] == $component)) &&
 330              ($line = next($vevent)))
 331       {
 332         $property = RFC5545::parseProperty($line);
 333       }
 334     }
 335     $line = next($vevent);
 336   }
 337 
 338   if (!isset($booking['start_time']))
 339   {
 340     trigger_error("No DTSTART", E_USER_WARNING);
 341   }
 342 
 343   // Now go through the properties
 344   foreach($properties as $property)
 345   {
 346     switch ($property['name'])
 347     {
 348       case 'ORGANIZER':
 349         $booking['create_by'] = get_create_by($property['value']);
 350         $booking['modified_by'] = '';
 351         break;
 352 
 353       case 'SUMMARY':
 354         $booking['name'] = $property['value'];
 355         break;
 356 
 357       case 'DESCRIPTION':
 358         $booking['description'] = $property['value'];
 359         break;
 360 
 361       case 'LOCATION':
 362         $location = $property['value']; // We may need the original LOCATION later
 363         if ($ignore_location)
 364         {
 365           $booking['room_id'] = $import_default_room;
 366         }
 367         else
 368         {
 369           $error = '';
 370           $booking['room_id'] = get_room_id($location, $error);
 371           if ($booking['room_id'] === false)
 372           {
 373             $problems[] = $error;
 374           }
 375         }
 376         break;
 377 
 378       case 'DTSTART':
 379         // We've already handled this
 380         break;
 381 
 382       case 'DTEND':
 383         $booking['end_time'] = RFC5545::getTimestamp($property['value'], $property['params']);
 384         break;
 385 
 386       case 'DURATION':
 387         trigger_error("DURATION not yet supported by MRBS", E_USER_WARNING);
 388         break;
 389 
 390       case 'RRULE':
 391         $rrule_errors = array();
 392         $repeat_rule = get_repeat_rule($property['value'], $booking['start_time'], $rrule_errors);
 393         if ($repeat_rule === false)
 394         {
 395           $problems = array_merge($problems, $rrule_errors);
 396         }
 397         else
 398         {
 399           $booking['repeat_rule'] = $repeat_rule;
 400         }
 401         break;
 402 
 403       case 'EXDATE':
 404         try
 405         {
 406           $booking['skip_list'] = get_skip_list($property['value'], $property['params']);
 407         }
 408         catch (\Exception $e)
 409         {
 410           // If it's a bad timezone, flag that as a problem, otherwise rethrow the exception
 411           if (str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'Unknown or bad timezone'))
 412           {
 413             $problems[] = get_vocab('bad_timezone', $property['params']['TZID'] ?? 'UTC');
 414           }
 415           else
 416           {
 417             throw new \Exception($e);
 418           }
 419         }
 420         break;
 421 
 422       case 'CLASS':
 423         $booking['private'] = in_array($property['value'], array('PRIVATE', 'CONFIDENTIAL'));
 424         break;
 425 
 426       case 'STATUS':
 427         $booking['tentative'] = ($property['value'] == 'TENTATIVE');
 428         break;
 429 
 430       case 'UID':
 431         $booking['ical_uid'] = $property['value'];
 432         break;
 433 
 434       case 'SEQUENCE':
 435         $booking['ical_sequence'] = $property['value'];
 436         break;
 437 
 438       case 'LAST-MODIFIED':
 439         // We probably ought to do something with LAST-MODIFIED and use it
 440         // for the timestamp field
 441         break;
 442 
 443       default:
 444         // MRBS specific properties
 445         $mrbs_prefix = 'X-MRBS-';
 446         if (str_starts_with($property['name'], $mrbs_prefix))
 447         {
 448           $key = substr($property['name'], strlen($mrbs_prefix));
 449           $key = strtolower($key);
 450           $key = str_replace('-', '_', $key);
 451           // Type
 452           if ($key == 'type')
 453           {
 454             if (!empty($booking_types))
 455             {
 456               foreach ($booking_types as $type)
 457               {
 458                 if ($property['value'] == get_type_vocab($type))
 459                 {
 460                   $booking['type'] = $type;
 461                   break;
 462                 }
 463               }
 464             }
 465           }
 466           // Registration keys
 467           elseif (in_array($key, $registration_keys))
 468           {
 469             $booking[$key] = $property['value'];
 470           }
 471           // Registrants
 472           elseif ($key == 'registrant')
 473           {
 474             $registrants[] = array(
 475               'username'    => $property['value'],
 476               'registered'  => $property['params']['X-MRBS-REGISTERED'],
 477               'create_by'   => RFC5545::unescapeQuotedString($property['params']['X-MRBS-CREATE-BY'])
 478             );
 479           }
 480           // TODO: custom fields
 481         }
 482         break;
 483     }
 484   }
 485 
 486   if (!$import_past && ($booking['end_time'] < time()))
 487   {
 488     return false;
 489   }
 490 
 491   // If we didn't manage to work out a username then just put the booking
 492   // under the name of the current user
 493   if (!isset($booking['create_by']))
 494   {
 495     $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 496     $mrbs_username = (isset($mrbs_user)) ? $mrbs_user->username : null;
 497     $booking['create_by'] = $mrbs_username;
 498   }
 499 
 500   // On the other hand a UID is mandatory in RFC 5545.   We'll be lenient and
 501   // provide one if it is missing
 502   if (!isset($booking['ical_uid']))
 503   {
 504     $booking['ical_uid'] = generate_global_uid($booking['name']);
 505     $booking['sequence'] = 0;  // and we'll start the sequence from 0
 506   }
 507 
 508   // Modify the brief and/or full descriptions
 509   if (!empty($add_location) && isset($location) && ($location !== ''))
 510   {
 511     // Brief description (SUMMARY)
 512     if (in_array('summary', $add_location))
 513     {
 514       if (isset($booking['name']) && ($booking['name'] !== ''))
 515       {
 516         $booking['name'] = get_vocab('expanded_name',
 517                                      $booking['name'],
 518                                      $location);
 519       }
 520       else
 521       {
 522         $booking['name'] = get_vocab('expanded_empty_name', $location);
 523       }
 524     }
 525     // Full description (DESCRIPTION)
 526     if (in_array('description', $add_location))
 527     {
 528       if (isset($booking['description']) && ($booking['description'] !== ''))
 529       {
 530         $booking['description'] = get_vocab('expanded_description',
 531                                             $booking['description'],
 532                                             $location);
 533       }
 534       else
 535       {
 536         $booking['description'] = get_vocab('expanded_empty_description', $location);
 537       }
 538     }
 539   }
 540 
 541   // A SUMMARY is optional in RFC 5545, however a brief description is mandatory
 542   // in MRBS.   So if the VEVENT didn't include a name, we'll give it one
 543   if (!isset($booking['name']) || ($booking['name']) === '')
 544   {
 545     $tag = 'import_no_SUMMARY';
 546     $booking['name'] = get_vocab($tag);
 547     // Throw an exception if it is still empty - probably because the vocab string has
 548     // been overridden in the config file by an empty string.
 549     if (!isset($booking['name']) || ($booking['name']) === '')
 550     {
 551       throw new Exception("Vocab string for '$tag' is empty");
 552     }
 553   }
 554 
 555   // LOCATION is optional in RFC 5545 but is obviously mandatory in MRBS.
 556   // If there is no LOCATION property we use the default_room specified on
 557   // the form, but if there is no default room (most likely because no rooms
 558   // have been created) then this error message is created).
 559   if (!isset($booking['room_id']))
 560   {
 561     $problems[] = get_vocab("no_LOCATION");
 562   }
 563 
 564   if (empty($problems))
 565   {
 566     // Get the area settings for this room, if we haven't got them already
 567     if (!isset($room_settings[$booking['room_id']]))
 568     {
 569       get_area_settings(get_area($booking['room_id']));
 570       $room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['morningstarts'] = $morningstarts;
 571       $room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['morningstarts_minutes'] = $morningstarts_minutes;
 572       $room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['resolution'] = $resolution;
 573     }
 574     // Round the start and end times to slot boundaries
 575     $date = getdate($booking['start_time']);
 576     $m = $date['mon'];
 577     $d = $date['mday'];
 578     $y = $date['year'];
 579     $am7 = mktime($room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['morningstarts'],
 580                   $room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['morningstarts_minutes'],
 581                   0, $m, $d, $y);
 582     $booking['start_time'] = round_t_down($booking['start_time'],
 583                                           $room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['resolution'],
 584                                           $am7);
 585     $booking['end_time'] = round_t_up($booking['end_time'],
 586                                       $room_settings[$booking['room_id']]['resolution'],
 587                                       $am7);
 588     // Make the bookings
 589     $bookings = array($booking);
 590     $result = mrbsMakeBookings($bookings, null, false, $skip);
 591 
 592     if ($result['valid_booking'])
 593     {
 594       // If the bookings been made then add the registrants
 595       add_registrants($result['new_details'][0]['id'], $registrants);
 596       return true;
 597     }
 598   }
 599   // There were problems - list them
 600   echo "<div class=\"problem_report\">\n";
 601   echo escape_html(get_vocab("could_not_import", $booking['name'], $booking['ical_uid']));
 602   echo "<ul>\n";
 603   foreach ($problems as $problem)
 604   {
 605     echo "<li>" . escape_html($problem) . "</li>\n";
 606   }
 607   if (!empty($result['violations']['errors']))
 608   {
 609     echo "<li>" . get_vocab("rules_broken") . "\n";
 610     echo "<ul>\n";
 611     foreach ($result['violations']['errors'] as $rule)
 612     {
 613       echo "<li>$rule</li>\n";
 614     }
 615     echo "</ul></li>\n";
 616   }
 617   if (!empty($result['conflicts']))
 618   {
 619     echo "<li>" . get_vocab("conflict"). "\n";
 620     echo "<ul>\n";
 621     foreach ($result['conflicts'] as $conflict)
 622     {
 623       echo "<li>$conflict</li>\n";
 624     }
 625     echo "</ul></li>\n";
 626   }
 627   echo "</ul>\n";
 628   echo "</div>\n";
 629 
 630   return false;
 631 }

 634 function get_file_details_url(string $file) : array
 635 {
 636   $files = array();
 637   list( , $tmp_name) = explode('://', $file, 2);
 638   $files[] = array('name'     => $file,
 639                    'tmp_name' => $tmp_name,
 640                    'size'     => null);
 641   return $files;
 642 }

 645 function get_file_details_calendar(array $file) : array
 646 {
 647   $files = array();
 648   $files[] = array('name'     => $file['name'],
 649                    'tmp_name' => $file['tmp_name'],
 650                    'size'     => filesize($file['tmp_name']));
 651   return $files;

 655 function get_file_details_bzip2(array $file) : array
 656 {
 657   // It's not possible to get the uncompressed size of a bzip2 file without first
 658   // decompressing the whole file
 659   $files = array();
 660   $files[] = array('name'     => $file['name'],
 661                    'tmp_name' => $file['tmp_name'],
 662                    'size'     => null);
 663   return $files;
 664 }
 665 
 666 function get_file_details_gzip(array $file) : array
 667 {
 668   // Get the uncompressed size of the gzip file which is stored in the last four
 669   // bytes of the file, little-endian
 670   if (false !== ($handle = fopen($file['tmp_name'], 'rb')))
 671   {
 672     fseek($handle, -4, SEEK_END);
 673     $buffer = fread($handle, 4);
 674     $size_array = unpack('V', $buffer);
 675     $size = end($size_array);
 676     fclose($handle);
 677   }
 678   else
 679   {
 680     $size = null;
 681   }
 682   $files = array();
 683   $files[] = array('name'     => $file['name'],
 684                    'tmp_name' => $file['tmp_name'],
 685                    'size'     => $size);
 686   return $files;
 687 }
 688 
 689 
 690 function get_file_details_zip(array $file) : array
 691 {
 692   $files = array();
 693 
 694   if (class_exists('ZipArchive'))
 695   {
 696     $zip = new ZipArchive();
 697 
 698     if (true === ($result = $zip->open($file['tmp_name'])))
 699     {
 700       for ($i=0; $i<$zip->numFiles; $i++)
 701       {
 702         $details = array();
 703         $stats = $zip->statIndex($i);
 704         $details['name']     = $stats['name'];
 705         $details['tmp_name'] = $file['tmp_name'] . '#' . $stats['name'];
 706         $details['size']     = $stats['size'];
 707         $files[] = $details;
 708       }
 709     }
 710     else
 711     {
 712       // Try and convert the error code into something a bit more
 713       // meaningful.
 714       //
 715       // It's safe to use ReflectionClass (PHP 5) as we already know that
 716       // ZipArchive (PHP 5.2.0) exists
 717       $reflection = new ReflectionClass('ZipArchive');
 718       $constants = $reflection->getConstants();
 719       foreach ($constants as $key => $value)
 720       {
 721         if (($result === $value) && (mb_strpos($key, 'ER_') === 0))
 722         {
 723           $error_code = $key;
 724           break;
 725         }
 726       }
 727       $message = "ZipArchive::open() failed with ";
 728       if (isset($error_code))
 729       {
 730         $message .= "error code $error_code.";
 731         // There is a problem on IIS when opening a ZipArchive file that is in
 732         // C:\Windows\Temp.   ER_OPEN will be returned unless the user IUSR_XXXX
 733         // has 'List Folder' permission.
 734         // See the user notes at http://php.net/manual/en/ziparchive.open.php
 735         // and also https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=54128
 736         if ($result == ZipArchive::ER_OPEN)
 737         {
 738           $message .= " If your server is running Windows, check the permissions on " .
 739                       dirname($file['tmp_name']) . ". 'List Folder' permission is required " .
 740                       "for user IUSR_XXXX.";
 741         }
 742       }
 743       else
 744       {
 745         $message .= "unknown error code '$result'";
 746       }
 747       trigger_error($message, E_USER_WARNING);
 748     }
 749   }
 750   else
 751   {
 752     trigger_error("Could not open zip archive - the ZipArchive class does not exist on this system", E_USER_WARNING);
 753   }
 754   return $files;
 755 }
 756 
 757 
 758 function get_details($file) : array
 759 {
 760   $result = array();
 761 
 762   if (is_string($file))
 763   {
 764     list($result['wrapper']) = explode('://', $file, 2);
 765     $result['files'] = get_file_details_url($file);
 766   }
 767   else
 768   {
 769     switch ($file['type'])
 770     {
 771       case 'text/calendar':
 772       case 'text/html':
 773       case 'text/plain':
 774       case 'application/x-download':
 775         $result['wrapper'] = 'file';
 776         $result['files'] = get_file_details_calendar($file);
 777         break;
 778       case 'application/x-bzip2':
 779         $result['wrapper'] = 'compress.bzip2';
 780         $result['files'] = get_file_details_bzip2($file);
 781         break;
 782       case 'application/x-gzip':
 783         $result['wrapper'] = 'compress.zlib';
 784         $result['files'] = get_file_details_gzip($file);
 785         break;
 786       case 'application/x-zip-compressed':
 787       case 'application/zip':
 788         $result['wrapper'] = 'zip';
 789         $result['files'] = get_file_details_zip($file);
 790         break;
 791       default:
 792         $result = false;
 793         trigger_error("Unknown file type '" . $file['type'] . "'", E_USER_NOTICE);
 794         break;
 795     }
 796   }
 797 
 798   return $result;
 799 }

1042 $import = get_form_var('import', 'string');
1043 $source_type = get_form_var('source_type', 'string', $default_import_source);
1044 $url = get_form_var('url', 'string');
1045 $import_default_room = get_form_var('import_default_room', 'int');
1046 $ignore_location = get_form_var('ignore_location', 'string', '0');
1047 $add_location = get_form_var('add_location', 'array');
1048 $area_room_order = get_form_var('area_room_order', 'string', 'area_room');
1049 $area_room_delimiter = get_form_var('area_room_delimiter', 'string', $default_area_room_delimiter);
1050 $area_room_create = get_form_var('area_room_create', 'string', '0');
1051 $import_default_type = get_form_var('import_default_type', 'string', $default_type);
1052 $import_past = get_form_var('import_past', 'string', ((empty($default_import_past)) ? '0' : '1'));
1053 $skip = get_form_var('skip', 'bool', empty($skip_default));
1054 
1055 // Check the CSRF token if we're being asked to import data
1056 if (!empty($import))
1057 {
1058   Form::checkToken();
1059 }
1060 
1061 // Check the user is authorised for this page
1062 checkAuthorised(this_page());
1063 
1064 $context = array(
1065   'view'      => $view,
1066   'view_all'  => $view_all,
1067   'year'      => $year,
1068   'month'     => $month,
1069   'day'       => $day,
1070   'area'      => $area,
1071   'room'      => $room ?? null
1072 );
1073 
1074 print_header($context);
1075 
1076 
1077 // PHASE 2 - Process the files
1078 // ---------------------------
1079 
1080 if (!empty($import))
1081 {
1082   if ($source_type == 'url')
1083   {
1084     if (!isset($url) || !filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL))
1085     {
1086       echo "<p>\n";
1087       echo get_vocab("invalid_url");
1088       echo "</p>\n";
1089     }
1090     else
1091     {
1092       $details = get_details($url);
1093     }
1094   }
1095   else
1096   {
1097     if (($_FILES['upload_file']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) ||
1098         !is_uploaded_file($_FILES['upload_file']['tmp_name']))
1099     {
1100       echo "<p>\n";
1101       echo get_vocab("upload_failed");
1102 
1103       if ($_FILES['upload_file']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK)
1104       {
1105         try
1106         {
1107           throw new UploadException($_FILES['upload_file']['error']);
1108         }
1109         catch (UploadException $e)
1110         {
1111           switch ($e->getCode())
1112           {
1113             case UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE:
1114             case UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE:
1115               echo "<br>\n" . get_vocab("max_allowed_file_size", ini_get('upload_max_filesize'));
1116               break;
1117             case UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE:
1118               echo "<br>\n" . get_vocab("no_file");
1119               break;
1120             default:
1121               // None of the other possible errors would make much sense to the user, but should be reported
1122               trigger_error($e->getMessage(), E_USER_WARNING);
1123               break;
1124           }
1125         }
1126       }
1127       // Check this last, as it will be true if there is an error
1128       elseif (!is_uploaded_file($_FILES['upload_file']['tmp_name']))
1129       {
1130         // This should not happen and if it does may mean that somebody is messing about
1131         trigger_error("Attempt to import a file that has not been uploaded", E_USER_WARNING);
1132       }
1133 
1134       echo "</p>\n";
1135     }
1136     else
1137     {
1138       // We've got a file
1139       $details = get_details($_FILES['upload_file']);
1140     }
1141   }
1142 
1143   if (isset($details))
1144   {
1145     if ($details === false)
1146     {
1147       echo "<p>" . get_vocab("could_not_process") . "</p>\n";
1148     }
1149     else
1150     {
1151       foreach ($details['files'] as $file)
1152       {
1153         echo "<h3>" . $file['name'] . "</h3>";
1154 
1155         $n_success = 0;
1156         $n_failure = 0;
1157 
1158         $handle = fopen($details['wrapper'] . '://' . $file['tmp_name'], 'rb');
1159 
1160         if ($handle === false)
1161         {
1162           echo "<p>" . get_vocab("could_not_process") . "</p>\n";
1163         }
1164         else
1165         {
1166           while (false !== ($vevent = get_event($handle)))
1167           {
1168             (process_event($vevent)) ? $n_success++ : $n_failure++;
1169           }
1170 
1171           fclose($handle);
1172 
1173           echo "<p>\n";
1174           echo "$n_success " . get_vocab("events_imported");
1175           if ($n_failure > 0)
1176           {
1177             echo "<br>\n$n_failure " . get_vocab("events_not_imported");
1178           }
1179           echo "</p>\n";
1180         }
1181       }
1182     }
1183   }
1184 }
1185 
1186 // PHASE 1 - Get the user input
1187 // ----------------------------
1188 
1189 echo "<h2>" . get_vocab('import_icalendar') . "</h2>\n";
1190 
1191 $compression_wrappers = get_compression_wrappers();
1192 
1193 echo "<p>\n" . get_vocab('import_intro') . "</p>\n";
1194 echo "<p>\n" . get_vocab('supported_file_types') . "</p>\n";
1195 echo "<ul>\n";
1196 echo "<li>" . $wrapper_descriptions['file'] . "</li>\n";
1197 foreach ($compression_wrappers as $compression_wrapper)
1198 {
1199   echo "<li>" . $wrapper_descriptions[$compression_wrapper] . "</li>\n";
1200 }
1201 echo "</ul>\n";
1202 
1203 $form = new Form(Form::METHOD_POST);
1204 
1205 $form->setAttributes(array('class'   => 'standard',
1206                            'enctype' => 'multipart/form-data',
1207                            'action'  => multisite(this_page())));
1208 
1209 $fieldset = new ElementFieldset();
1210 
1211 $fieldset->addElement(get_fieldset_source($compression_wrappers))
1212          ->addElement(get_fieldset_location_settings())
1213          ->addElement(get_fieldset_other_settings())
1214          ->addElement(get_fieldset_submit_button());
1215 
1216 $form->addElement($fieldset);
1217 
1218 $form->render();
1219 
1220 
1221 print_footer();

  56     $form = new Form();

  62                                  'page_date' => $page_date));

  91 function make_room_select_html (string $view, int $view_all, int $year, int $month, int $day, int $area, int $current) : string
  92 {
  93   global $multisite, $site, $always_offer_view_all;
  94 
  95   $out_html = '';
  96 
  97   $rooms = get_room_names($area);
  98   $n_rooms = count($rooms);
  99 
 100   if ($n_rooms > 0)
 101   {
 102     $page_date = format_iso_date($year, $month, $day);
 103     $options = $rooms;
 104 
 105     // If we are in the week, month or year views and there is more than one room, then add the 'all'
 106     // option to the room select, which allows the user to display all rooms in the view.
 107     // And if we are viewing all the rooms then make sure the current room is negative.
 108     // (The room select uses a negative value of $room to signify that we want to view all
 109     // rooms in an area.   The absolute value of $room is the current room.)
 110     if (in_array($view, array('week', 'month', 'year')) && ($always_offer_view_all || ($n_rooms > 1)))
 111     {
 112       $all = -abs($current);
 113       if ($view_all)
 114       {
 115         $current = -abs($current);
 116       }
 117       $options = array($all => get_vocab('all')) + $options;
 118     }
 119 
 120     $form = new Form();
 121 
 122     $form->setAttributes(array('class'  => 'roomChangeForm',
 123                                'action' => multisite(this_page())));
 124 
 125     $form->addHiddenInputs(array('view'      => $view,
 126                                  'view_all'  => 0,
 127                                  'page_date' => $page_date,
 128                                  'area'      => $area));
 129 
 130     if ($multisite && isset($site) && ($site !== ''))
 131     {
 132       $form->addHiddenInput('site', $site);
 133     }
 134 
 135     $select = new ElementSelect();
 136     $select->setAttributes(array('class'      => 'room_area_select',
 137                                  'name'       => 'room',
 138                                  'disabled'   => is_kiosk_mode(),
 139                                  'aria-label' => get_vocab('select_room'),
 140                                  'onchange'   => 'this.form.submit()'))
 141            ->addSelectOptions($options, $current, true);
 142     $form->addElement($select);
 143 
 144     // Note:  the submit button will not be displayed if JavaScript is enabled
 145     $submit = new ElementInputSubmit();
 146     $submit->setAttributes(array('class' => 'js_none',
 147                                  'value' => get_vocab('change')));
 148     $form->addElement($submit);
 149 
 150     $out_html .= $form->toHTML();
 151   }
 152 
 153   return $out_html;
 154 } // end make_room_select_html

 158 // Gets the link to the next/previous day/week/month
 159 function get_adjacent_link(string $view, int $view_all, int $year, int $month, int $day, int $area, int $room, int $increment) : string
 160 {
 161   $date = new DateTime();
 162   $date->setDate($year, $month, $day);
 163 
 164   switch ($view)
 165   {
 166     case 'day':
 167       $modifier = "$increment day";
 168       $date->modify($modifier);
 169       // find the next non-hidden day
 170       $i = 0;
 171       while ($date->isHiddenDay() && ($i < DAYS_PER_WEEK)) // break the loop if all days are hidden
 172       {
 173         $i++;
 174         $date->modify($modifier);
 175       }
 176       break;
 177     case 'week':
 178       $modifier = "$increment week";
 179       $date->modify($modifier);
 180       break;
 181     case 'month':
 182       $date->modifyMonthsNoOverflow($increment);
 183       break;
 184     case 'year':
 185       $date->modifyYearsNoOverflow($increment);
 186       break;
 187     default:
 188       throw new \Exception("Unknown view '$view'");
 189       break;
 190   }
 191 
 192   $vars = array('view'      => $view,
 193                 'view_all'  => $view_all,
 194                 'page_date' => $date->getISODate(),
 195                 'area'      => $area,
 196                 'room'      => $room);
 197 
 198   return multisite('index.php?' . http_build_query($vars, '', '&'));
 199 }

 202 // Gets the link for today
 203 function get_today_link(string $view, int $view_all, int $area, int $room) : string
 204 {
 205   // Don't include a date in order to make sure that the link will result in the current
 206   // day at the time it is clicked, not the time the page was loaded (which might have been
 207   // a few days ago.
 208   $vars = array('view'      => $view,
 209                 'view_all'  => $view_all,
 210                 'area'      => $area,
 211                 'room'      => $room);
 212 
 213   return multisite('index.php?' . http_build_query($vars, '', '&'));

 217 function get_location_nav(string $view, int $view_all, int $year, int $month, int $day, int $area, int $room) : string

 221   $html .= "<nav class=\"location js_hidden\">\n";  // JavaScript will show it

 235 function get_view_nav(string $current_view, int $view_all, int $year, int $month, int $day, int $area, int $room) : string
 236 {
 237   global $max_slots_for_year_view;
 238 
 239   $html = '';
 240 
 241   $html .= '<nav class="view">';
 242   $html .= '<div class="container">';  // helps the CSS
 243 
 244   $views = [
 245     'day' => 'nav_day',
 246     'week' => 'nav_week',
 247     'month' => 'nav_month'
 248   ];
 249 
 250   if (Calendar::getNTimeSlots() <= $max_slots_for_year_view)
 251   {
 252     $views['year'] = 'nav_year';
 253   }
 254 
 255   foreach ($views as $view => $token)
 256   {
 257     $this_view_all = $view_all ?? 1;
 258 
 259     $vars = array('view'      => $view,
 260                   'view_all'  => $this_view_all,
 261                   'page_date' => format_iso_date($year, $month, $day),
 262                   'area'      => $area,
 263                   'room'      => $room);
 264 
 265     $query = http_build_query($vars, '', '&');
 266     $href = multisite("index.php?$query");
 267     $classes = [$view];
 268     if ($view == $current_view)
 269     {
 270       $classes[] = 'selected';
 271     }
 272     $html .= '<a class="' . implode(' ', $classes) . '"';
 273     $html .= ' href="' . escape_html($href) . '">' . escape_html(get_vocab($token)) . '</a>';
 274   }
 275 
 276   $html .= '</div>';
 277   $html .= '</nav>';
 278 
 279   return $html;
 280 }

 283 function get_arrow_nav(string $view, int $view_all, int $year, int $month, int $day, int $area, int $room) : string
 284 {
 285   $html = '';
 286 
 287   switch ($view)
 288   {
 289     case 'day':
 290       $title_prev = get_vocab('daybefore');
 291       $title_this = get_vocab('gototoday');
 292       $title_next = get_vocab('dayafter');
 293       $title_prev_week = get_vocab('weekbefore');
 294       $title_next_week = get_vocab('weekafter');
 295       $link_prev_week = get_adjacent_link($view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, $room, -7);
 296       $link_next_week = get_adjacent_link($view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, $room, +7);
 297       break;
 298     case 'week':
 299       $title_prev = get_vocab('weekbefore');
 300       $title_this = get_vocab('gotothisweek');
 301       $title_next = get_vocab('weekafter');
 302       break;
 303     case 'month':
 304       $title_prev = get_vocab('monthbefore');
 305       $title_this = get_vocab('gotothismonth');
 306       $title_next = get_vocab('monthafter');
 307       break;
 308     case 'year':
 309       $title_prev = get_vocab('yearbefore');
 310       $title_this = get_vocab('gotothisyear');
 311       $title_next = get_vocab('yearafter');
 312       break;
 313     default:
 314       throw new \Exception("Unknown view '$view'");
 315       break;
 316   }
 317 
 318   $title_prev = escape_html($title_prev);
 319   $title_next = escape_html($title_next);
 320 
 321   $link_prev = get_adjacent_link($view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, $room, -1);
 322   $link_today = get_today_link($view, $view_all, $area, $room);
 323   $link_next = get_adjacent_link($view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, $room, 1);
 324 
 325   // For the day view we also offer buttons to go back/forward by one week.
 326   // The links without any text have their content filled by CSS.
 327   $html .= "<nav class=\"arrow\">\n";
 328   if ($view == 'day')
 329   {
 330     $html .= "<a class=\"prev week symbol prefetch\" title=\"$title_prev_week\" aria-label=\"$title_prev_week\" href=\"" . escape_html($link_prev_week) . "\"></a>";
 331   }
 332   $html .= "<a class=\"prev symbol prefetch\" title=\"$title_prev\" aria-label=\"$title_prev\" href=\"" . escape_html($link_prev) . "\"></a>";
 333   $html .= "<a title= \"$title_this\" aria-label=\"$title_this\" href=\"" . escape_html($link_today) . "\">" . get_vocab("now_$view") . "</a>";
 334   $html .= "<a class=\"next symbol prefetch\" title=\"$title_next\" aria-label=\"$title_next\" href=\"" . escape_html($link_next) . "\"></a>";
 335   if ($view == 'day')
 336   {
 337     $html .= "<a class=\"next week symbol prefetch\" title=\"$title_next_week\" aria-label=\"$title_next_week\" href=\"" . escape_html($link_next_week) . "\"></a>";
 338   }
 339   $html .= "</nav>";
 340 
 341   return $html;
 342 }

 345 function get_calendar_nav(string $view, int $view_all, int $year, int $month, int $day, int $area, int $room, bool $hidden=false) : string
 346 {
 347   $html = '';

 349   $html .= "<nav class=\"main_calendar" .
 350            (($hidden) ? ' js_hidden' : '') .
 351            "\">\n";

 355   $html .= get_view_nav($view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, $room);
 356 
 357   $html .= "</nav>\n";
 358 
 359   return $html;
