   1 <?php
   2 declare(strict_types=1);
   3 namespace MRBS;
   4 
   5 use Defuse\Crypto\Crypto;
   6 use Defuse\Crypto\Exception\WrongKeyOrModifiedCiphertextException;
   7 use Defuse\Crypto\Key;
   8 use MRBS\DB\DBException;
   9 use PDOException;
  10 use SessionHandlerInterface;
  11 use SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface;
  12 
  13 // Suppress deprecation notices until we get to requiring at least PHP 8
  14 // because union types, needed for the return types of read() and gc(), are
  15 // not supported in PHP 7.  Using the #[\ReturnTypeWillChange] attribute
  16 // does not help because that was only introduced in PHP 8.1.
  17 if (version_compare(MRBS_MIN_PHP_VERSION, '8.0.0') < 0)
  18 {
  19   $old_level = error_reporting();
  20   error_reporting($old_level & ~E_DEPRECATED);
  21 }
  22 else
  23 {
  24   trigger_error("This code can now be removed", E_USER_NOTICE);
  25 }
  26 
  27 // Use our own PHP session handling by storing sessions in the database.   This has three advantages:
  28 //    (a) it's more secure, especially on shared servers
  29 //    (b) it avoids problems with ordinary sessions not working because the PHP session save
  30 //        directory is not writable
  31 //    (c) it's more resilient in clustered environments
  32 //
  33 // The class also encrypts the session data, using a random key which is stored in a cookie (based on
  34 // https://github.com/ezimuel/PHP-Secure-Session).
  35 
  36 class SessionHandlerDb implements SessionHandlerInterface, SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface
  37 {
  38   private const KEY_COOKIE_PREFIX = 'KEY_';
  39 
  40   private $key;
  41   private static $table;
  42 
  43   public function __construct()
  44   {
  45     self::$table = _tbl('sessions');
  46 
  47     // We need to lock the session data while it is in use in order to prevent problems
  48     // with Ajax calls.  This happens with the default file session handler, but
  49     // in order to provide it with the DB session handler we need the ability to set multiple locks.
  50     if (!db()->supportsMultipleLocks())
  51     {
  52       throw new SessionHandlerDbException(
  53           "MRBS: database does not support multiple locks.",
  54           SessionHandlerDbException::NO_MULTIPLE_LOCKS
  55         );
  56 
  57     }
  58 
  59     if (!db()->table_exists(self::$table))
  60     {
  61       // We throw an exception if the table doesn't exist rather than returning FALSE, because in some
  62       // versions of PHP, eg 7.0.25, session_start() will throw a fatal error if it can't open
  63       // a session, rather than just returning FALSE as the documentation seems to suggest.   So
  64       // when a new SessionHandlerDb object is created we do it in a try/catch block.  [Note that
  65       // the exception can't be thrown on open() because a try/catch round session_start() won't
  66       // catch the exception - maybe because open() is a callback function??]
  67       throw new SessionHandlerDbException(
  68           "MRBS: session table does not exist",
  69           SessionHandlerDbException::TABLE_NOT_EXISTS
  70         );
  71     }
  72   }
  73 
  74   // The return value (usually TRUE on success, FALSE on failure). Note this value is
  75   // returned internally to PHP for processing.
  76   public function open($path, $name): bool
  77   {
  78     try {
  79       $this->key = $this->getKey(self::KEY_COOKIE_PREFIX . $name);
  80     }
  81     catch (\Exception $e) {
  82       trigger_error("Failed to get key: " . $e->getMessage(), E_USER_WARNING);
  83       // The message below is sometimes seen. Log the key cookie value.  It's usually because the cookie value is
  84       // 'deleted'.  This is because, as the PHP manual says in https://www.php.net/manual/en/function.setcookie.php,
  85       // "Cookies must be deleted with the same parameters as they were set with. If the value argument is an empty
  86       // string, and all other arguments match a previous call to setcookie(), then the cookie with the specified name
  87       // will be deleted from the remote client. This is internally achieved by setting value to 'deleted' and
  88       // expiration time in the past."
  89       // However it's not clear why the cookie is being read, given that it has been deleted.   And as it is being read
  90       // can we do some kind of retry and set the key cookie with a proper key so that session_start() does not fail?
  91       if (str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'Encoding::hexToBin() input is not a hex string'))
  92       {
  93         $key_cookie = $_COOKIE[self::KEY_COOKIE_PREFIX . $name];
  94         trigger_error("Key cookie: $key_cookie");
  95       }
  96       return false;
  97     }
  98 
  99     return true;
 100   }
 101 
 102 
 103   // The return value (usually TRUE on success, FALSE on failure). Note this value is
 104   // returned internally to PHP for processing.
 105   public function close(): bool
 106   {
 107     return true;
 108   }
 109 
 110 
 111   // Returns an encoded string of the read data. If nothing was read, it must
 112   // return an empty string. Note this value is returned internally to PHP for
 113   // processing.
 114   public function read($id)
 115   {
 116     global $dbsys;
 117 
 118     // Acquire mutex to lock the session id.  When using the default file session handler
 119     // locks are obtained using flock().  We need to do something similar in order to prevent
 120     // problems with multiple Ajax requests writing to the S_SESSION variable while
 121     // another process is still using it.
 122     // Acquire a lock
 123     if (!db()->mutex_lock($id))
 124     {
 125       trigger_error("Failed to acquire a lock", E_USER_WARNING);
 126       return '';
 127     }
 128 
 129     try
 130     {
 131       $sql = "SELECT data
 132                 FROM " . self::$table . "
 133                WHERE id=:id
 134                LIMIT 1";
 135 
 136       $result = db()->query_scalar_non_bool($sql, array(':id' => $id));
 137     }
 138     catch (DBException $e)
 139     {
 140       // If the exception is because the sessions table doesn't exist, then that's
 141       // probably because we're in the middle of the upgrade that creates the
 142       // sessions table, so just ignore it and return ''.   Otherwise, re-throw
 143       // the exception.
 144       if (!db()->table_exists(self::$table))
 145       {
 146         return '';
 147       }
 148       throw $e;
 149     }
 150 
 151     if (!isset($result) || ($result === false))
 152     {
 153       return '';
 154     }
 155 
 156     // TODO: fix this properly
 157     // In PostgreSQL we store the session base64 encoded.  That's because the session data string (encoded by PHP)
 158     // can contain NULL bytes when the User object has protected properties.  The solution is probably to convert
 159     // the data column in PostgreSQL to be bytea rather than text.  However this doesn't seem to work for some reason -
 160     // no doubt soluble - and also upgrading the database is complicated while the roles branch is still under
 161     // development and there are two sets of upgrades to be merged.  So for the moment we have this rather inelegant
 162     // workaround.
 163     // NOTE: this step is probably not necessary anymore, now that the session data is encrypted.
 164     if ($dbsys == 'pgsql')
 165     {
 166       $decoded = base64_decode($result, true);
 167       // Test to see if the data is base64 encoded so that we can handle session data written before this change.
 168       if (($decoded !== false) && (base64_encode($decoded) === $result))
 169       {
 170         $result = $decoded;
 171       }
 172     }
 173 
 174     try {
 175       $result = Crypto::decrypt($result, $this->key);
 176     }
 177     catch (WrongKeyOrModifiedCiphertextException $e) {
 178       $message = $e->getMessage();
 179       if (!str_contains($message, 'Ciphertext has invalid hex encoding'))
 180       {
 181         // This exception can be caused by (1) the wrong key being used, or (2) the cipher text having
 182         // been modified or truncated.  The message will generally be "Integrity check failed".  None
 183         // of these should normally happen.  If the cipher text has been truncated, because it was too
 184         // long for the database column, then we should have seen an SQL error when the session data
 185         // was written.
 186         trigger_error(get_class($e) . ': ' . $message, E_USER_WARNING);
 187         $result = '';
 188       }
 189       // Otherwise do nothing.  This is to handle the case where we are reading old session data before
 190       // encryption was introduced, when the session data will almost certainly contain non-hex characters.
 191       // So just return the undecrypted data from the database (because it was never encrypted in the first
 192       // place).
 193     }
 194     catch (\Exception $e) {
 195       trigger_error("Failed to decrypt session data: " . $e->getMessage(), E_USER_WARNING);
 196       $result = '';
 197     }
 198 
 199     return $result;
 200   }
 201 
 202 
 203   // The return value (usually TRUE on success, FALSE on failure). Note this value is
 204   // returned internally to PHP for processing.
 205   public function write($id, $data): bool
 206   {
 207     global $dbsys;
 208 
 209     try {
 210       $data = Crypto::encrypt($data, $this->key);
 211     }
 212     catch (\Exception $e) {
 213       trigger_error("Failed to encrypt session data: " . $e->getMessage(), E_USER_WARNING);
 214       return false;
 215     }
 216 
 217     // See comment in read()
 218     if ($dbsys == 'pgsql')
 219     {
 220       $data = base64_encode($data);
 221     }
 222 
 223     $query_data = array(
 224       'id' => $id,
 225       'data' => $data,
 226       'access' => time()
 227     );
 228 
 229     $sql_params = array();
 230     $sql = db()->syntax_upsert($query_data, self::$table, $sql_params, 'id');
 231 
 232     // From the MySQL manual:
 233     // "With ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, the affected-rows value per row is 1 if the row is inserted as a
 234     // new row, 2 if an existing row is updated, and 0 if an existing row is set to its current values.
 235     // If you specify the CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS flag to the mysql_real_connect() C API function when connecting
 236     // to mysqld, the affected-rows value is 1 (not 0) if an existing row is set to its current values."
 237     return (0 < db()->command($sql, $sql_params));
 238   }
 239 
 240 
 241   // The return value (usually TRUE on success, FALSE on failure). Note this value is
 242   // returned internally to PHP for processing.
 243   public function destroy($id): bool
 244   {
 245     try
 246     {
 247       $sql = "DELETE FROM " . self::$table . " WHERE id=:id";
 248       db()->command($sql, array(':id' => $id));
 249       return true;
 250     }
 251     catch (\Exception $e)
 252     {
 253       return false;
 254     }
 255   }
 256 
 257 
 258   // The return value (usually TRUE on success, FALSE on failure). Note this value is
 259   // returned internally to PHP for processing.
 260   public function gc($max_lifetime)
 261   {
 262     $sql = "DELETE FROM " . self::$table . " WHERE access<:old";
 263     db()->command($sql, array(':old' => time() - $max_lifetime));
 264     return true;  // An exception will be thrown on error
 265   }
 266 
 267 
 268   // Need to provide this method to circumvent a bug in some versions of PHP.
 269   // See https://github.com/php/php-src/issues/9668
 270   public function validateId($id) : bool
 271   {
 272     // Acquire a lock
 273     if (!db()->mutex_lock($id))
 274     {
 275       trigger_error("Failed to acquire a lock", E_USER_WARNING);
 276       return false;
 277     }
 278 
 279     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*)
 280               FROM " . self::$table . "
 281              WHERE id=:id
 282              LIMIT 1";
 283 
 284     return (db()->query1($sql, array(':id' => $id)) == 1);
 285   }
 286 
 287 
 288   // We only need to provide this method because it's part of SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface
 289   // which we are implementing in order to provide validateId().
 290   public function updateTimestamp($id, $data) : bool
 291   {
 292     // Acquire a lock
 293     if (!db()->mutex_lock($id))
 294     {
 295       trigger_error("Failed to acquire a lock", E_USER_WARNING);
 296       return false;
 297     }
 298 
 299     try
 300     {
 301       $sql = "UPDATE " . self::$table . "
 302                  SET access=:access
 303                WHERE id=:id";
 304 
 305       $sql_params = array(
 306           ':id' => $id,
 307           ':access' => time()
 308         );
 309 
 310       $result = (1 === db()->command($sql, $sql_params));
 311     }
 312     catch(PDOException $e)
 313     {
 314       trigger_error($e->getMessage(), E_USER_WARNING);
 315       $result = false;
 316     }
 317 
 318     // Release the mutex lock
 319     db()->mutex_unlock($id);
 320 
 321     return $result;
 322   }
 323 
 324 
 325   // Delete the key cookie, but only if the expiry is not zero.
 326   public static function deleteKeyCookie() : void
 327   {
 328     if (false === ($name = session_name()))
 329     {
 330       return;
 331     }
 332 
 333     if (session_get_cookie_params()['lifetime'] !== 0)
 334     {
 335       $name = self::KEY_COOKIE_PREFIX . $name;
 336       unset($_COOKIE[$name]);
 337       self::setKeyCookie($name, '', time() - 42000);
 338     }
 339   }
 340 
 341 
 342   // Regenerate the key cookie, setting its expiry to be the same as the session cookie's.
 343   public static function regenerateKeyCookie() : void
 344   {
 345     // No need to do anything if we can't get a session name, or if the expiry is zero (browser close).
 346     if ((false === ($name = session_name())) || (0 === ($session_lifetime = session_get_cookie_params()['lifetime'])))
 347     {
 348       return;
 349     }
 350 
 351     // And no need to do anything if we can't get a cookie value.
 352     $name = self::KEY_COOKIE_PREFIX . $name;
 353     if (!isset($_COOKIE[$name]))
 354     {
 355       return;
 356     }
 357 
 358     // But otherwise, set the key cookie lifetime to be the same as the session cookie's.
 359     self::setKeyCookie($name, $_COOKIE[$name], time() + $session_lifetime);
 360   }
 361 
 362 
 363   private static function setKeyCookie(string $name, string $value, int $expires) : void
 364   {
 365     // Use the same cookie params as for the session cookie.
 366     $cookie_params = session_get_cookie_params();
 367     assert(version_compare(MRBS_MIN_PHP_VERSION, '7.3.0', '<'), "The else block can be removed.");
 368     if (version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '7.3.0', '>='))
 369     {
 370       // The new way, allowing 'samesite' to be set
 371       setcookie($name, $value, [
 372         'expires' => $expires,
 373         'path' => $cookie_params['path'],
 374         'domain' => $cookie_params['domain'],
 375         'secure' => $cookie_params['secure'],
 376         'httponly' => $cookie_params['httponly'],
 377         'samesite' => $cookie_params['samesite']
 378       ]);
 379     }
 380     else
 381     {
 382       // The old way.  'samesite' wasn't available until PHP 7.3.0.
 383       setcookie(
 384         $name,
 385         $value,
 386         $expires,
 387         $cookie_params['path'],
 388         $cookie_params['domain'],
 389         $cookie_params['secure'],
 390         $cookie_params['httponly']
 391       );
 392     }
 393   }
 394 
 395 
 396   private function getKey(string $name) : Key
 397   {
 398     // Get the key from the cookie, or if there isn't one create a random key and
 399     // store it in the cookie.
 400     if (empty($_COOKIE[$name]))
 401     {
 402       $key = Key::createNewRandomKey();
 403       $ascii_key = $key->saveToAsciiSafeString();
 404       $session_lifetime = session_get_cookie_params()['lifetime'];
 405       // Set the expiry to be the same as the session cookie expiry, or else 0 for browser close
 406       self::setKeyCookie($name, $ascii_key, ($session_lifetime > 0) ? time() + $session_lifetime : 0);
 407       $_COOKIE[$name] = $ascii_key;
 408     }
 409     else
 410     {
 411       $key = Key::loadFromAsciiSafeString($_COOKIE[$name]);
 412     }
 413 
 414     return $key;
 415   }
 416 
 417 }
 418 
 419 
 420 // Restore the original error reporting level
 421 if (version_compare(MRBS_MIN_PHP_VERSION, '8.0.0') < 0)
 422 {
 423   error_reporting($old_level);
 424 }
 425 else
 426 {
 427   trigger_error("This code can now be removed", E_USER_NOTICE);
 428 }

 867   // Works out whether the machine architecture is little-endian or big-endian
 868   public static function getEndianness() : int
 869   {
 870     static $result;
 871 
 872     if (!isset($result))
 873     {
 874       $testint = 0x00FF;
 875       $p = pack('S', $testint);
 876       $result = ($testint===current(unpack('v', $p))) ? self::LITTLE_ENDIAN : self::BIG_ENDIAN;
 877     }
 878 
 879     return $result;
 880   }
 881 
 882   public static function getServerOS() : string
 883   {
 884     static $server_os = null;
 885 
 886     if (!isset($server_os))
 887     {
 888       if (stristr(PHP_OS,'Darwin'))
 889       {
 890         $server_os = 'macosx';
 891       }
 892       elseif (stristr(PHP_OS, 'WIN'))
 893       {
 894         $server_os = 'windows';
 895       }
 896       elseif (stristr(PHP_OS, 'Linux'))
 897       {
 898         $server_os = 'linux';
 899       }
 900       elseif (stristr(PHP_OS, 'BSD'))
 901       {
 902         $server_os = 'bsd';
 903       }
 904       elseif (stristr(PHP_OS, 'SunOS'))
 905       {
 906         $server_os = 'sunos';
 907       }
 908       elseif (stristr(PHP_OS, 'AIX'))
 909       {
 910         $server_os = 'aix';

 912       else
 913       {
 914         $server_os = 'unsupported';
 915       }
 916     }
 917 
 918     return $server_os;

 922   // Returns information about the operating system PHP is running on
 923   public static function info() : string
 924   {

 926     if (in_array('php_uname', explode(',', ini_get('disable_functions'))))
 927     {
 928       return PHP_OS;
 929     }
 930     return php_uname();

 933   // Checks whether $langtag is advertised as being available on this system
 934   private static function isAdvertisedLocale(string $langtag) : bool
 935   {
 936     if (!class_exists('\\ResourceBundle'))
 937     {
 938       // Could try using locale -a but that requires exec() which is not
 939       // available on most systems.
 940       // Could also use IntlCalendar::getAvailableLocales(), but that needs
 941       // the intl extension, just like ResourceBundle::getLocales().
 942       return false;
 943     }
 944 
 945     // Get the available locales
 946     $locales = ResourceBundle::getLocales('');
 947     // Put our locale into PHP's format
 948     $locale = Locale::composeLocale(Locale::parseLocale($langtag));
 949     // See whether our locale exists.   Note that if it does we return the original
 950     // $langtag, which will be in BCP 47 format, rather than the locale in PHP's
 951     // format.  Although PHP will give you locales with underscores, when you try
 952     // and set them you need hyphens!
 953     return in_array($locale, $locales);
 954   }

 957   // Checks whether $langtag, which is in BCP 47 format, is available on this system
 958   public static function isAvailableLocale(string $langtag) : bool
 959   {
 960     // If the OS tells us it's available, then that's enough
 961     if (self::isAdvertisedLocale($langtag))
 962     {
 963       return true;
 964     }
 965 
 966     // Otherwise try setting the locale
 967     if (self::testLocale($langtag))
 968     {
 969       return true;
 970     }
 971 
 972     // If that didn't work then we might just be running on a very old OS that does
 973     // things differently
 974     $server_os = self::getServerOS();
 975 
 976     // Windows systems
 977     if ($server_os == "windows")
 978     {
 979       $langtag_lower = mb_strtolower($langtag);
 980       if (!isset(self::$lang_map_windows[$langtag_lower]))
 981       {
 982         return false;
 983       }
 984       $locale = self::$lang_map_windows[$langtag_lower];
 985     }
 986     // All of these Unix OSes work in mostly the same way...
 987     elseif (in_array($server_os, array('linux', 'sunos', 'bsd', 'aix', 'macosx')))
 988     {
 989       // Construct the locale name
 990       if (strlen($langtag) == 2)
 991       {
 992         if (isset(self::$lang_map_unix[$langtag]) && (self::$lang_map_unix[$langtag]))
 993         {
 994           $locale = self::$lang_map_unix[$langtag];
 995         }
 996         else
 997         {
 998           // Convert locale=xx to xx_XX
 999           $locale = mb_strtolower($langtag) . "-" . mb_strtoupper($langtag);
1000         }
1001       }
1002       else
1003       {
1004         $locale = $langtag;
1005       }
1006     }
1007     // Unsupported OS
1008     else
1009     {
1010       return false;
1011     }
1012 
1013     // Then test it
1014     return self::testLocale($locale);
1015   }
1016

1018   // Add a codeset suffix to $locale
1019   private static function addCodeset(string $locale) : string
1020   {
1021     $server_os = self::getServerOS();
1022 
1023     switch ($server_os)
1024     {
1025       case 'sunos':
1026       case 'linux':
1027       case 'bsd':
1028         $codeset = '.UTF-8';
1029         break;
1030 
1031       case 'macosx':
1032       case 'windows':
1033         $codeset = '.utf-8';
1034         break;
1035 
1036       default:
1037         $codeset = '';
1038         break;
1039     }
1040 
1041     return $locale . $codeset;
1042   }

1045   // Returns an array of locales in the correct format for the server OS given
1046   // a BCP 47 language tag.  There is an array of locales to try because some
1047   // operating systems and versions accept locales with underscores, some with
1048   // hyphens and some as special codes.
1049   public static function getOSlocale(string $langtag) : array
1050   {
1051     $locales = self::getLocaleAlternatives($langtag);
1052 
1053     // Add on a codeset [is this still necessary??]
1054     $locales = array_map(self::class . '::addCodeset', $locales);
1055 
1056     return $locales;
1057   }

1060   // The inverse of getOSlocale.  Turns an OS-specific locale into a BCP 47 style
1061   // language tag.    This is provided for backwards compatibility with old versions
1062   // of MRBS where the $override_locale config setting was required to be operating
1063   // system specific (eg 'en_GB.utf-8' on Unix systems or 'eng' on Windows).  Now
1064   // $override_locale should be in BCP 47 format, but we accept old-style settings.
1065   public static function getBCPlocale(string $locale) : string
1066   {
1067     $result = $locale;
1068 
1069     // Strip anything like '.utf-8' off the end
1070     if (mb_strpos($result, '.') !== false)
1071     {
1072       $result = strstr($locale, '.', true);
1073     }
1074 
1075     // Convert an old style Windows locale, eg 'eng' to a BCP 47 one, eg 'en-gb'
1076     if ((self::getServerOS() == 'windows') && in_array($result, self::$lang_map_windows))
1077     {
1078       $result = array_search($result, self::$lang_map_windows);
1079     }
1080 
1081     // Parse it and then recompose it.  This will get the capitalisation correct, eg
1082     // "sr-Latn-RS".  Note though that BCP 47 language tags are case insensitive and
1083     // the capitalisation is just a convention.
1084     $result = Locale::composeLocale(Locale::parseLocale($result));
1085 
1086     // Convert underscores to hyphens.  Locale::composeLocale() returns underscores.
1087     $result = str_replace('_', '-', $result);
1088 
1089     return $result;
1090   }

1093   public static function utf8ConvertFromLocale(string $string, ?string $locale=null) : string
1094   {
1095     $server_os = self::getServerOS();
1096 
1097     if ($server_os == 'windows')
1098     {
1099       if (!isset($locale))
1100       {
1101         $locale = get_mrbs_locale();
1102       }
1103 
1104       $locale = mb_strtolower($locale);
1105 
1106       if (isset(self::$lang_map_windows[$locale]) &&
1107           array_key_exists(self::$lang_map_windows[$locale], self::$winlocale_codepage_map))
1108       {
1109         $from_encoding = self::$winlocale_codepage_map[self::$lang_map_windows[$locale]];
1110         $to_encoding = 'utf-8';
1111         $string = iconv($from_encoding, $to_encoding, $string);
1112         if ($string === false)
1113         {
1114           $message = "iconv() failed converting from '$from_encoding' to '$to_encoding'";
1115           throw new Exception($message);
1116         }
1117       }
1118     }
1119     else if ($server_os == 'aix')
1120     {
1121       $string = self::utf8ConvertAix($string, $locale);
1122     }
1123     return $string;
1124   }

1126 
1127   private static function getLocaleAlternatives(string $langtag) : array
1128   {
1129     $locales = array();
1130 
1131     // Put the $langtag into standard PHP format
1132     $subtags = Locale::parseLocale($langtag);
1133 
1134     if (!empty($subtags))
1135     {
1136       $locale = Locale::composeLocale($subtags);
1137 
1138       // First locale to try is one with hyphens instead of underscores.  These work on newer
1139       // Windows systems, whereas underscores do not.  Also, on Windows systems, although
1140       // setlocale will succeed with, for example, both 'en_GB' and 'en-GB', only 'en-GB' (and
1141       // indeed 'eng') will give the date in the correct format when using strftime('%x').
1142       $locales[] = str_replace('_', '-', $locale);
1143 
1144       // Next locale to try is a PHP style locale, ie with underscores
1145       // Make sure we haven't already got it
1146       if (!in_array($locale, $locales))
1147       {
1148         $locales[] = $locale;
1149       }
1150 
1151       if (self::getServerOS() == 'windows')
1152       {
1153         // Add in the three-letter code if any as a last resort
1154         if (isset(self::$lang_map_windows[mb_strtolower($langtag)]))
1155         {
1156           $locales[] = self::$lang_map_windows[mb_strtolower($langtag)];
1157         }
1158       }
1159 
1160       // If there isn't a region specified then add one, because on some systems
1161       // setlocale(LC_ALL, 'en'), for example, doesn't work, even though 'en' seems
1162       // to be an available locale.
1163       if (!isset($subtags['region']))
1164       {
1165         $subtags['region'] = self::getDefaultRegion($subtags['language']);
1166         if (isset($subtags['region']))  // avoid an infinite recursion
1167         {
1168           $locales = array_merge($locales, self::getLocaleAlternatives(Locale::composeLocale($subtags)));
1169         }
1170       }
1171     }
1172 
1173     return $locales;
1174   }
1175 
1176 
1177   // Returns the default region for a language
1178   private static function getDefaultRegion(string $language) : string
1179   {
1180     if (isset(self::$default_regions[$language]))
1181     {
1182       return self::$default_regions[$language];
1183     }
1184 
1185     return mb_strtoupper($language);
1186   }
1187

1189   // AIX version of utf8_convert(); needed as locales won't give us UTF-8
1190   // NOTE: Should ONLY be called with input encoded in the default code set of the current locale!
1191   // NOTE: Uses the LC_TIME category for determining the current locale setting, so should preferably be used on date/time input only!
1192   private static function utf8ConvertAix(string $string, ?string $aix_locale=null) : string
1193   {
1194     if (!isset($aix_locale))
1195     {
1196       // Retrieve current locale setting
1197       $aix_locale = setlocale(LC_TIME, '0');
1198     }
1199 
1200     if ($aix_locale === false)
1201     {
1202       // Locale setting could not be retrieved; return string unchanged
1203       return $string;
1204     }
1205 
1206     if (!array_key_exists($aix_locale, self::$aixlocale_codepage_map))
1207     {
1208       // Default code page of locale could not be found; return string unchanged
1209       return $string;
1210     }
1211 
1212     $aix_codepage = self::$aixlocale_codepage_map[$aix_locale];
1213 
1214     if (!in_array($aix_codepage, self::$aix_utf8_converters, true))
1215     {
1216       // No suitable UTF-8 converter was found for this code page; return string unchanged
1217       return $string;
1218     }
1219 
1220     // Convert string to UTF-8
1221     $from_encoding = $aix_codepage;
1222     $to_encoding = 'UTF-8';
1223     $string = iconv($from_encoding, $to_encoding, $string);
1224     if ($string === false)
1225     {
1226       $message = "iconv() failed converting from '$from_encoding' to '$to_encoding'";
1227       throw new Exception($message);
1228     }
1229 
1230     return $string;
1231   }
1232 
1233 
1234   // Translates a GNU libiconv character encoding name to its corresponding IBM AIX libiconv character
1235   // encoding name. Returns FALSE if character encoding name is unknown.
1236   private static function getAixCharacterEncoding(?string $character_encoding)
1237   {
1238     // Check arguments
1239     if ($character_encoding == null ||
1240         !is_string($character_encoding) ||
1241         empty($character_encoding))
1242     {
1243       return false;
1244     }
1245 
1246     // Convert character encoding name to lowercase
1247     $character_encoding = mb_strtolower($character_encoding);
1248 
1249     // Check that we know of an IBM AIX libiconv character encoding name equivalent for this character encoding name
1250     if (!array_key_exists($character_encoding, self::$gnu_iconv_to_aix_iconv_codepage_map))
1251     {
1252       return false;
1253     }
1254 
1255     return self::$gnu_iconv_to_aix_iconv_codepage_map[$character_encoding];
1256   }
1257 
1258 
1259   // Tests whether $langtag can be set on this system. Preserves the current locale.
1260   private static function testLocale(string $langtag) : bool
1261   {
1262     // Save the original locales so that we can restore them later.   Note that
1263     // there could be different locales for different categories
1264     $original_locales = explode(';', setlocale(LC_ALL, '0'));
1265 
1266     $os_locale = self::getOSLocale($langtag);
1267 
1268     // Try the test locale
1269     $result = setlocale(LC_ALL, $os_locale);
1270 
1271     // Restore the original settings
1272     foreach ($original_locales as $locale_setting)
1273     {
1274       if (mb_strpos($locale_setting, '=') !== false)
1275       {
1276         list($category, $locale) = explode('=', $locale_setting);
1277         // Need to turn the string back into a constant (sometimes PHP doesn't recognise a LC_ constant,
1278         // so check that it has been defined first before turning it into a constant).
1279         $category = (defined($category)) ? constant($category) : null;
1280       }
1281       else
1282       {
1283         $category = LC_ALL;
1284         $locale   = $locale_setting;
1285       }
1286       if (isset($category))
1287       {
1288         setlocale($category, $locale);
1289       }
1290     }
1291 
1292     return ($result !== false);
1293   }
1294

   2 declare(strict_types=1);
   3 namespace MRBS;

   5 
   6 // This is a class for a general MRBS user, regardless of the authentication type.  Once authenticated each
   7 // user is converted into a standard MRBS user object with defined properties.  (Do not confuse this user
   8 // with a user in the users table: the 'db' authentication method is just one of many that MRBS supports.)
   9 use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer;
  10 
  11 class User
  12 {
  13   // Standard properties
  14   public $username;
  15   public $display_name;
  16   public $email;
  17   public $level;
  18 
  19   // Extra properties held here, accessed through magic methods
  20   protected  $data = array();
  21 
  22 
  23   public function __construct($username=null)
  24   {
  25     $this->username = $username;
  26 
  27     // Set some default properties
  28     $this->display_name = $username;
  29     $this->setDefaultEmail();
  30     $this->level = 0; // Play it safe
  31   }
  32 
  33 
  34   public function __get($name)
  35   {
  36     return (array_key_exists($name, $this->data)) ? $this->data[$name] : null;
  37   }
  38 
  39 
  40   public function __set($name, $value)
  41   {
  42     $this->data[$name] = $value;
  43   }
  44 
  45 
  46   public function __isset($name)
  47   {
  48     return (array_key_exists($name, $this->data) && isset($this->data[$name]));
  49   }
  50 
  51 
  52   public function __unset($name)
  53   {
  54     unset($this->data[$name]);
  55   }
  56 
  57 
  58   // Checks whether the user appears somewhere in the bookings as (a) the creator
  59   // of a booking, (b) the modifier of a booking or (c) a registrant.
  60   public function isInBookings() : bool
  61   {
  62     $sql_params = [':username' => $this->username];
  63 
  64     foreach (['entry', 'repeat'] as $table)
  65     {
  66       $sql = "SELECT COUNT(id)
  67                 FROM ". _tbl($table) . "
  68                WHERE (create_by = :username)
  69                   OR (modified_by = :username)
  70                LIMIT 1";
  71       if (db()->query1($sql, $sql_params) > 0)
  72       {
  73         return true;
  74       }
  75     }
  76 
  77     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(id)
  78               FROM ". _tbl('participants') . "
  79              WHERE username = :username
  80              LIMIT 1";
  81 
  82     return (db()->query1($sql, $sql_params) > 0);
  83   }
  84 
  85 
  86   public function load(array $data)
  87   {
  88     foreach ($data as $key => $value)
  89     {
  90       $this->$key = $value;
  91     }
  92   }
  93 
  94 
  95   // Returns an RFC 5322 mailbox address, ie an address in the format
  96   // "Display name <email address>"
  97   public function mailbox()
  98   {
  99     if (!isset($this->email))
 100     {
 101       return null;
 102     }
 103 
 104     if (!isset($this->display_name) || ($this->display_name === ''))
 105     {
 106       return $this->email;
 107     }
 108 
 109     $mailer = new PHPMailer();
 110     $mailer->CharSet = get_mail_charset();
 111 
 112     // Note that addrFormat() returns a MIME-encoded address
 113     return $mailer->addrFormat(array($this->email, $this->display_name));
 114   }
 115 
 116   // Sets the default email address for the user (null if one can't be found)
 117   private function setDefaultEmail()
 118   {
 119     global $mail_settings;
 120 
 121     if (!isset($this->username) || $this->username === '')
 122     {
 123       $this->email = null;
 124     }
 125     else
 126     {
 127       $this->email = $this->username;
 128 
 129       // Remove the suffix, if there is one
 130       if (isset($mail_settings['username_suffix']) && ($mail_settings['username_suffix'] !== ''))
 131       {
 132         $suffix = $mail_settings['username_suffix'];
 133         if (mb_substr($this->email, -mb_strlen($suffix)) === $suffix)
 134         {
 135           $this->email = mb_substr($this->email, 0, -mb_strlen($suffix));
 136         }
 137       }
 138 
 139       // Add on the domain, if there is one
 140       if (isset($mail_settings['domain']) && ($mail_settings['domain'] !== ''))
 141       {
 142         // Trim any leading '@' character. Older versions of MRBS required the '@' character
 143         // to be included in $mail_settings['domain'], and we still allow this for backwards
 144         // compatibility.
 145         $domain = ltrim($mail_settings['domain'], '@');
 146         $this->email .= '@' . $domain;
 147       }
 148     }
 149   }
 150 
 151 }

  21  * @author Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be>
  22  */
  23 class NormalizerFormatter implements FormatterInterface
  24 {
  25     public const SIMPLE_DATE = "Y-m-d\TH:i:sP";
  26 
  27     /** @var string */
  28     protected $dateFormat;
  29     /** @var int */
  30     protected $maxNormalizeDepth = 9;
  31     /** @var int */
  32     protected $maxNormalizeItemCount = 1000;
  33 
  34     /** @var int */
  35     private $jsonEncodeOptions = Utils::DEFAULT_JSON_FLAGS;
  36 
  37     /**
  38      * @param string|null $dateFormat The format of the timestamp: one supported by DateTime::format
  39      */
  40     public function __construct(?string $dateFormat = null)
  41     {
  42         $this->dateFormat = null === $dateFormat ? static::SIMPLE_DATE : $dateFormat;
  43         if (!function_exists('json_encode')) {
  44             throw new \RuntimeException('PHP\'s json extension is required to use Monolog\'s NormalizerFormatter');
  45         }

  48     /**

  55         return $this->normalize($record);

  58     /**

  60      */
  61     public function formatBatch(array $records)
  62     {
  63         foreach ($records as $key => $record) {
  64             $records[$key] = $this->format($record);
  65         }
  66 
  67         return $records;
  68     }

  86     {
  87         return $this->maxNormalizeDepth;
  88     }
  89

  91     {
  92         $this->maxNormalizeDepth = $maxNormalizeDepth;

  95     }
  96

 130     protected function normalize($data, int $depth = 0)

 135 
 136         if (null === $data || is_scalar($data)) {
 137             if (is_float($data)) {
 138                 if (is_infinite($data)) {
 139                     return ($data > 0 ? '' : '-') . 'INF';
 140                 }
 141                 if (is_nan($data)) {
 142                     return 'NaN';
 143                 }
 144             }
 145 
 146             return $data;
 147         }
 148 
 149         if (is_array($data)) {
 150             $normalized = [];
 151 
 152             $count = 1;
 153             foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
 154                 if ($count++ > $this->maxNormalizeItemCount) {
 155                     $normalized['...'] = 'Over ' . $this->maxNormalizeItemCount . ' items ('.count($data).' total), aborting normalization';
 156                     break;
 157                 }
 158 
 159                 $normalized[$key] = $this->normalize($value, $depth + 1);
 160             }
 161 
 162             return $normalized;
 163         }
 164 
 165         if ($data instanceof \DateTimeInterface) {
 166             return $this->formatDate($data);
 167         }
 168 
 169         if (is_object($data)) {
 170             if ($data instanceof Throwable) {
 171                 return $this->normalizeException($data, $depth);
 172             }
 173 
 174             if ($data instanceof \JsonSerializable) {
 175                 /** @var null|scalar|array<array|scalar|null> $value */
 176                 $value = $data->jsonSerialize();
 177             } elseif (\get_class($data) === '__PHP_Incomplete_Class') {
 178                 $accessor = new \ArrayObject($data);
 179                 $value = (string) $accessor['__PHP_Incomplete_Class_Name'];
 180             } elseif (method_exists($data, '__toString')) {
 181                 /** @var string $value */
 182                 $value = $data->__toString();
 183             } else {
 184                 // the rest is normalized by json encoding and decoding it
 185                 /** @var null|scalar|array<array|scalar|null> $value */
 186                 $value = json_decode($this->toJson($data, true), true);
 187             }
 188 
 189             return [Utils::getClass($data) => $value];
 190         }
 191 
 192         if (is_resource($data)) {
 193             return sprintf('[resource(%s)]', get_resource_type($data));
 194         }
 195 
 196         return '[unknown('.gettype($data).')]';
 197     }
 198 
 199     /**
 200      * @return mixed[]
 201      */
 202     protected function normalizeException(Throwable $e, int $depth = 0)
 203     {
 204         if ($depth > $this->maxNormalizeDepth) {
 205             return ['Over ' . $this->maxNormalizeDepth . ' levels deep, aborting normalization'];
 206         }
 207 
 208         if ($e instanceof \JsonSerializable) {
 209             return (array) $e->jsonSerialize();
 210         }
 211 
 212         $data = [
 213             'class' => Utils::getClass($e),
 214             'message' => $e->getMessage(),
 215             'code' => (int) $e->getCode(),
 216             'file' => $e->getFile().':'.$e->getLine(),
 217         ];
 218 
 219         if ($e instanceof \SoapFault) {
 220             if (isset($e->faultcode)) {
 221                 $data['faultcode'] = $e->faultcode;
 222             }
 223 
 224             if (isset($e->faultactor)) {
 225                 $data['faultactor'] = $e->faultactor;
 226             }
 227 
 228             if (isset($e->detail)) {
 229                 if (is_string($e->detail)) {
 230                     $data['detail'] = $e->detail;
 231                 } elseif (is_object($e->detail) || is_array($e->detail)) {
 232                     $data['detail'] = $this->toJson($e->detail, true);
 233                 }
 234             }
 235         }
 236 
 237         $trace = $e->getTrace();
 238         foreach ($trace as $frame) {
 239             if (isset($frame['file'])) {
 240                 $data['trace'][] = $frame['file'].':'.$frame['line'];
 241             }
 242         }
 243 
 244         if ($previous = $e->getPrevious()) {
 245             $data['previous'] = $this->normalizeException($previous, $depth + 1);
 246         }
 247 
 248         return $data;
 249     }
 250 
 251     /**
 252      * Return the JSON representation of a value
 253      *
 254      * @param  mixed             $data
 255      * @throws \RuntimeException if encoding fails and errors are not ignored
 256      * @return string            if encoding fails and ignoreErrors is true 'null' is returned
 257      */
 258     protected function toJson($data, bool $ignoreErrors = false): string
 259     {
 260         return Utils::jsonEncode($data, $this->jsonEncodeOptions, $ignoreErrors);
 261     }
 262 
 263     /**
 264      * @return string
 265      */
 266     protected function formatDate(\DateTimeInterface $date)
 267     {
 268         // in case the date format isn't custom then we defer to the custom DateTimeImmutable
 269         // formatting logic, which will pick the right format based on whether useMicroseconds is on
 270         if ($this->dateFormat === self::SIMPLE_DATE && $date instanceof DateTimeImmutable) {
 271             return (string) $date;
 272         }
 273 
 274         return $date->format($this->dateFormat);
 275     }
 276 
 277     public function addJsonEncodeOption(int $option): self
 278     {
 279         $this->jsonEncodeOptions |= $option;
 280 
 281         return $this;
 282     }
 283 
 284     public function removeJsonEncodeOption(int $option): self
 285     {
 286         $this->jsonEncodeOptions &= ~$option;
 287 
 288         return $this;
 289     }
 290 }

  13 
  14 /**
  15  * Base Handler class providing basic close() support as well as handleBatch
  16  *
  17  * @author Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be>
  18  */
  19 abstract class Handler implements HandlerInterface
  20 {
  21     /**
  22      * {@inheritDoc}
  23      */
  24     public function handleBatch(array $records): void
  25     {
  26         foreach ($records as $record) {
  27             $this->handle($record);
  28         }
  29     }
  30 
  31     /**
  32      * {@inheritDoc}
  33      */
  34     public function close(): void
  35     {
  36     }
  37 
  38     public function __destruct()
  39     {
  40         try {
  41             $this->close();
  42         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
  43             // do nothing
  44         }
  45     }
  46 
  47     public function __sleep()
  48     {
  49         $this->close();
  50 
  51         $reflClass = new \ReflectionClass($this);
  52 
  53         $keys = [];
  54         foreach ($reflClass->getProperties() as $reflProp) {
  55             if (!$reflProp->isStatic()) {
  56                 $keys[] = $reflProp->getName();
  57             }
  58         }
  59 
  60         return $keys;
  61     }
  62 }

  45      * those that it does not want to handle.

  17 /**
  18  * Helper trait for implementing ProcessableInterface
  19  *
  20  * @author Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be>
  21  *
  22  * @phpstan-import-type Record from \Monolog\Logger
  23  */
  24 trait ProcessableHandlerTrait
  25 {
  26     /**
  27      * @var callable[]
  28      * @phpstan-var array<ProcessorInterface|callable(Record): Record>
  29      */
  30     protected $processors = [];
  31 
  32     /**
  33      * {@inheritDoc}
  34      */
  35     public function pushProcessor(callable $callback): HandlerInterface
  36     {
  37         array_unshift($this->processors, $callback);
  38 
  39         return $this;
  40     }
  41 
  42     /**
  43      * {@inheritDoc}
  44      */
  45     public function popProcessor(): callable
  46     {
  47         if (!$this->processors) {
  48             throw new \LogicException('You tried to pop from an empty processor stack.');
  49         }
  50 
  51         return array_shift($this->processors);
  52     }
  53 
  54     /**
  55      * Processes a record.
  56      *
  57      * @phpstan-param  Record $record
  58      * @phpstan-return Record
  59      */
  60     protected function processRecord(array $record): array
  61     {
  62         foreach ($this->processors as $processor) {
  63             $record = $processor($record);
  64         }
  65 
  66         return $record;
  67     }
  68 
  69     protected function resetProcessors(): void
  70     {
  71         foreach ($this->processors as $processor) {
  72             if ($processor instanceof ResettableInterface) {
  73                 $processor->reset();
  74             }
  75         }
  76     }
  77 }

  63         if (($phpMemoryLimit = Utils::expandIniShorthandBytes(ini_get('memory_limit'))) !== false) {

  69                 $this->streamChunkSize = static::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;
  70             }
  71         } else {
  72             // no memory limit information, set to the default 10MB
  73             $this->streamChunkSize = static::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;
  74         }
  75 
  76         if (is_resource($stream)) {
  77             $this->stream = $stream;
  78 
  79             stream_set_chunk_size($this->stream, $this->streamChunkSize);
  80         } elseif (is_string($stream)) {
  81             $this->url = Utils::canonicalizePath($stream);
  82         } else {

  84         }

  86         $this->fileOpenMode = $fileOpenMode;

  90 
  91     /**
  92      * {@inheritDoc}
  93      */
  94     public function close(): void
  95     {

  97             fclose($this->stream);
  98         }

 100         $this->dirCreated = null;
 101     }
 102 
 103     /**
 104      * Return the currently active stream if it is open
 105      *
 106      * @return resource|null
 107      */
 108     public function getStream()
 109     {
 110         return $this->stream;
 111     }
 112 
 113     /**
 114      * Return the stream URL if it was configured with a URL and not an active resource
 115      *
 116      * @return string|null
 117      */
 118     public function getUrl(): ?string
 119     {
 120         return $this->url;
 121     }
 122 
 123     /**
 124      * @return int
 125      */
 126     public function getStreamChunkSize(): int
 127     {
 128         return $this->streamChunkSize;
 129     }
 130 
 131     /**
 132      * {@inheritDoc}
 133      */
 134     protected function write(array $record): void
 135     {
 136         if (!is_resource($this->stream)) {
 137             $url = $this->url;
 138             if (null === $url || '' === $url) {
 139                 throw new \LogicException('Missing stream url, the stream can not be opened. This may be caused by a premature call to close().' . Utils::getRecordMessageForException($record));
 140             }
 141             $this->createDir($url);
 142             $this->errorMessage = null;
 143             set_error_handler(function (...$args) {
 144                 return $this->customErrorHandler(...$args);
 145             });
 146             try {
 147                 $stream = fopen($url, $this->fileOpenMode);
 148                 if ($this->filePermission !== null) {
 149                     @chmod($url, $this->filePermission);
 150                 }
 151             } finally {
 152                 restore_error_handler();
 153             }
 154             if (!is_resource($stream)) {
 155                 $this->stream = null;
 156 
 157                 throw new \UnexpectedValueException(sprintf('The stream or file "%s" could not be opened in append mode: '.$this->errorMessage, $url) . Utils::getRecordMessageForException($record));
 158             }
 159             stream_set_chunk_size($stream, $this->streamChunkSize);
 160             $this->stream = $stream;
 161         }
 162 
 163         $stream = $this->stream;
 164         if (!is_resource($stream)) {
 165             throw new \LogicException('No stream was opened yet' . Utils::getRecordMessageForException($record));
 166         }
 167 
 168         if ($this->useLocking) {
 169             // ignoring errors here, there's not much we can do about them
 170             flock($stream, LOCK_EX);
 171         }
 172 
 173         $this->errorMessage = null;
 174         set_error_handler(function (...$args) {
 175             return $this->customErrorHandler(...$args);
 176         });
 177         try {
 178             $this->streamWrite($stream, $record);
 179         } finally {
 180             restore_error_handler();
 181         }
 182         if ($this->errorMessage !== null) {
 183             $error = $this->errorMessage;
 184             // close the resource if possible to reopen it, and retry the failed write
 185             if (!$this->retrying && $this->url !== null && $this->url !== 'php://memory') {
 186                 $this->retrying = true;
 187                 $this->close();
 188                 $this->write($record);
 189 
 190                 return;
 191             }
 192 
 193             throw new \UnexpectedValueException('Writing to the log file failed: '.$error . Utils::getRecordMessageForException($record));
 194         }
 195 
 196         $this->retrying = false;
 197         if ($this->useLocking) {
 198             flock($stream, LOCK_UN);
 199         }
 200     }
 201 
 202     /**
 203      * Write to stream
 204      * @param resource $stream
 205      * @param array    $record
 206      *
 207      * @phpstan-param FormattedRecord $record
 208      */
 209     protected function streamWrite($stream, array $record): void
 210     {
 211         fwrite($stream, (string) $record['formatted']);
 212     }
 213 
 214     private function customErrorHandler(int $code, string $msg): bool
 215     {
 216         $this->errorMessage = preg_replace('{^(fopen|mkdir|fwrite)\(.*?\): }', '', $msg);
 217 
 218         return true;
 219     }
 220 
 221     private function getDirFromStream(string $stream): ?string
 222     {
 223         $pos = strpos($stream, '://');
 224         if ($pos === false) {
 225             return dirname($stream);
 226         }
 227 
 228         if ('file://' === substr($stream, 0, 7)) {
 229             return dirname(substr($stream, 7));
 230         }
 231 
 232         return null;
 233     }
 234 
 235     private function createDir(string $url): void
 236     {
 237         // Do not try to create dir if it has already been tried.
 238         if ($this->dirCreated) {
 239             return;
 240         }
 241 
 242         $dir = $this->getDirFromStream($url);
 243         if (null !== $dir && !is_dir($dir)) {
 244             $this->errorMessage = null;
 245             set_error_handler(function (...$args) {
 246                 return $this->customErrorHandler(...$args);
 247             });
 248             $status = mkdir($dir, 0777, true);
 249             restore_error_handler();
 250             if (false === $status && !is_dir($dir) && strpos((string) $this->errorMessage, 'File exists') === false) {
 251                 throw new \UnexpectedValueException(sprintf('There is no existing directory at "%s" and it could not be created: '.$this->errorMessage, $dir));
 252             }
 253         }
 254         $this->dirCreated = true;
 255     }
 256 }

 329     /**
 330      * Adds a log record.
 331      *
 332      * @param  int               $level    The logging level (a Monolog or RFC 5424 level)
 333      * @param  string            $message  The log message
 334      * @param  mixed[]           $context  The log context
 335      * @param  DateTimeImmutable $datetime Optional log date to log into the past or future
 336      * @return bool              Whether the record has been processed

 338      * @phpstan-param Level $level
 339      */
 340     public function addRecord(int $level, string $message, array $context = [], ?DateTimeImmutable $datetime = null): bool
 341     {
 342         if (isset(self::RFC_5424_LEVELS[$level])) {
 343             $level = self::RFC_5424_LEVELS[$level];
 344         }
 345 
 346         if ($this->detectCycles) {
 347             if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 80100 && $fiber = \Fiber::getCurrent()) {
 348                 // @phpstan-ignore offsetAssign.dimType
 349                 $this->fiberLogDepth[$fiber] = $this->fiberLogDepth[$fiber] ?? 0;
 350                 $logDepth = ++$this->fiberLogDepth[$fiber];
 351             } else {
 352                 $logDepth = ++$this->logDepth;
 353             }
 354         } else {
 355             $logDepth = 0;
 356         }
 357 
 358         if ($logDepth === 3) {
 359             $this->warning('A possible infinite logging loop was detected and aborted. It appears some of your handler code is triggering logging, see the previous log record for a hint as to what may be the cause.');
 360             return false;
 361         } elseif ($logDepth >= 5) { // log depth 4 is let through, so we can log the warning above
 362             return false;
 363         }
 364 
 365         try {
 366             $record = null;
 367 
 368             foreach ($this->handlers as $handler) {
 369                 if (null === $record) {
 370                     // skip creating the record as long as no handler is going to handle it
 371                     if (!$handler->isHandling(['level' => $level])) {
 372                         continue;
 373                     }
 374 
 375                     $levelName = static::getLevelName($level);
 376 
 377                     $record = [
 378                         'message' => $message,
 379                         'context' => $context,
 380                         'level' => $level,
 381                         'level_name' => $levelName,
 382                         'channel' => $this->name,
 383                         'datetime' => $datetime ?? new DateTimeImmutable($this->microsecondTimestamps, $this->timezone),
 384                         'extra' => [],
 385                     ];
 386 
 387                     try {
 388                         foreach ($this->processors as $processor) {
 389                             $record = $processor($record);
 390                         }
 391                     } catch (Throwable $e) {
 392                         $this->handleException($e, $record);
 393 
 394                         return true;
 395                     }
 396                 }
 397 
 398                 // once the record exists, send it to all handlers as long as the bubbling chain is not interrupted
 399                 try {
 400                     if (true === $handler->handle($record)) {
 401                         break;
 402                     }
 403                 } catch (Throwable $e) {
 404                     $this->handleException($e, $record);
 405 
 406                     return true;
 407                 }
 408             }
 409         } finally {
 410             if ($this->detectCycles) {
 411                 if (isset($fiber)) {
 412                     $this->fiberLogDepth[$fiber]--;
 413                 } else {
 414                     $this->logDepth--;
 415                 }
 416             }
 417         }
 418 
 419         return null !== $record;

 443      * state, and getting it back to a state in which it can receive log records again.

 492     /**

 501     public static function toMonologLevel($level): int

 503         if (is_string($level)) {
 504             if (is_numeric($level)) {
 505                 /** @phpstan-ignore-next-line */
 506                 return intval($level);
 507             }
 508 
 509             // Contains chars of all log levels and avoids using strtoupper() which may have
 510             // strange results depending on locale (for example, "i" will become "İ" in Turkish locale)
 511             $upper = strtr($level, 'abcdefgilmnortuwy', 'ABCDEFGILMNORTUWY');
 512             if (defined(__CLASS__.'::'.$upper)) {
 513                 return constant(__CLASS__ . '::' . $upper);
 514             }
 515 
 516             throw new InvalidArgumentException('Level "'.$level.'" is not defined, use one of: '.implode(', ', array_keys(static::$levels) + static::$levels));
 517         }
 518 
 519         if (!is_int($level)) {
 520             throw new InvalidArgumentException('Level "'.var_export($level, true).'" is not defined, use one of: '.implode(', ', array_keys(static::$levels) + static::$levels));
 521         }
 522 
 523         return $level;
 524     }

 563     /**
 564      * Adds a log record at an arbitrary level.
 565      *
 566      * This method allows for compatibility with common interfaces.
 567      *
 568      * @param mixed             $level   The log level (a Monolog, PSR-3 or RFC 5424 level)
 569      * @param string|Stringable $message The log message

 573      */
 574     public function log($level, $message, array $context = []): void
 575     {
 576         if (!is_int($level) && !is_string($level)) {

  12 namespace Monolog\Processor;
  13 
  14 use Monolog\Logger;
  15 use Psr\Log\LogLevel;
  16 
  17 /**
  18  * Injects line/file:class/function where the log message came from
  19  *
  20  * Warning: This only works if the handler processes the logs directly.
  21  * If you put the processor on a handler that is behind a FingersCrossedHandler
  22  * for example, the processor will only be called once the trigger level is reached,
  23  * and all the log records will have the same file/line/.. data from the call that
  24  * triggered the FingersCrossedHandler.
  25  *
  26  * @author Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be>
  27  *
  28  * @phpstan-import-type Level from \Monolog\Logger
  29  * @phpstan-import-type LevelName from \Monolog\Logger
  30  */
  31 class IntrospectionProcessor implements ProcessorInterface
  32 {
  33     /** @var int */
  34     private $level;
  35     /** @var string[] */
  36     private $skipClassesPartials;
  37     /** @var int */
  38     private $skipStackFramesCount;
  39     /** @var string[] */
  40     private $skipFunctions = [
  41         'call_user_func',
  42         'call_user_func_array',
  43     ];
  44 
  45     /**
  46      * @param string|int $level               The minimum logging level at which this Processor will be triggered
  47      * @param string[]   $skipClassesPartials
  48      *
  49      * @phpstan-param Level|LevelName|LogLevel::* $level
  50      */
  51     public function __construct($level = Logger::DEBUG, array $skipClassesPartials = [], int $skipStackFramesCount = 0)
  52     {
  53         $this->level = Logger::toMonologLevel($level);
  54         $this->skipClassesPartials = array_merge(['Monolog\\'], $skipClassesPartials);
  55         $this->skipStackFramesCount = $skipStackFramesCount;
  56     }
  57 
  58     /**
  59      * {@inheritDoc}
  60      */
  61     public function __invoke(array $record): array
  62     {
  63         // return if the level is not high enough
  64         if ($record['level'] < $this->level) {
  65             return $record;
  66         }
  67 
  68         $trace = debug_backtrace(DEBUG_BACKTRACE_IGNORE_ARGS);
  69 
  70         // skip first since it's always the current method
  71         array_shift($trace);
  72         // the call_user_func call is also skipped
  73         array_shift($trace);
  74 
  75         $i = 0;
  76 
  77         while ($this->isTraceClassOrSkippedFunction($trace, $i)) {
  78             if (isset($trace[$i]['class'])) {
  79                 foreach ($this->skipClassesPartials as $part) {
  80                     if (strpos($trace[$i]['class'], $part) !== false) {
  81                         $i++;
  82 
  83                         continue 2;
  84                     }
  85                 }
  86             } elseif (in_array($trace[$i]['function'], $this->skipFunctions)) {
  87                 $i++;
  88 
  89                 continue;
  90             }
  91 
  92             break;
  93         }
  94 
  95         $i += $this->skipStackFramesCount;
  96 
  97         // we should have the call source now
  98         $record['extra'] = array_merge(
  99             $record['extra'],
 100             [
 101                 'file'      => isset($trace[$i - 1]['file']) ? $trace[$i - 1]['file'] : null,
 102                 'line'      => isset($trace[$i - 1]['line']) ? $trace[$i - 1]['line'] : null,
 103                 'class'     => isset($trace[$i]['class']) ? $trace[$i]['class'] : null,
 104                 'callType'  => isset($trace[$i]['type']) ? $trace[$i]['type'] : null,
 105                 'function'  => isset($trace[$i]['function']) ? $trace[$i]['function'] : null,
 106             ]
 107         );
 108 
 109         return $record;
 110     }
 111 
 112     /**
 113      * @param array[] $trace
 114      */
 115     private function isTraceClassOrSkippedFunction(array $trace, int $index): bool
 116     {
 117         if (!isset($trace[$index])) {
 118             return false;
 119         }
 120 
 121         return isset($trace[$index]['class']) || in_array($trace[$index]['function'], $this->skipFunctions);
 122     }
 123 }

  19  * Allows to get `Logger` instances in the global scope
  20  * via static method calls on this class.
  21  *
  22  * <code>
  23  * $application = new Monolog\Logger('application');
  24  * $api = new Monolog\Logger('api');
  25  *
  26  * Monolog\Registry::addLogger($application);
  27  * Monolog\Registry::addLogger($api);
  28  *
  29  * function testLogger()
  30  * {
  31  *     Monolog\Registry::api()->error('Sent to $api Logger instance');
  32  *     Monolog\Registry::application()->error('Sent to $application Logger instance');
  33  * }
  34  * </code>
  35  *
  36  * @author Tomas Tatarko <tomas@tatarko.sk>
  37  */
  38 class Registry
  39 {
  40     /**
  41      * List of all loggers in the registry (by named indexes)
  42      *
  43      * @var Logger[]
  44      */
  45     private static $loggers = [];
  46 
  47     /**
  48      * Adds new logging channel to the registry
  49      *
  50      * @param  Logger                    $logger    Instance of the logging channel
  51      * @param  string|null               $name      Name of the logging channel ($logger->getName() by default)
  52      * @param  bool                      $overwrite Overwrite instance in the registry if the given name already exists?
  53      * @throws \InvalidArgumentException If $overwrite set to false and named Logger instance already exists
  54      * @return void
  55      */
  56     public static function addLogger(Logger $logger, ?string $name = null, bool $overwrite = false)
  57     {
  58         $name = $name ?: $logger->getName();
  59 
  60         if (isset(self::$loggers[$name]) && !$overwrite) {
  61             throw new InvalidArgumentException('Logger with the given name already exists');
  62         }
  63 
  64         self::$loggers[$name] = $logger;
  65     }
  66 
  67     /**
  68      * Checks if such logging channel exists by name or instance
  69      *
  70      * @param string|Logger $logger Name or logger instance
  71      */
  72     public static function hasLogger($logger): bool
  73     {
  74         if ($logger instanceof Logger) {
  75             $index = array_search($logger, self::$loggers, true);
  76 
  77             return false !== $index;
  78         }
  79 
  80         return isset(self::$loggers[$logger]);
  81     }
  82 
  83     /**
  84      * Removes instance from registry by name or instance
  85      *
  86      * @param string|Logger $logger Name or logger instance
  87      */
  88     public static function removeLogger($logger): void
  89     {
  90         if ($logger instanceof Logger) {
  91             if (false !== ($idx = array_search($logger, self::$loggers, true))) {
  92                 unset(self::$loggers[$idx]);
  93             }
  94         } else {
  95             unset(self::$loggers[$logger]);
  96         }
  97     }
  98 
  99     /**
 100      * Clears the registry
 101      */

 103     {
 104         self::$loggers = [];
 105     }
 106 
 107     /**
 108      * Gets Logger instance from the registry
 109      *
 110      * @param  string                    $name Name of the requested Logger instance
 111      * @throws \InvalidArgumentException If named Logger instance is not in the registry
 112      */
 113     public static function getInstance($name): Logger
 114     {
 115         if (!isset(self::$loggers[$name])) {
 116             throw new InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Requested "%s" logger instance is not in the registry', $name));
 117         }
 118 
 119         return self::$loggers[$name];
 120     }
 121 
 122     /**

 125      * @param  string                    $name      Name of the requested Logger instance
 126      * @param  mixed[]                   $arguments Arguments passed to static method call

 130     public static function __callStatic($name, $arguments)

 132         return self::getInstance($name);

  19  * Resetting a Handler or a Processor means flushing/cleaning all buffers, resetting internal
  20  * state, and getting it back to a state in which it can receive log records again.

  33     public function reset();

 204      * can be used as a callback for array_walk_recursive.
 205      *
 206      * @param mixed $data Input to check and convert if needed, passed by ref
 207      */
 208     private static function detectAndCleanUtf8(&$data): void
 209     {
 210         if (is_string($data) && !preg_match('//u', $data)) {
 211             $data = preg_replace_callback(
 212                 '/[\x80-\xFF]+/',
 213                 function ($m) {
 214                     return function_exists('mb_convert_encoding') ? mb_convert_encoding($m[0], 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1') : utf8_encode($m[0]);
 215                 },
 216                 $data
 217             );
 218             if (!is_string($data)) {
 219                 $pcreErrorCode = preg_last_error();
 220                 throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to preg_replace_callback: ' . $pcreErrorCode . ' / ' . self::pcreLastErrorMessage($pcreErrorCode));
 221             }
 222             $data = str_replace(
 223                 ['¤', '¦', '¨', '´', '¸', '¼', '½', '¾'],
 224                 ['€', 'Š', 'š', 'Ž', 'ž', 'Œ', 'œ', 'Ÿ'],
 225                 $data
 226             );
 227         }
 228     }
 229 
 230     /**
 231      * Converts a string with a valid 'memory_limit' format, to bytes.
 232      *
 233      * @param string|false $val
 234      * @return int|false Returns an integer representing bytes. Returns FALSE in case of error.
 235      */
 236     public static function expandIniShorthandBytes($val)
 237     {
 238         if (!is_string($val)) {
 239             return false;
 240         }
 241 
 242         // support -1
 243         if ((int) $val < 0) {
 244             return (int) $val;
 245         }
 246 
 247         if (!preg_match('/^\s*(?<val>\d+)(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?<unit>[gmk]?)\s*$/i', $val, $match)) {
 248             return false;
 249         }
 250 
 251         $val = (int) $match['val'];
 252         switch (strtolower($match['unit'])) {
 253             case 'g':
 254                 $val *= 1024;
 255             case 'm':
 256                 $val *= 1024;
 257             case 'k':
 258                 $val *= 1024;
 259         }
 260 
 261         return $val;
 262     }
 263 
 264     /**
 265      * @param array<mixed> $record
 266      */
 267     public static function getRecordMessageForException(array $record): string
 268     {
 269         $context = '';
 270         $extra = '';
 271         try {
 272             if ($record['context']) {
 273                 $context = "\nContext: " . json_encode($record['context']);
 274             }
 275             if ($record['extra']) {
 276                 $extra = "\nExtra: " . json_encode($record['extra']);
 277             }
 278         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 279             // noop
 280         }
 281 
 282         return "\nThe exception occurred while attempting to log: " . $record['message'] . $context . $extra;
 283     }
 284 }

/lib/Psr/Log/LoggerInterface.php

   1 <?php
   2 
   3 namespace Psr\Log;
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * Describes a logger instance.
   7  *
   8  * The message MUST be a string or object implementing __toString().
   9  *
  10  * The message MAY contain placeholders in the form: {foo} where foo
  11  * will be replaced by the context data in key "foo".
  12  *
  13  * The context array can contain arbitrary data. The only assumption that
  14  * can be made by implementors is that if an Exception instance is given
  15  * to produce a stack trace, it MUST be in a key named "exception".
  16  *
  17  * See https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-3-logger-interface.md
  18  * for the full interface specification.
  19  */
  20 interface LoggerInterface
  21 {
  22     /**
  23      * System is unusable.
  24      *
  25      * @param string  $message
  26      * @param mixed[] $context
  27      *
  28      * @return void
  29      */
  30     public function emergency($message, array $context = array());
  31 
  32     /**
  33      * Action must be taken immediately.
  34      *
  35      * Example: Entire website down, database unavailable, etc. This should
  36      * trigger the SMS alerts and wake you up.
  37      *
  38      * @param string  $message
  39      * @param mixed[] $context
  40      *
  41      * @return void
  42      */
  43     public function alert($message, array $context = array());
  44 
  45     /**
  46      * Critical conditions.
  47      *
  48      * Example: Application component unavailable, unexpected exception.
  49      *
  50      * @param string  $message
  51      * @param mixed[] $context
  52      *
  53      * @return void
  54      */
  55     public function critical($message, array $context = array());
  56 
  57     /**
  58      * Runtime errors that do not require immediate action but should typically
  59      * be logged and monitored.
  60      *
  61      * @param string  $message
  62      * @param mixed[] $context
  63      *
  64      * @return void
  65      */
  66     public function error($message, array $context = array());
  67 
  68     /**
  69      * Exceptional occurrences that are not errors.
  70      *
  71      * Example: Use of deprecated APIs, poor use of an API, undesirable things
  72      * that are not necessarily wrong.
  73      *
  74      * @param string  $message
  75      * @param mixed[] $context
  76      *
  77      * @return void
  78      */
  79     public function warning($message, array $context = array());
  80 
  81     /**
  82      * Normal but significant events.
  83      *
  84      * @param string  $message
  85      * @param mixed[] $context
  86      *
  87      * @return void
  88      */
  89     public function notice($message, array $context = array());
  90 
  91     /**
  92      * Interesting events.
  93      *
  94      * Example: User logs in, SQL logs.
  95      *
  96      * @param string  $message
  97      * @param mixed[] $context
  98      *
  99      * @return void
 100      */
 101     public function info($message, array $context = array());
 102 
 103     /**
 104      * Detailed debug information.
 105      *
 106      * @param string  $message
 107      * @param mixed[] $context
 108      *
 109      * @return void
 110      */
 111     public function debug($message, array $context = array());
 112 
 113     /**
 114      * Logs with an arbitrary level.
 115      *
 116      * @param mixed   $level
 117      * @param string  $message
 118      * @param mixed[] $context
 119      *
 120      * @return void
 121      *
 122      * @throws \Psr\Log\InvalidArgumentException
 123      */
 124     public function log($level, $message, array $context = array());
 125 }

   3 namespace MRBS;

  11 function auth()
  12 {
  13   global $auth;
  14 
  15   static $auth_obj = null;
  16 
  17   if (is_null($auth_obj))
  18   {

  20   }
  21

  28 {

  32

  41 
  42 
  43 // Checks if a page is open to users, using the config variables
  44 // $auth['only_admin_can_book'] and $auth['only_admin_can_book_before']
  45 function booking_level() : int
  46 {
  47   global $auth;
  48 
  49   if ($auth['allow_anonymous_booking'])
  50   {
  51     return 0;
  52   }
  53 
  54   if ($auth['only_admin_can_book'])
  55   {
  56     return 2;
  57   }
  58   elseif ($auth['only_admin_can_book_before'])
  59   {
  60     $go_live = strtotime($auth['only_admin_can_book_before']);
  61     if ($go_live === false)
  62     {
  63       $message = "Could not calculate time from '" . $auth['only_admin_can_book_before'] . "'.";
  64       trigger_error($message);
  65       return 2;
  66     }
  67     else
  68     {
  69       return (time() >= $go_live) ? 1 : 2;
  70     }
  71   }
  72 
  73   return 1;
  74 }
  75 
  76 
  77 // Gets the minimum user level required to access a page
  78 function get_page_level($page)
  79 {
  80   global $auth, $max_level;
  81 
  82   // If you're resetting your password you won't be logged in and $auth['deny_public_access']
  83   // should not apply.
  84   if (in_array($page, array('reset_password.php', 'reset_password_handler.php')))
  85   {
  86     return 0;
  87   }
  88 
  89   // Otherwise ...
  90   switch ($page)
  91   {
  92     // These pages are open to the public by default as they only contain
  93     // read features.
  94     case 'help.php':
  95     case 'index.php':
  96       $result = 0;
  97       break;
  98 
  99     // These pages reveal usernames, which could be of assistance to someone trying to
 100     // break into the system, so users are required to be logged in before viewing them.
 101     case 'search.php':
 102       $result = 1;
 103       break;
 104 
 105     case 'view_entry.php':
 106       $result = ($auth['allow_anonymous_booking']) ? 0 : 1;
 107       break;
 108 
 109     // These pages are set to have a minimum access level of 1 as ordinary users
 110     // should be able to access them because they will have read access and in some
 111     // cases write access for their own entries.   Where necessary further checks are
 112     // made within the page to prevent ordinary users gaining access to admin features.
 113     case 'admin.php':
 114     case 'approve_entry_handler.php':   // Ordinary users are allowed to remind admins
 115     case 'edit_message.php':            // Booking admins can edit messages
 116     case 'edit_message_handler.php':    // Booking admins can edit messages
 117     case 'edit_room.php':               // Ordinary users can view room details
 118     case 'edit_users.php':              // Ordinary users can edit their own details
 119     case 'pending.php':                 // Ordinary users can view their own entries
 120     case 'registration_handler.php':    // Ordinary users can register for an event
 121     case 'usernames.php':               // Ajax page for getting a list of users (booking admins can use this)
 122       $result = 1;
 123       break;
 124 
 125     // These pages allow users to create and delete entries
 126     case 'check_slot.php':              // Ajax page used by edit_entry.php
 127     case 'del_entry.php':
 128     case 'edit_entry.php':
 129     case 'edit_entry_handler.php':
 130       return booking_level();
 131       break;
 132 
 133     // Everything else is for admins only
 134     default:
 135       $result = (isset($max_level)) ? $max_level : 2;
 136       break;
 137   }
 138 
 139   if ($auth['deny_public_access'])
 140   {
 141     $result = max($result, 1);
 142   }
 143 
 144   // Can always access index.php when in kiosk mode
 145   if ($page == 'index.php' && is_kiosk_mode())
 146   {
 147     $result = 0;
 148   }
 149 
 150   return $result;
 151 }
 152
