 154 /* getAuthorised($level)
 155  *
 156  * Check to see if the current user has a certain level of rights
 157  *
 158  * $level  - The access level required
 159  * $returl - The URL to return to eventually
 160  *
 161  * Returns:
 162  *   false - The user does not have the required access
 163  *   true  - The user has the required access
 164  */
 165 function getAuthorised($level, $returl) : bool
 166 {
 167   // If the minimum level is zero (or not set) then they are
 168   // authorised, whoever they are
 169   if (empty($level))
 170   {
 171     return true;
 172   }
 173 
 174   // Otherwise we need to check who they are
 175   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 176 
 177   if(!isset($mrbs_user))
 178   {
 179     // Ask them to authenticate, if the session scheme supports it
 180     if (method_exists(session(), 'authGet'))
 181     {
 182       session()->authGet(null, $returl);
 183     }
 184     return false;
 185   }
 186 
 187   return ($mrbs_user->level >= $level);
 188 }
 189 
 190 
 191 /* checkAuthorised()
 192  *
 193  * Checks to see that a user is authorised to access a page.
 194  * If they are not, then shows an "Access Denied" message and exits.
 195  *
 196  */
 197 function checkAuthorised($page, $just_check=false)
 198 {
 199   global $view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, $room;
 200   global $returl;
 201 
 202   // Get the minimum authorisation level for this page
 203   $required_level = get_page_level($page);
 204 
 205   if ($just_check)
 206   {
 207     if ($required_level == 0)
 208     {
 209       return true;
 210     }
 211 
 212     $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 213     return (isset($mrbs_user) && ($mrbs_user->level >= $required_level));
 214   }
 215 
 216   // Check that the user has this level
 217   if (getAuthorised($required_level, $returl))
 218   {
 219     return true;
 220   }
 221 
 222   // If we don't know the right date then use today's
 223   if (!isset($day) or !isset($month) or !isset($year))
 224   {
 225     $day   = date('d');
 226     $month = date('m');
 227     $year  = date('Y');
 228   }
 229 
 230   if (empty($area))
 231   {
 232     $area = get_default_area();
 233   }
 234 
 235   showAccessDenied($view, $view_all, $year, $month, $day, $area, isset($room) ? $room : null);
 236   exit();
 237 }
 238 
 239 
 240 /* getWritable($creator, $room)
 241  *
 242  * Determines if the current user is able to modify an entry
 243  *
 244  * $creator - The creator of the entry
 245  * $rooms   - The id(s) of the room(s) that the entries are in. Can
 246  *            be a scalar or an array.
 247  * $all     - Whether to check that the creator has write access
 248  *            for all ($all=true) or just some ($all=false) of the
 249  *            rooms.
 250  *
 251  * Returns:
 252  *   false  - The user does not have the required access
 253  *   true   - The user has the required access
 254  */
 255 function getWritable($creator, $rooms=null, $all=true) : bool
 256 {
 257   if (is_array($rooms) && (count($rooms) > 0))
 258   {
 259     if ($all)
 260     {
 261       // We want the user to have write access for all the rooms,
 262       // so if for any one room they are not, then return false.
 263       foreach ($rooms as $room)
 264       {
 265         if (!getWritable($creator, $room))
 266         {
 267           return false;
 268         }
 269       }
 270       return true;
 271     }
 272     else
 273     {
 274       // We want the user to have write access for at least one room,
 275       // so if there are no rooms for which they do, then return false.
 276       foreach ($rooms as $room)
 277       {
 278         if (getWritable($creator, $room))
 279         {
 280           return true;
 281         }
 282       }
 283       return false;
 284     }
 285   }
 286 
 287   if (is_null($rooms) && !$all)
 288   {
 289     // Not yet supported.  Could support it but need to decide what $rooms=null means.
 290     // Does it mean all rooms in the system or just all rooms in the current area?
 291     throw new \Exception('$rooms===null and $all===false not yet supported.');
 292   }
 293 
 294   // You can't make bookings in rooms which are invisible
 295   if (!is_visible($rooms))
 296   {
 297     return false;
 298   }
 299 
 300   // Always allowed to modify your own stuff
 301   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 302   if (isset($mrbs_user) && isset($creator) && (strcasecmp_locale($creator, $mrbs_user->username) === 0))
 303   {
 304     return true;
 305   }
 306 
 307   // Otherwise you have to be a (booking) admin for this room
 308   if (is_book_admin($rooms))
 309   {
 310     return true;
 311   }
 312 
 313   // Unauthorised access
 314   return false;
 315 }
 316 
 317 /* showAccessDenied()
 318  *
 319  * Displays an appropriate message when access has been denied
 320  *
 321  * Returns: Nothing
 322  */
 323 function showAccessDenied($view=null, $view_all=null, $year=null, $month=null, $day=null, $area=null, $room=null)
 324 {
 325   global $server;
 326 
 327   $context = array(
 328       'view'      => $view,
 329       'view_all'  => $view_all,
 330       'year'      => $year,
 331       'month'     => $month,
 332       'day'       => $day,
 333       'area'      => $area,
 334       'room'      => isset($room) ? $room : null
 335     );
 336 
 337   print_header($context);
 338 
 339   // Wrap the contents in a <div> to help with styling.  Not a very nice solution, but anyway.
 340   echo "<div>\n";
 341   echo "<h1>" . get_vocab("accessdenied") . "</h1>\n";
 342   echo "<p>" . get_vocab("norights") . "</p>\n";
 343   $referrer = session()->getReferrer();

 345   {
 346     echo "<p>\n";
 347     echo "<a href=\"" . escape_html($referrer) . "\">\n" . get_vocab("returnprev") . "</a>\n";
 348     echo "</p>\n";
 349   }
 350   echo "</div>\n";
 351 
 352   // Print footer and exit
 353   print_footer(true);
 354 }

 357 // Checks whether the current user has admin rights
 358 function is_admin() : bool
 359 {
 360   global $max_level;
 361 
 362   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 363   $required_level = (isset($max_level) ? $max_level : 2);
 364 
 365   return (isset($mrbs_user) && ($mrbs_user->level >= $required_level));
 366 }
 367 
 368 
 369 // Checks whether the current user has booking administration rights
 370 // for $rooms - ie is allowed to modify and delete other people's bookings
 371 // and to approve bookings.
 372 //
 373 // $rooms can be either a single scalar value or an array of room ids.  The default
 374 // value for $rooms is all rooms.  (At the moment $room is ignored, but is passed here
 375 // so that later MRBS can be enhanced to provide fine-grained permissions.)
 376 //
 377 // $all specifies whether the user must be a booking for all $rooms, or just some of
 378 // them, ie at least one.
 379 //
 380 // Returns:  TRUE if the user is allowed has booking admin rights for
 381 //           the room(s); otherwise FALSE
 382 function is_book_admin($rooms=null, $all=true) : bool
 383 {
 384   global $min_booking_admin_level;
 385 
 386   if (is_array($rooms) && (count($rooms) > 0))
 387   {
 388     if ($all)
 389     {
 390       // We want the user to be a booking admin for all the rooms,
 391       // so if for any one room they are not, then return false.
 392       foreach ($rooms as $room)
 393       {
 394         if (!is_book_admin($room))
 395         {
 396           return false;
 397         }
 398       }
 399       return true;
 400     }
 401     else
 402     {
 403       // We want the user to be a booking admin for at least one room,
 404       // so if there are no rooms for which they are, then return false.
 405       foreach ($rooms as $room)
 406       {
 407         if (is_book_admin($room))
 408         {
 409           return true;
 410         }
 411       }
 412       return false;
 413     }
 414   }
 415 
 416   if (is_null($rooms) && !$all)
 417   {
 418     // Not yet supported.  Could support it but need to decide what $rooms=null means.
 419     // Does it mean all rooms in the system or just all rooms in the current area?
 420     throw new \Exception('$rooms===null and $all===false not yet supported.');
 421   }
 422 
 423   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 424 
 425   return (isset($mrbs_user) && ($mrbs_user->level >= $min_booking_admin_level));
 426 }

 464 // Checks whether the current user can see others' email addresses
 465 function can_see_email_addresses() : bool
 466 {
 467   global $auth, $is_private_field;
 468 
 469   // Admins can see everything
 470   if (is_admin())
 471   {
 472     return true;
 473   }
 474 
 475   $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
 476 
 477   // Don't expose email addresses to the public
 478   if (!isset($mrbs_user))
 479   {
 480     return false;
 481   }
 482 
 483   // MRBS must be configured for logged-in users to see others' details
 484   if ($auth['only_admin_can_see_other_users'])
 485   {
 486     return false;
 487   }
 488 
 489   // Otherwise the email field in the users table must not be private
 490   return (!auth()->canCreateUsers() || empty($is_private_field['users.email']));
 491 }

   2 declare(strict_types=1);
   3 namespace MRBS;

   5 use DateTimeImmutable;
   6 use DateTimeZone;
   7 use MRBS\DB\DBException;

  14 // Some database drivers (eg MySQL in certain cases) return strings for ints and floats.
  15 // This function casts them to their intended types if necessary.
  16 function row_cast_columns(array &$row, string $table_short_name) : void
  17 {
  18   if (db()->returnsNativeTypes())
  19   {
  20     return;
  21   }
  22 
  23   $columns = Columns::getInstance(_tbl($table_short_name));
  24 
  25   foreach ($columns as $column)
  26   {
  27     if (isset($row[$column->name]))
  28     {
  29       switch ($column->getNature())
  30       {
  31         case Column::NATURE_BOOLEAN:
  32           // Cast those fields which are booleans into booleans
  33           $row[$column->name] = (bool) $row[$column->name];
  34           break;
  35         case Column::NATURE_INTEGER:
  36           // MySQL will return strings for integer fields, so cast them into ints
  37           $row[$column->name] = (int) $row[$column->name];
  38           break;
  39         case Column::NATURE_REAL:
  40           // MySQL will return strings for real fields, so cast them into floats
  41           $row[$column->name] = (float) $row[$column->name];
  42           break;
  43         default:
  44           break;
  45       }
  46     }
  47   }
  48 }
  49 
  50 
  51 // Pack the various status fields into a single bitmap
  52 function pack_status(array &$data)
  53 {
  54   $statuses = array('awaiting_approval' => STATUS_AWAITING_APPROVAL,
  55                     'private'           => STATUS_PRIVATE,
  56                     'tentative'         => STATUS_TENTATIVE);
  57 
  58   $data['status'] = 0;
  59 
  60   foreach ($statuses as $key => $value)
  61   {
  62     if (!empty($data[$key]))
  63     {
  64       $data['status'] |= $value;
  65     }
  66     unset($data[$key]);
  67   }
  68 }
  69 
  70 
  71 // Translates the status flags into a set of booleans
  72 function unpack_status(array &$data)
  73 {
  74   if (isset($data))
  75   {
  76     $data['awaiting_approval'] = (bool) ($data['status'] & STATUS_AWAITING_APPROVAL);
  77     $data['private']           = (bool) ($data['status'] & STATUS_PRIVATE);
  78     $data['tentative']         = (bool) ($data['status'] & STATUS_TENTATIVE);
  79     unset($data['status']);
  80   }
  81 }

  84 /** mrbsCheckFree()
  85  *
  86  * Check to see if the time period specified is free
  87  *
  88  * $booking           - The booking in question, an associative array
  89  * $ignore_entry_id   - An entry ID to ignore, null to ignore no entries
  90  * $ignore_repeat_id  - A repeat ID to ignore everything in the series, null to ignore no series
  91  *
  92  * Returns:
  93  *   an array of conflicts, empty if there are none
  94  */
  95 function mrbsCheckFree(array $booking, ?int $ignore_entry_id=null, ?int $ignore_repeat_id=null) : array
  96 {
  97   global $enable_periods, $periods;
  98   global $datetime_formats, $is_private_field;
  99 
 100   $room_id = $booking['room_id'];
 101 
 102   get_area_settings(get_area($room_id));
 103 
 104   // Select any meetings which overlap for this room:
 105   $sql = "SELECT E.id, name, start_time, end_time, create_by, status, room_name
 106             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " E, " . _tbl('room') . " R
 107            WHERE E.room_id=R.id
 108              AND start_time < ?
 109              AND end_time > ?
 110              AND E.room_id = ?";
 111 
 112   $sql_params = array($booking['end_time'],
 113                       $booking['start_time'],
 114                       $room_id);
 115 
 116   if (isset($ignore_entry_id))
 117   {
 118     $sql .= " AND E.id <> ?";
 119     $sql_params[] = $ignore_entry_id;
 120   }
 121   if (isset($ignore_repeat_id))
 122   {
 123     $sql .= " AND (repeat_id IS NULL OR repeat_id <> ?)";
 124     $sql_params[] = $ignore_repeat_id;
 125   }
 126   $sql .= " ORDER BY start_time";
 127 
 128   $res = db()->query($sql, $sql_params);
 129 
 130   if ($res->count() == 0)
 131   {
 132     return array();
 133   }
 134   // Get the room's area ID for linking to day, week, and month views:
 135   $area = mrbsGetRoomArea($room_id);
 136 
 137   // Build a listing all the conflicts:
 138   $err = array();
 139 
 140   while (false !== ($row = $res->next_row_keyed()))
 141   {
 142     row_cast_columns($row, 'entry');
 143     unpack_status($row);
 144     $existing_entry_interval = new EntryInterval($row['start_time'], $row['end_time'], $enable_periods);
 145 
 146     $existing_start_date = new DateTime();
 147     $existing_start_date->setTimestamp($row['start_time']);
 148 
 149     $timestr = (string) $existing_entry_interval;
 150 
 151     if (is_private_event($row['private']) &&
 152         $is_private_field['entry.name'] &&
 153         !getWritable($row['create_by'], $room_id))
 154     {
 155        $row['name'] = get_vocab("unavailable");
 156     }
 157 
 158     // enclose the viewday etc. links in a span to make it easier for JavaScript to strip them out
 159     $vars = array('page_date' => $existing_start_date->getISODate(),
 160                   'area'  => $area,
 161                   'room'  => $room_id);
 162 
 163     $query = http_build_query($vars, '', '&');
 164 
 165     $err[] = '<a href="' . escape_html(multisite('view_entry.php?id=' . $row['id'])) . '">' .
 166              escape_html($row['name']) . '</a>' .
 167              ' (' . escape_html($timestr) . ', ' . escape_html($row['room_name']) . ') ' .
 168              '<span>(' .
 169              '<a href="' . escape_html(multisite("index.php?view=day&$query")) . '">' . get_vocab('viewday') . '</a> | ' .
 170              '<a href="' . escape_html(multisite("index.php?view=week&$query")) . '">' . get_vocab('viewweek') . '</a> | ' .
 171              '<a href="' . escape_html(multisite("index.php?view=month&$query")) . '">' . get_vocab('viewmonth') . '</a>' .
 172              ')</span>';
 173   }
 174 
 175   return $err;
 176 }

 179 // Checks whether the user will have more than the maximum number of rooms booked simultaneously
 180 // Returns NULL if OK, otherwise an error string.
 181 // TODO: Maybe we should ignore bookings in rooms where the user is a booking admin??
 182 function check_simultaneous(array $booking, ?int $ignore_entry_id) : ?string
 183 {
 184   global $max_simultaneous_bookings, $simultaneous_ignore_other_areas;
 185 
 186   static $existing = array();
 187   static $proposed = array();
 188   static $area_id = null;
 189   static $check_complete = false;
 190 
 191   // Check to see whether we are searching globally across a mixture of times and periods.
 192   // This will lead to false clashes because (a) MRBS stores periods as one minute bookings
 193   // starting at 12:00 and (b) MRBS does not know what times periods correspond to.
 194   if (!$simultaneous_ignore_other_areas && !$check_complete)
 195   {
 196     if (periods_somewhere(true)  && times_somewhere(true))
 197     {
 198       $message = 'It does not make sense to check the whole system for simultaneous bookings ' .
 199                  'when there are some areas using periods and others using times. You should ' .
 200                  'either change the value of the config setting $simultaneous_ignore_other_areas ' .
 201                  'or change your area settings.';
 202       trigger_error($message, E_USER_WARNING);
 203     }
 204     $check_complete = true;
 205   }
 206 
 207   // Get the area id if we need it (it will be the same for all bookings, so
 208   // save it in a static variable).
 209   if ($simultaneous_ignore_other_areas && !isset($area_id))
 210   {
 211     $room_details = get_room_details($booking['room_id']);
 212     if (!isset($room_details['area_id']))
 213     {
 214       throw new Exception("Cannot get the area id for the room with id '" . $booking['room_id'] . "'");
 215     }
 216     $area_id = $room_details['area_id'];
 217   }
 218 
 219   // Get the existing bookings for this user and interval, if we don't already have them
 220   if (!isset($existing[$booking['start_time']]))
 221   {
 222     // If $simultaneous_ignore_other_areas is false then $area_id will be null, which is
 223     // what we want.
 224     $existing[$booking['start_time']] = count(get_entry_times_by_user($booking['create_by'],
 225                                                                       $booking['start_time'],
 226                                                                       $booking['end_time'],
 227                                                                       $area_id,
 228                                                                       false,
 229                                                                       $ignore_entry_id));
 230   }
 231 
 232   // Increment the proposed bookings
 233   if (!isset($proposed[$booking['start_time']]))
 234   {
 235     $proposed[$booking['start_time']] = 1;
 236   }
 237   else
 238   {
 239     $proposed[$booking['start_time']]++;
 240   }
 241 
 242   // Check whether this would break the rules
 243   if (($existing[$booking['start_time']] + $proposed[$booking['start_time']]) > $max_simultaneous_bookings)
 244   {
 245     // The number is sent as a string to allow words instead of numbers in the future, eg "two" instead of 2
 246     return get_vocab('no_simultaneous_bookings', strval($max_simultaneous_bookings));
 247   }
 248 
 249   return null;
 250 }

 253 // Checks whether the proposed booking $booking would exceed the maximum number/length of
 254 // bookings in the interval of type $interval_type (can be 'day', 'week', 'month', 'year' or
 255 // 'future').  If $only_area is set then only the bookings in the same area are considered.
 256 // If $check_seconds is set then the total length of bookings is checked, otherwise the number.
 257 // Returns NULL if OK, otherwise an error string.
 258 function check_interval(string $interval_type, array $booking, ?int $ignore_entry_id, ?int $ignore_repeat_id, bool $only_area=false, bool $check_seconds=false) : ?string
 259 {
 260   global $max_per_interval_global, $max_per_interval_area;
 261   global $max_secs_per_interval_global, $max_secs_per_interval_area;
 262 
 263   // Get the area id.   We only need to do this once as all bookings will be
 264   // in the same area.
 265   static $area_id = null;
 266   if (!isset($area_id))
 267   {
 268     $area_id = get_area($booking['room_id']);
 269   }
 270 
 271   // Get the location for indexing the $existing and $proposed arrays.   If it's a
 272   // global check then $location = 0, otherwise use the area_id.
 273   $location = ($only_area) ? $area_id : 0;
 274   // Get the check type for indexing the $existing and $proposed arrays
 275   $check_type = ($check_seconds) ? 'length' : 'number';
 276 
 277   // Set up arrays recording the number of existing and proposed bookings for the interval,
 278   // indexed by the interval type and the Unix time at the start of that interval.  These
 279   // are static variables because we test all the proposed bookings, which could be for
 280   // multiple rooms and/or for repeat bookings, before making the booking.
 281   static $existing = array();
 282   static $proposed = array();
 283 
 284   // Loop through all the intervals in the proposed booking, counting how many bookings
 285   // already exist for that interval, and incrementing the number of proposed bookings
 286   // by one
 287   $start_date = getdate($booking['start_time']);
 288   $i = 1;
 289   switch ($interval_type)
 290   {
 291     case 'day':
 292       $interval_start = mktime(0, 0, 0, $start_date['mon'], $start_date['mday'], $start_date['year']);
 293       break;
 294     case 'week':
 295       $skipback = day_of_MRBS_week($booking['start_time']);
 296       $interval_start = mktime(0, 0, 0, $start_date['mon'], $start_date['mday'] - $skipback, $start_date['year']);
 297       break;
 298     case 'month':
 299       $interval_start = mktime(0, 0, 0, $start_date['mon'], 1, $start_date['year']);
 300       break;
 301     case 'year':
 302       $interval_start = mktime(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, $start_date['year']);
 303       break;
 304     case 'future':
 305       $interval_start = time();
 306       break;
 307   }
 308 
 309   while ($interval_start < $booking['end_time'])
 310   {
 311     switch ($interval_type)
 312     {
 313       case 'day':
 314         $interval_end = mktime(0, 0, 0, $start_date['mon'], $start_date['mday'] + $i, $start_date['year']);
 315         break;
 316       case 'week':
 317         $interval_end = mktime(0, 0, 0, $start_date['mon'], $start_date['mday'] + ($i * DAYS_PER_WEEK) - $skipback, $start_date['year']);
 318         break;
 319       case 'month':
 320         $interval_end = mktime(0, 0, 0, $start_date['mon'] + $i, 1, $start_date['year']);
 321         break;
 322       case 'year':
 323         $interval_end = mktime(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, $start_date['year'] + $i);
 324         break;
 325       case 'future':
 326         $interval_end = null;  // Effectively infinity.  We can't use PHP_INT_MAX because this will break some databases.
 327         break;
 328     }
 329 
 330     if (!isset($existing[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start]))
 331     {
 332       $existing[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start] = 0;
 333       $proposed[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start] = 0;
 334 
 335       $rows = get_entry_times_by_user(
 336           $booking['create_by'],
 337           $interval_start,
 338           $interval_end,
 339           ($only_area) ? $area_id : null,
 340           $check_seconds,
 341           $ignore_entry_id,
 342           $ignore_repeat_id
 343         );
 344 
 345       foreach ($rows as $row)
 346       {
 347         // If we're checking for total time we want the length of the existing booking that falls
 348         // inside the interval.  Otherwise it's just one more booking.
 349         if ($check_seconds)
 350         {
 351           $seconds = (isset($interval_end)) ? min($row['end_time'], $interval_end) : $row['end_time'];
 352           $seconds = $seconds - max($row['start_time'], $interval_start);
 353           $existing[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start] += $seconds;
 354         }
 355         else
 356         {
 357           $existing[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start]++;
 358         }
 359       }
 360     }
 361 
 362     // If we're checking for total time we want the length of the proposed booking that falls
 363     // inside the interval.  Otherwise it's just one more booking.
 364     if ($check_seconds)
 365     {
 366       $seconds = (isset($interval_end)) ? min($booking['end_time'], $interval_end) : $booking['end_time'];
 367       $seconds = $seconds - max($booking['start_time'], $interval_start);
 368       $proposed[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start] += $seconds;
 369     }
 370     else
 371     {
 372       $proposed[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start]++;
 373     }
 374 
 375     // Check to see if the maximum number/length of bookings would be exceeded
 376     if ($check_seconds)
 377     {
 378       $max_allowed = ($only_area) ? $max_secs_per_interval_area[$interval_type] : $max_secs_per_interval_global[$interval_type];
 379       if (($existing[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start] +
 380            $proposed[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start]) >
 381           $max_allowed)
 382       {
 383         if ($only_area)
 384         {
 385           $max = $max_secs_per_interval_area[$interval_type];
 386           toTimeString($max, $units);
 387           return get_vocab("max_secs_per_{$interval_type}_area", $max, $units);
 388         }
 389         else
 390         {
 391           $max = $max_secs_per_interval_global[$interval_type];
 392           toTimeString($max, $units);
 393           return get_vocab("max_secs_per_{$interval_type}_global", $max, $units);
 394         }
 395       }
 396     }
 397     else
 398     {
 399       $max_allowed = ($only_area) ? $max_per_interval_area[$interval_type] : $max_per_interval_global[$interval_type];
 400       if (($existing[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start] +
 401            $proposed[$location][$check_type][$interval_type][$interval_start]) >
 402           $max_allowed)
 403       {
 404         if ($only_area)
 405         {
 406           return get_vocab("max_per_{$interval_type}_area") . " $max_per_interval_area[$interval_type]";
 407         }
 408         else
 409         {
 410           return get_vocab("max_per_{$interval_type}_global") . " $max_per_interval_global[$interval_type]";
 411         }
 412       }
 413     }
 414 
 415     if (isset($interval_end))
 416     {
 417       $interval_start = $interval_end;
 418       $i++;
 419     }
 420     else
 421     {
 422       // $interval_end won't be set if we're looking at all bookings in the future, in
 423       // which case the interval end is effectively infinity and we should stop.
 424       break;
 425     }
 426   }
 427 
 428   return null;
 429 }

 432 // Adjusts a book ahead time when using periods.  Because we don't
 433 // know when periods are in the day we adjust the book ahead time
 434 // down to the nearest whole day.
 435 function adjust_ahead_seconds(int $seconds) : int
 436 {
 437   global $enable_periods;
 438 
 439   if ($enable_periods)
 440   {
 441     // Round down to the nearest whole day
 442     $seconds -=  $seconds % SECONDS_PER_DAY;
 443   }
 444 
 445   return $seconds;
 446 }

 449 /** mrbsCheckPolicy()
 450  *
 451  * Check to see if a proposed booking conforms to any booking policies in force.
 452  * Can be used for both creating and deleting an entry.
 453  *
 454  * $booking   - The booking in question - an associative array
 455  * $delete    - TRUE: We're intending to delete an entry
 456  *            - FALSE:  We're intending to create an entry (the default)
 457  *
 458  * Returns:
 459  *            - An array of human-readable errors, index by 'notices' or 'errors'.
 460  *              If there are no policy violations the array has length 0.
 461  */
 462 function mrbsCheckPolicy(array $booking, ?int $ignore_entry_id=null, ?int $ignore_repeat_id=null, bool $delete=false) : array
 463 {
 464   global $periods, $enable_periods;
 465   global $min_create_ahead_enabled, $min_create_ahead_secs;
 466   global $max_create_ahead_enabled, $max_create_ahead_secs;
 467   global $min_delete_ahead_enabled, $min_delete_ahead_secs;
 468   global $max_delete_ahead_enabled, $max_delete_ahead_secs;
 469   global $min_booking_date_enabled, $min_booking_date, $max_booking_date_enabled, $max_booking_date;
 470   global $max_duration_enabled, $max_duration_secs, $max_duration_periods;
 471   global $max_per_interval_global_enabled, $max_per_interval_area_enabled;
 472   global $max_secs_per_interval_global_enabled, $max_secs_per_interval_area_enabled;
 473   global $interval_types, $datetime_formats;
 474   global $approved_bookings_cannot_be_changed, $approval_enabled;
 475   global $prevent_simultaneous_bookings, $prevent_invalid_types, $invalid_types_days;
 476   global $prevent_booking_on_holidays, $prevent_booking_on_weekends;
 477   global $periods_booking_opens, $measure_max_to_start_time;
 478 
 479   $result = array('notices' => array(),
 480                   'errors'  => array());
 481 
 482   $violations = array();
 483 
 484   // If the user is a booking admin for this room then we still check for policy
 485   // violations, but they are for information only and are classed as 'notices'
 486   $violation_status = (is_book_admin($booking['room_id'])) ? 'notices' : 'errors';
 487 
 488   $now = time();
 489   if ($enable_periods)
 490   {
 491     // And now add on the difference between the internal start of periods (12:00)
 492     // and the booking day start for periods
 493     $now += strtotime('12:00') - strtotime($periods_booking_opens);
 494   }
 495 
 496   // Check deletion policies
 497   if ($delete)
 498   {
 499     if ($approval_enabled && $approved_bookings_cannot_be_changed && !$booking['awaiting_approval'])
 500     {
 501       $violations[] = get_vocab('cannot_change_approved_bookings');
 502     }
 503 
 504     if ($min_delete_ahead_enabled)
 505     {
 506       $min_delete_ahead = adjust_ahead_seconds($min_delete_ahead_secs);
 507       if ($booking['start_time'] - $now < $min_delete_ahead + cross_dst($now, $booking['start_time']))
 508       {
 509         toTimeString($min_delete_ahead, $units);
 510         $violations[] = get_vocab('min_delete_time_before', $min_delete_ahead, $units);
 511       }
 512     }
 513 
 514     if ($max_delete_ahead_enabled)
 515     {
 516       $max_delete_ahead = adjust_ahead_seconds($max_delete_ahead_secs);
 517       $edge = ($measure_max_to_start_time) ? $booking['start_time'] : $booking['end_time'];
 518       if ($edge - $now > $max_delete_ahead + cross_dst($now, $edge))
 519       {
 520         toTimeString($max_delete_ahead, $units);
 521         $tag = ($measure_max_to_start_time) ? 'max_delete_time_before_start' : 'max_delete_time_before';
 522         $violations[] = get_vocab($tag, $max_delete_ahead, $units);
 523       }
 524     }
 525   }
 526 
 527   // Check creation policies
 528   else
 529   {
 530     $entryInterval = new EntryInterval($booking['start_time'], $booking['end_time'], $enable_periods);
 531     // Check whether the user is trying to book on a holiday
 532     if ($prevent_booking_on_holidays)
 533     {
 534       if (false !== ($date = $entryInterval->overlapsHoliday()))
 535       {
 536         $violations[] = get_vocab('no_bookings_on_holidays', datetime_format($datetime_formats['date_holiday'], $date->getTimestamp()));
 537       }
 538     }
 539     // Check whether the user is trying to book on a weekend
 540     if ($prevent_booking_on_weekends)
 541     {
 542       if (false !== ($date = $entryInterval->overlapsWeekend()))
 543       {
 544         $violations[] = get_vocab('no_bookings_on_weekends', datetime_format($datetime_formats['date_holiday'], $date->getTimestamp()));
 545       }
 546     }
 547 
 548     // Check whether the user is trying to book multiple rooms simultaneously
 549     if ($prevent_simultaneous_bookings)
 550     {
 551       $tmp = check_simultaneous($booking, $ignore_entry_id);
 552       if (isset($tmp))
 553       {
 554         $violations[] = $tmp;
 555       }
 556     }
 557 
 558     // Check whether this booking type is allowed ...
 559     if ($prevent_invalid_types)
 560     {
 561       // ... in this room
 562       $room_details = get_room_details($booking['room_id']);
 563       if (isset($room_details['invalid_types']) &&
 564           in_array($booking['type'], $room_details['invalid_types']))
 565       {
 566         // TODO: is this the best place for the escape_html()?  Should it go closer to the output?
 567         $violations[] = get_vocab('type_not_allowed', get_type_vocab($booking['type']), escape_html($room_details['room_name']));
 568       }
 569       // ... on this day
 570       if (!empty($invalid_types_days[$booking['type']]))
 571       {
 572         $overlap_date = $entryInterval->overlapsDays($invalid_types_days[$booking['type']]);
 573         if ($overlap_date !== false)
 574         {
 575           $overlap_day = datetime_format(['pattern' => 'cccc'], $overlap_date->getTimestamp());
 576           $violations[] = get_vocab('type_not_allowed_day', get_type_vocab($booking['type']), $overlap_day);
 577         }
 578       }
 579     }
 580 
 581     if ($min_create_ahead_enabled)
 582     {
 583       $min_create_ahead = adjust_ahead_seconds($min_create_ahead_secs);
 584       if ($booking['start_time'] - $now < $min_create_ahead + cross_dst($now, $booking['start_time']))
 585       {
 586         toTimeString($min_create_ahead, $units);
 587         $violations[] = get_vocab('min_create_time_before', $min_create_ahead, $units);
 588       }
 589     }
 590 
 591     if ($max_create_ahead_enabled)
 592     {
 593       $max_create_ahead = adjust_ahead_seconds($max_create_ahead_secs);
 594       $edge = ($measure_max_to_start_time) ? $booking['start_time'] : $booking['end_time'];
 595       if ($edge - $now > $max_create_ahead + cross_dst($now, $edge))
 596       {
 597         toTimeString($max_create_ahead, $units);
 598         $tag = ($measure_max_to_start_time) ? 'max_create_time_before_start' : 'max_create_time_before';
 599         $violations[] = get_vocab($tag, $max_create_ahead, $units);
 600       }
 601     }
 602   }
 603 
 604   // Check min_booking_date
 605   if ($min_booking_date_enabled && !$delete)
 606   {
 607     // Use DateTimeImmutable because we will need the original date for the error message
 608     $date_immutable = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat($format=DateTime::ISO8601_DATE, $min_booking_date);
 609     // Check that the date is valid (createFromFormat will allow, for example, months > 12)
 610     if (($date_immutable === false) || ($date_immutable->format($format) !== $min_booking_date))
 611     {
 612       throw new \Exception('MRBS config error: invalid $min_booking_date ' . "'$min_booking_date'");
 613     }
 614     if ($booking['start_time'] < $date_immutable->setTime(0, 0)->getTimestamp())
 615     {
 616       $violations[] = get_vocab(
 617         'earliest_booking_date',
 618         datetime_format($datetime_formats['date'], $date_immutable->getTimestamp())
 619       );
 620     }
 621   }
 622 
 623   // Check max_booking_date
 624   if ($max_booking_date_enabled && !$delete)
 625   {
 626     // Use DateTimeImmutable because we will need the original date for the error message
 627     $date_immutable = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat($format=DateTime::ISO8601_DATE, $max_booking_date);
 628     // Check that the date is valid (createFromFormat will allow, for example, months > 12)
 629     if (($date_immutable === false) || ($date_immutable->format($format) !== $max_booking_date))
 630     {
 631       throw new \Exception('MRBS config error: invalid $max_booking_date ' . "'$max_booking_date'");
 632     }
 633     if ($booking['end_time'] > $date_immutable->setTime(0, 0)->modify('+1 day')->getTimestamp())
 634     {
 635       $violations[] = get_vocab(
 636         'latest_booking_date',
 637         datetime_format($datetime_formats['date'], $date_immutable->getTimestamp())
 638       );
 639     }
 640   }
 641 
 642   // Check max_duration (but not if we're deleting a booking)
 643   if ($max_duration_enabled && !$delete)
 644   {
 645     if ($enable_periods)
 646     {
 647       // Instead of calculating the difference between the start and end times and
 648       // comparing that with the maximum duration, we add the maximum duration to the
 649       // start time and compare that with the actual end time
 650       $start = getdate($booking['start_time']);
 651       $start['minutes'] += $max_duration_periods;
 652       $n_periods = count($periods);
 653       // If we've gone over into another day, adjust the minutes and days accordingly
 654       while ($start['minutes'] >= $n_periods)
 655       {
 656         $start['minutes'] -= $n_periods;
 657         $start['mday']++;
 658       }
 659       $max_endtime = mktime($start['hours'], $start['minutes'], $start['seconds'],
 660                             $start['mon'], $start['mday'], $start['year']);
 661       if ($booking['end_time'] > $max_endtime)
 662       {
 663         $violations[] = get_vocab("max_booking_duration") . " $max_duration_periods " .
 664                     (($max_duration_periods > 1) ? get_vocab("periods") : get_vocab("period_lc"));
 665       }
 666     }
 667     elseif ($booking['end_time'] - $booking['start_time'] > $max_duration_secs)
 668     {
 669       $max_duration = $max_duration_secs;
 670       toTimeString($max_duration, $units);
 671       $violations[] = get_vocab("max_booking_duration") . " $max_duration $units";
 672     }
 673   }
 674 
 675   // Check max number of bookings allowed per interval for this user for each of
 676   // the interval types, both globally and for the area
 677   foreach ($interval_types as $interval_type)
 678   {
 679     // globally
 680     // number of bookings
 681     if (!empty($max_per_interval_global_enabled[$interval_type]) && !$delete)
 682     {
 683       $tmp = check_interval($interval_type, $booking, $ignore_entry_id, $ignore_repeat_id, false);
 684       if (isset($tmp))
 685       {
 686         $violations[] = $tmp;
 687       }
 688     }
 689     // length of bookings
 690     if (!empty($max_secs_per_interval_global_enabled[$interval_type]) && !$delete)
 691     {
 692       $tmp = check_interval($interval_type, $booking, $ignore_entry_id, $ignore_repeat_id, false, true);
 693       if (isset($tmp))
 694       {
 695         $violations[] = $tmp;
 696       }
 697     }
 698     // for the area
 699     // number of bookings
 700     if (!empty($max_per_interval_area_enabled[$interval_type]) && !$delete)
 701     {
 702       $tmp = check_interval($interval_type, $booking, $ignore_entry_id, $ignore_repeat_id, true);
 703       if (isset($tmp))
 704       {
 705         $violations[] = $tmp;
 706       }
 707     }
 708     // length of bookings
 709     if (!empty($max_secs_per_interval_area_enabled[$interval_type]) && !$delete)
 710     {
 711       $tmp = check_interval($interval_type, $booking, $ignore_entry_id, $ignore_repeat_id, true, true);
 712       if (isset($tmp))
 713       {
 714         $violations[] = $tmp;
 715       }
 716     }
 717   }
 718 
 719   $result[$violation_status] = $violations;
 720 
 721   return $result;
 722 }

 756 // Returns the timestamp for a registration opening/closing boundary.
 757 // Takes account of periods, when registration closes at $periods_booking_opens
 758 // on the day of the booking, because we don't know when in the day periods occur.
 759 // This function compensates for DST changes, so that, for example, 1 week before
 760 // occurs at the same time of day as the start time, even if there's a DST
 761 // transition in between.
 762 function registration_boundary_timestamp(int $start_time, int $in_advance) : int
 763 {
 764   global $enable_periods, $periods_booking_opens;
 765 
 766   // If we're using periods set the time back to midnight
 767   if ($enable_periods)
 768   {
 769     $start_time = timestamp_set_time($start_time, $periods_booking_opens);
 770   }
 771 
 772   $boundary_time = $start_time - $in_advance;
 773 
 774   return $boundary_time - cross_dst($boundary_time, $start_time);
 775 }
 776 
 777 
 778 // Returns the Unix timestamp for registration opening.
 779 function registration_opens_timestamp(array $entry) : int
 780 {
 781   return registration_boundary_timestamp($entry['start_time'], $entry['registration_opens']);
 782 }
 783 
 784 
 785 // Returns the Unix timestamp for registration closing.
 786 function registration_closes_timestamp(array $entry) : int
 787 {
 788   return registration_boundary_timestamp($entry['start_time'], $entry['registration_closes']);
 789 }
 790 
 791 
 792 // Checks whether an entry is open for registration
 793 function entry_registration_is_open(array $entry) : bool
 794 {
 795   return (!$entry['registration_opens_enabled'] || (time() >= registration_opens_timestamp($entry))) &&
 796          (!$entry['registration_closes_enabled'] || (time() <= registration_closes_timestamp($entry)));
 797 }
 798 
 799 
 800 // Checks whether it is too late to cancel a registration, which is
 801 // after the closing time for registration, if there is one, or else
 802 // after the entry start time.
 803 function entry_registration_cancellation_has_closed(array $entry) : bool
 804 {
 805   global $enable_periods;
 806 
 807   if (!empty($entry['registration_closes_enabled']))
 808   {
 809     return (time() > registration_closes_timestamp($entry));
 810   }
 811 
 812   if ($enable_periods)
 813   {
 814     // Allow registration to be cancelled all the way up to the end of the
 815     // current day, because we don't know when in the day the period starts.
 816     $date = new DateTime();
 817     $date->setTimestamp($entry['start_time']);
 818     $date->setTime(0, 0);
 819     $date->modify('+1 day');
 820     return (time() > $date->getTimestamp());
 821   }
 822   else
 823   {
 824     return (time() > $entry['start_time']);
 825   }
 826 }

 837 // Add the registrants (indexed by 'username', 'create_by' and 'registered') to
 838 // the entry with id $entry_id
 839 function add_registrants(int $entry_id, array $registrants) : void
 840 {
 841   if (empty($registrants))
 842   {

 846   $sql_params = array(':entry_id' => $entry_id);
 847   $values = array();

 849   foreach ($registrants as $i => $registrant)
 850   {
 851     $sql_params[":username$i"] = $registrant['username'];
 852     $sql_params[":create_by$i"] = $registrant['create_by'];
 853     $sql_params[":registered$i"] = $registrant['registered'];
 854     $values[] = "(:entry_id, :username$i, :create_by$i, :registered$i)";
 855   }
 856 
 857   $sql = "INSERT INTO " . _tbl('participants') . " (entry_id, username, create_by, registered) VALUES " .
 858          implode(', ', $values);
 859 
 860   db()->command($sql, $sql_params);

 864 // Get all the entries for the area with $area_id in the interval that starts at $start_date
 865 // and ends at $end_date (both DateTime objects).  Only get entries for enabled rooms.
 866 // Returns an array of entries.   Each element of the array is itself an array with keys
 867 // corresponding to the entry table columns
 868 function get_entries_by_area(int $area_id, DateTime $start_date, DateTime $end_date) : array
 869 {
 870   // The GROUP BY is necessary to get n_registered to work
 871   $sql = "SELECT E.*, " .
 872                  db()->syntax_timestamp_to_unix("E.timestamp") . " AS last_updated,
 873                  COUNT(P.entry_id) AS n_registered
 874             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " E
 875        LEFT JOIN " . _tbl('room') . " R ON E.room_id = R.id
 876        LEFT JOIN " . _tbl('participants') . " P ON P.entry_id = E.id
 877            WHERE R.area_id = :area_id
 878              AND R.disabled = 0
 879              AND start_time < :interval_end AND end_time > :interval_start
 880         GROUP BY E.id
 881         ORDER BY start_time, E.id";   // necessary so that multiple bookings appear in the right order
 882 
 883   $sql_params = [
 884     ':area_id' => $area_id,
 885     ':interval_end' => $end_date->getTimestamp(),
 886     ':interval_start' => $start_date->getTimestamp()
 887   ];
 888 
 889   $res = db()->query($sql, $sql_params);
 890 
 891   $result = $res->all_rows_keyed();
 892 
 893   foreach ($result as &$row)
 894   {
 895     row_cast_columns($row, 'entry');
 896     unpack_status($row);
 897   }
 898   unset($row);
 899 
 900   return $result;
 901 }

 909            WHERE room_id=:room_id";
 910 
 911   return db()->query1($sql, [':room_id' => $room_id]);

 914 
 915 // Get all the entries for the room with $room_id in the interval that starts at $start_date (if set)
 916 // and ends at $end_date (if set) (both DateTime objects).  The sort order is ASC by default, but
 917 // DESC if $desc is TRUE.  If $limit is set then only $limit entries are returned.
 918 // Returns an array of entries.   Each element of the array is itself an array with keys
 919 // corresponding to the entry table columns
 920 function get_entries_by_room(int $room_id, ?DateTime $start_date, ?DateTime $end_date, bool $desc=false, ?int $limit=null) : array
 921 {
 922   $sql_params = [':room_id' => $room_id];
 923 
 924   // The GROUP BY is necessary to get n_registered to work
 925   $sql = "SELECT E.*, " .
 926                  db()->syntax_timestamp_to_unix("E.timestamp") . " AS last_updated,
 927                  COUNT(P.entry_id) AS n_registered
 928             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " E
 929        LEFT JOIN " . _tbl('participants') . " P ON P.entry_id = E.id
 930            WHERE room_id = :room_id";
 931 
 932   if (isset($start_date))
 933   {
 934     $sql_params[':interval_start'] = $start_date->getTimestamp();
 935     $sql .= " AND end_time > :interval_start";
 936   }
 937   if (isset($end_date))
 938   {
 939     $sql_params[':interval_end'] = $end_date->getTimestamp();
 940     $sql .= " AND start_time < :interval_end";
 941   }
 942 
 943   $sql .= " GROUP BY E.id";
 944   $order = ($desc) ? 'DESC' : 'ASC';
 945   $sql .= " ORDER BY start_time $order, id $order"; // necessary so that multiple bookings appear in the right order
 946 
 947   if (isset($limit))
 948   {
 949     // The LIMIT parameter should ideally be one of the parameters to the
 950     // query, but MySQL throws an error at the moment because it gets bound
 951     // as a string.  Doesn't matter in this case because we know $limit is
 952     // an integer, but for the general case MRBS needs to provide the ability
 953     // to bind it as an integer.
 954     $sql .= " LIMIT $limit";
 955   }
 956 
 957   $res = db()->query($sql, $sql_params);
 958 
 959   $result = $res->all_rows_keyed();
 960 
 961   foreach ($result as &$row)
 962   {
 963     row_cast_columns($row, 'entry');
 964     unpack_status($row);
 965   }
 966   unset($row);
 967 
 968   return $result;
 969 }

 972 function get_entry_times_by_user(
 973   string $create_by,
 974   int $interval_start,
 975   ?int $interval_end=null,
 976   ?int $area_id=null,
 977   bool $exclude_periods=false,
 978   ?int $ignore_entry_id=null,
 979   ?int $ignore_repeat_id=null) : array
 980 {
 981   $sql = "SELECT E.start_time, E.end_time
 982                 FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " E, " . _tbl('room') . " R, " . _tbl('area') . " A
 983                WHERE E.end_time > :interval_start
 984                  AND E.create_by = :create_by
 985                  AND E.room_id = R.id
 986                  AND R.area_id = A.id
 987                  AND R.disabled = 0
 988                  AND A.disabled = 0";
 989 
 990   $sql_params = array(
 991     ':interval_start' => $interval_start,
 992     ':create_by' => $create_by
 993   );
 994 
 995   if (isset($interval_end))
 996   {
 997     $sql .= " AND E.start_time < :interval_end";
 998     $sql_params[':interval_end'] = $interval_end;
 999   }
1000 
1001   if ($exclude_periods)
1002   {
1003     // If we're checking for the actual time of bookings, then exclude areas using periods
1004     $sql .= " AND A.enable_periods=0";
1005   }
1006   if (isset($area_id))
1007   {
1008     $sql .= " AND R.area_id = :area_id";
1009     $sql_params[':area_id'] = $area_id;
1010   }
1011   if (isset($ignore_entry_id))
1012   {
1013     $sql .= " AND E.id <> :ignore_entry_id";
1014     $sql_params[':ignore_entry_id'] = $ignore_entry_id;
1015   }
1016   if (isset($ignore_repeat_id))
1017   {
1018     $sql .= " AND (E.repeat_id IS NULL OR E.repeat_id <> :ignore_repeat_id)";
1019     $sql_params[':ignore_repeat_id'] = $ignore_repeat_id;
1020   }
1021 
1022   $res = db()->query($sql, $sql_params);
1023 
1024   $result = array();
1025 
1026   while (false !== ($row = $res->next_row_keyed()))
1027   {
1028     $result[] = $row;
1029   }
1030 
1031   return $result;
1032 }

1035 // Get the number of outstanding (ie waiting to be approved) for a user
1036 function get_entries_n_outstanding(User $user) : int
1037 {
1038   $sql_approval_enabled = some_area_predicate('approval_enabled');
1039 
1040   // Find out how many bookings are awaiting approval
1041   // (but only for areas where approval is required)
1042   $sql = "SELECT room_id, create_by
1043             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " E, " . _tbl('room') . " R, " . _tbl('area') . " A
1044            WHERE (status&" . STATUS_AWAITING_APPROVAL . " != 0)
1045              AND E.room_id = R.id
1046              AND R.area_id = A.id
1047              AND R.disabled = 0
1048              AND A.disabled = 0
1049              AND $sql_approval_enabled";
1050 
1051   $res = db()->query($sql);
1052 
1053   $result = 0;
1054 
1055   // Get this user's own bookings awaiting approval or those made by others in rooms
1056   // for which this user is a booking admin.
1057   while (false !== ($row = $res->next_row_keyed()))
1058   {
1059     if ((strcasecmp_locale($row['create_by'], $user->username) === 0) || is_book_admin($row['room_id']))
1060     {
1061       $result++;
1062     }
1063   }
1064 
1065   return $result;
1066 }

1069 /** mrbsDelEntry()
1070  *
1071  * Delete an entry, or optionally all entries.   Will also delete any newly
1072  * orphaned rows in the repeat table.
1073  *
1074  * $id     - The entry to delete
1075  * $series - If set, delete the series, except user modified entries
1076  * $all    - If set, include user modified entries in the series delete
1077  *
1078  * Returns FALSE if an error occurred, otherwise an array of start_times that
1079  * have been deleted.
1080  *
1081  */
1082 function mrbsDelEntry(int $id, bool $series, bool $all)
1083 {
1084   $start_times = array();
1085 
1086   // Get the repeat_id and room_id for this entry
1087   $sql = "SELECT repeat_id, room_id
1088             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . "
1089            WHERE id=?
1090            LIMIT 1";
1091   $res = db()->query($sql, array($id));
1092   if ($res->count() <= 0)
1093   {
1094     return FALSE;
1095   }
1096   $row = $res->next_row_keyed();
1097   row_cast_columns($row, 'entry');
1098   $repeat_id = $row['repeat_id'];
1099   $room_id = $row['room_id'];
1100 
1101   $sql = "SELECT * FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " WHERE ";
1102 
1103   $sql_params = array();
1104 
1105   if ($series)
1106   {
1107     $sql .= "repeat_id=?";
1108     $sql_params[] = $repeat_id;
1109   }
1110   else
1111   {
1112     $sql .= "id=?";
1113     $sql_params[] = $id;
1114   }
1115 
1116   $res = db()->query($sql, $sql_params);
1117 
1118   while (false !== ($row = $res->next_row_keyed()))
1119   {
1120     row_cast_columns($row, 'entry');
1121     unpack_status($row);
1122 
1123     if(!getWritable($row['create_by'], $room_id))
1124     {
1125       continue;
1126     }
1127 
1128     if ($series && $row['entry_type'] == ENTRY_RPT_CHANGED && !$all)
1129     {
1130       continue;
1131     }
1132 
1133     // check that the booking policies allow us to delete this entry
1134     $tmp = mrbsCheckPolicy($row, null, null, true);
1135 
1136     if (empty($tmp['errors']))
1137     {
1138       $sql = "DELETE FROM " . _tbl('entry') . " WHERE id=?";
1139       if (db()->command($sql, array($row['id'])) > 0)
1140       {
1141         $start_times[] = $row['start_time'];
1142       }
1143     }
1144   }
1145 
1146   // Get rid of any orphaned rows in the repeat table
1147   $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*)
1148             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . "
1149            WHERE repeat_id=?";
1150   if (!empty($repeat_id) && (db()->query1($sql, array($repeat_id)) == 0))
1151   {
1152     $sql = "DELETE FROM " . _tbl('repeat') . " WHERE id=?";
1153     db()->command($sql, array($repeat_id));
1154   }
1155 
1156   asort($start_times);
1157   return $start_times;
1158 }
1159 
1160 
1161 /** mrbsCreateEntry()
1162  *
1163  * Create an entry in the database
1164  *
1165  * $table         - The table in which to create the entry
1166  * $data          - An array containing the row data for the entry
1167  *
1168  * Returns:
1169  *   0        - An error occurred while inserting the entry
1170  *   non-zero - The entry's ID
1171  */
1172 function mrbsCreateEntry(string $table, array $data) : int
1173 {
1174   global $standard_fields;
1175 
1176   $sql_col = array();
1177   $sql_val = array();
1178 
1179   $table_short_name = get_table_short_name($table);
1180   $fields = db()->field_info($table);
1181 
1182   $sql_params = array();
1183 
1184   // Pack the status fields into the bit map
1185   pack_status($data);
1186 
1187   foreach ($fields as $field)
1188   {
1189     $key = $field['name'];
1190 
1191     // Check to see whether custom field names obey the MRBS rules.   If we don't check
1192     // other parts of the code will run without producing PHP or SQL errors but will give
1193     // the wrong results.   A bit of a crude check, and in due course we probably ought to
1194     // allow custom fields with spaces in them (or else have custom fields created by MRBS).
1195     if (mb_strpos($key, ' ') !== FALSE)
1196     {
1197       Errors::fatalError("Custom field names cannot contain spaces.");
1198     }
1199 
1200     // If the key doesn't exist in the $data array then the database will just use its
1201     // default value for the column.    If it does exist and is set to NULL then we'll
1202     // write NULL to the database (which may not necessarily be the default value).
1203     if (array_key_exists($key, $data))
1204     {
1205       switch ($key)
1206       {
1207         // booleans
1208         case 'allow_registration':
1209         case 'registrant_limit_enabled':
1210         case 'registration_opens_enabled':
1211         case 'registration_closes_enabled':
1212           if (isset($data[$key]))
1213           {
1214             $sql_col[] = $key;
1215             $sql_val[] = '?';
1216             $sql_params[] = ($data[$key]) ? 1 : 0;
1217           }
1218           break;
1219 
1220         // integers
1221         case 'start_time':
1222         case 'end_time':
1223         case 'entry_type':
1224         case 'repeat_id':
1225         case 'room_id':
1226         case 'status':
1227         case 'ical_sequence':
1228           $sql_col[] = $key;
1229           $sql_val[] = '?';
1230           $sql_params[] = (isset($data[$key])) ? (int)$data[$key] : null;
1231           break;
1232 
1233         // integers NOT NULL
1234         case 'registrant_limit':
1235         case 'registration_opens':
1236         case 'registration_closes':
1237           if (isset($data[$key]))
1238           {
1239             $sql_col[] = $key;
1240             $sql_val[] = '?';
1241             $sql_params[] = (int)$data[$key];
1242           }
1243           break;
1244 
1245         // strings
1246         case 'create_by':
1247         case 'modified_by':
1248         case 'name':
1249         case 'type':
1250         case 'description':
1251         case 'ical_uid':
1252         case 'ical_recur_id':
1253           $sql_col[] = $key;
1254           $sql_val[] = '?';
1255           $sql_params[] = (isset($data[$key])) ? $data[$key] : null;
1256           break;
1257 
1258         default:
1259           // custom fields
1260           // We handle the repeat data separately
1261           $repeat_fields = [
1262             'repeat_rule',
1263             'rep_type',
1264             'rep_opt',
1265             'rep_interval',
1266             'month_absolute',
1267             'month_relative'
1268           ];
1269 
1270           if (!in_array($key, $standard_fields[$table_short_name]) &&
1271               !in_array($key, $repeat_fields))
1272           {
1273             $sql_col[] = $key;
1274 
1275             // Depending on the nature of the custom field the treatment will vary
1276             switch ($field['nature'])
1277             {
1278               case 'integer':
1279                 if (!isset($data[$key]) || ($data[$key] === ''))
1280                 {
1281                   // Try and set it to NULL when we can because there will be cases when we
1282                   // want to distinguish between NULL and 0 - especially when the field
1283                   // is a genuine integer.
1284                   $value = ($field['is_nullable']) ? null : 0;
1285                 }
1286                 else
1287                 {
1288                   $value = (int)$data[$key];
1289                 }
1290                 break;
1291               default:
1292                 if (!isset($data[$key]))
1293                 {
1294                   $value = ($field['is_nullable']) ? null : '';
1295                 }
1296                 else
1297                 {
1298                   $value = $data[$key];
1299                 }
1300                 break;
1301             } // switch ($field_natures[$key])
1302 
1303             $sql_val[] = '?';
1304             $sql_params[] = $value;
1305           }
1306           // do nothing for fields that aren't custom or otherwise listed above
1307           break;
1308 
1309       } // switch ($key)
1310     } // if
1311   } // foreach
1312 
1313   // Add in the repeat data for the repeat table
1314   if ($table_short_name == 'repeat')
1315   {
1316     $repeat_rule = $data['repeat_rule'];
1317     $sql_col[] = 'rep_type';
1318     $sql_val[] = '?';
1319     $sql_params[] = $repeat_rule->getType();
1320 
1321     $sql_col[] = 'end_date';
1322     $sql_val[] = '?';
1323     $end_date = $repeat_rule->getEndDate();
1324     $sql_params[] = (isset($end_date)) ? $end_date->getTimestamp() : null;
1325 
1326     // special case - rep_interval
1327     $rep_interval = $repeat_rule->getInterval();
1328     if (isset($rep_interval)) {
1329       $sql_col[] = 'rep_interval';
1330       $sql_val[] = '?';
1331       $sql_params[] = $rep_interval;
1332     }
1333 
1334     $sql_col[] = 'rep_opt';
1335     $sql_val[] = '?';
1336     $sql_params[] = $repeat_rule->getRepOpt();
1337 
1338     $sql_col[] = 'month_absolute';
1339     $sql_val[] = '?';
1340     $sql_params[] = $repeat_rule->getMonthlyAbsolute();
1341 
1342     $sql_col[] = 'month_relative';
1343     $sql_val[] = '?';
1344     $sql_params[] = $repeat_rule->getMonthlyRelative();
1345   }
1346 
1347   foreach ($sql_col as &$col)
1348   {
1349     $col = db()->quote($col);
1350   }
1351 
1352   $sql = "INSERT INTO $table (" . implode(', ', $sql_col) . ") VALUES (" . implode(', ',$sql_val) . ")";
1353 
1354   db()->command($sql, $sql_params);
1355 
1356   return db()->insert_id($table, "id");
1357 }

1359 /** mrbsCreateSingleEntry()
1360  *
1361  * Create a single (non-repeating) entry in the database
1362  *
1363  * $data      - An array containing the entry details
1364  *
1365  * Returns:
1366  *   0        - An error occurred while inserting the entry
1367  *   non-zero - The entry's ID
1368  */
1369 function mrbsCreateSingleEntry(array $data) : int
1370 {
1371   // Make sure that any entry is of a positive duration.
1372   // This is to trap potential negative duration created when DST comes
1373   // into effect
1374   if ($data['end_time'] > $data['start_time'])
1375   {
1376     // If we're about to create an individual member of a series for the first time
1377     // then give it a recurrence-id equivalent to the start time.  It should always
1378     // keep this value, even if the start time is subsequently changed.
1379     if ($data['entry_type'] == ENTRY_RPT_ORIGINAL)
1380     {
1381       $data['ical_recur_id'] = gmdate(RFC5545::DATETIME_FORMAT . '\Z', $data['start_time']);
1382     }
1383     return mrbsCreateEntry(_tbl('entry'), $data);
1384   }
1385   else
1386   {
1387     return 0;
1388   }
1389 }
1390 
1391 /** mrbsCreateRepeatEntry()
1392  *
1393  * Creates a repeat entry in the data base
1394  *
1395  * $data      - An array containing the entry details
1396  *
1397  * Returns:
1398  *   0        - An error occurred while inserting the entry
1399  *   non-zero - The entry's ID
1400  */
1401 function mrbsCreateRepeatEntry(array $data)
1402 {
1403   return mrbsCreateEntry(_tbl('repeat'), $data);
1404 }
1405 
1406 
1407 /** mrbsCreateRepeatingEntrys()
1408  *
1409  * Creates a repeat entry in the database + all the repeating entries
1410  *
1411  * $data      - An array containing the entry details
1412  *
1413  * Returns:
1414  *   an array
1415  *   ['id']          - 0 if an error occurred or if no bookings could be
1416  *                     made, otherwise an id
1417  *   ['series']      - boolean: TRUE if the id refers to the repeat table
1418  *                              FALSE if the id refers to the entry table
1419  *   ['start_times'] - an array of start times that have been created
1420  *
1421  */
1422 function mrbsCreateRepeatingEntrys(array $data) : array
1423 {
1424   global $max_rep_entrys;
1425 
1426   $result = array('id' => 0, 'series' => false, 'start_times' => array());
1427 
1428   if (!isset($data['skip_list']))
1429   {
1430     $data['skip_list'] = array();
1431   }
1432 
1433   $reps = $data['repeat_rule']->getRepeatStartTimes($data['start_time'], $max_rep_entrys);
1434 
1435   // Don't make any bookings if
1436   // (a) we've been asked to book up more entries than we are
1437   //     allowed in a single repeat, or
1438   // (b) the repeat results in an empty set, or
1439   // (c) we've got to skip past all the entries
1440   if ((count($reps) > $max_rep_entrys) ||
1441       (count($reps) == 0) ||
1442       (count($reps) == count($data['skip_list'])))
1443   {
1444     $result['id'] = 0;
1445     return $result;
1446   }
1447 
1448   // Maybe one should also consider adjusting the start_time for
1449   // the repeat if the first (or more) entries of the series are
1450   // to be skipped.    However I haven't done so here and it gives the
1451   // maybe slightly strange result that the start date of the series won't
1452   // have an entry on that date.   But then this is no different from
1453   // the way MRBS works at present if you create a series and then
1454   // delete the first entry.
1455   //
1456   // Note also that RFC 5545 allows this behaviour in 3.8.5.1:
1457   //   'The "EXDATE" property can be used to exclude the value specified
1458   //    in "DTSTART".  However, in such cases, the original "DTSTART" date
1459   //    MUST still be maintained by the calendaring and scheduling system
1460   //    because the original "DTSTART" value has inherent usage
1461   //    dependencies by other properties such as the "RECURRENCE-ID".'
1462 
1463   $id = mrbsCreateRepeatEntry($data);
1464 
1465   if ($id)
1466   {
1467     $data['entry_type'] = ENTRY_RPT_ORIGINAL;
1468     $data['repeat_id'] = $id;
1469     $start_time = $data['start_time'];
1470     $end_time = $data['end_time'];
1471     // Even if there is only one entry in the series we treat the booking
1472     // as a series rather than a single booking.   It allows the series to
1473     // be extended later.
1474     for ($i = 0; $i < count($reps); $i++)
1475     {
1476       // Provided this isn't one of the entries to skip, go ahead
1477       // and make the booking
1478       if (!in_array($reps[$i], $data['skip_list']))
1479       {
1480         // calculate diff each time and correct where events
1481         // cross DST
1482         $diff = $end_time - $start_time;
1483         $diff += cross_dst($reps[$i], $reps[$i] + $diff);
1484         $data['start_time'] = $reps[$i];
1485         $data['end_time'] = $reps[$i] + $diff;
1486 
1487         $ent_id = mrbsCreateSingleEntry($data);
1488         $result['start_times'][] = $data['start_time'];
1489       }
1490     }
1491   }
1492   $result['id'] = $id;
1493   $result['series'] = TRUE;
1494   return $result;
1495 }

1498 // Gets the repeat_id for an entry in the entry table with id $entry_id
1499 // Returns the repeat_id or NULL
1500 function get_repeat_id(int $entry_id) : ?int
1501 {
1502   $sql = "SELECT repeat_id
1503             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . "
1504            WHERE id=?
1505            LIMIT 1";
1506 
1507   $res = db()->query($sql, array($entry_id));
1508 
1509   if ($res->count() == 0)
1510   {
1511     // This should not happen
1512     trigger_error('$entry_id=' . "$entry_id does not exist.", E_USER_NOTICE);
1513     return null;
1514   }
1515 
1516   $row = $res->next_row_keyed();
1517   return (isset($row['repeat_id'])) ? (int) $row['repeat_id'] : null;
1518 }

1540 // Update the time of last reminding.
1541 // If the entry is part of a repeating series, then also increment
1542 // the last reminder time in the repeat table and all the individual
1543 // entries.  (Although strictly speaking the reminder time should apply
1544 // either to a series or an individual entry, we update everything to
1545 // prevent users bombarding admins with reminder emails)
1546 //
1547 // Returns the number of tuples affected if OK (a number >= 0).
1548 // Returns -1 on error; use the DB class error() method to get the error message.
1549 function update_last_reminded($id, $series)
1550 {
1551   $now = time();
1552   if ($series)
1553   {
1554     $sql = "UPDATE " . _tbl('repeat') . "
1555                SET reminded=?,
1556                    ical_sequence=ical_sequence+1
1557              WHERE id=?";
1558     db()->command($sql, array($now, $id));
1559 
1560     $sql = "UPDATE " . _tbl('entry') . "
1561                SET reminded=?,
1562                    ical_sequence=ical_sequence+1
1563              WHERE repeat_id=?";
1564     return db()->command($sql, array($now, $id));
1565   }
1566   else
1567   {
1568     $sql = "UPDATE " . _tbl('entry') . "
1569                SET reminded=?,
1570                    ical_sequence=ical_sequence+1
1571              WHERE id=?";
1572     if (db()->command($sql, array($now,$id)) > 0)
1573     {
1574       $repeat_id = get_repeat_id($id);
1575       if (isset($repeat_id))
1576       {
1577         $sql = "UPDATE " . _tbl('repeat') . "
1578                    SET reminded=?,
1579                        ical_sequence=ical_sequence+1
1580                  WHERE id=?";
1581         return db()->command($sql, array($now,$id));
1582       }
1583     }
1584   }
1585   return -1;
1586 }

1588 // Update the entry/repeat tables with details about the last More Info
1589 // request (time, user, email text)
1590 //
1591 // If $series is TRUE then $id is the id of an entry in the repeat table
1592 // which is updated.   Otherwise $id is the id of an entry in the
1593 // entry table, which is updated.
1594 //
1595 // Returns the number of tuples affected if OK (a number >= 0).
1596 // Returns -1 on error; use the DB class error() method to get the error
1597 // message.
1598 function update_more_info($id, $series, $user, $note)
1599 {
1600   $table = ($series) ? _tbl('repeat') : _tbl('entry');
1601   $now = time();
1602 
1603   $sql_params = array();
1604   $sql = "UPDATE $table SET";
1605   $sql .= " info_time=?";
1606   $sql_params[] = $now;
1607   $sql .= ", info_user=?";
1608   $sql_params[] = $user;
1609   $sql .= ", info_text=?";
1610   $sql_params[] = $note;
1611   $sql .= " WHERE id=?";
1612   $sql_params[] = $id;
1613   return db()->command($sql, $sql_params);
1614 }

1616 // mrbsApproveEntry($id, $series)
1617 //
1618 // Approve an entry with id $id.   If series is set to TRUE
1619 // then the id is the id in the repeat table and we must approve
1620 // all the individual entries.
1621 // We also update the ical_sequence number so that any emails that
1622 // are generated will be treated by calendar clients as referring
1623 // to the same meeting, rather than a new meeting.
1624 //
1625 // Returns FALSE on failure, otherwise an array of start times that
1626 // have been approved
1627 function mrbsApproveEntry($id, $series)
1628 {
1629   if ($series)
1630   {
1631     // First update the repeat table if it's a series
1632     $sql = "UPDATE " . _tbl('repeat') . "
1633                SET status=status&(~" . STATUS_AWAITING_APPROVAL . "),
1634                    ical_sequence=ical_sequence+1
1635              WHERE id=?";  // PostgreSQL does not support LIMIT with UPDATE
1636     db()->command($sql, array($id));
1637     $id_column = 'repeat_id';
1638   }
1639   else
1640   {
1641     $id_column = 'id';
1642   }
1643   // Then update the entry table.  First of all we get a list of the
1644   // start times that will be approved, then we do the approval.
1645   $condition = "$id_column=? AND status&" . STATUS_AWAITING_APPROVAL . "!=0";
1646   $sql_params = array($id);
1647   $sql = "SELECT start_time
1648             FROM " . _tbl('entry') . "
1649            WHERE $condition";
1650   $start_times = db()->query_array($sql, $sql_params);
1651 
1652   if (($start_times !== FALSE) && (count($start_times) != 0))
1653   {
1654     $sql = "UPDATE " . _tbl('entry') . "
1655                SET status=status&(~" . STATUS_AWAITING_APPROVAL . "),
1656                    ical_sequence=ical_sequence+1
1657              WHERE $condition";  // PostgreSQL does not support LIMIT with UPDATE
1658 
1659     db()->command($sql, $sql_params);
1660   }
1661 
1662   if (is_array($start_times))
1663   {
1664     asort($start_times);
1665   }
1666 
1667   return $start_times;
1668 }
