1759 
1760 // get_booking_info($id, $series)
1761 //
1762 // Gets all the details for a booking with $id, which is in the
1763 // repeat table if $series is set, otherwise in the entry table.
1764 
1765 // Returns the results in an array with keys the same as the table
1766 // field names.  In the event of an error stops with a fatal error,
1767 // unless $silent is TRUE, when it returns FALSE.
1768 function get_booking_info(int $id, bool $series, bool $silent=false)
1769 {
1770   // Check that we've got an id
1771   if (!isset($id))
1772   {
1773     trigger_error("id not set", E_USER_WARNING);
1774     if ($silent)
1775     {
1776       return false;
1777     }
1778     else
1779     {
1780       Errors::fatalError(($series ? get_vocab("invalid_series_id") : get_vocab("invalid_entry_id")));
1781     }
1782   }
1783 
1784   $table = ($series) ? _tbl('repeat') : _tbl('entry');
1785 
1786   $columns = Columns::getInstance($table);
1787 
1788   if (!$series)
1789   {
1790     // Build an array of the column names in the repeat table so that
1791     // we'll be able to do some sanity checking later
1792     $repeat_columns = Columns::getInstance(_tbl('repeat'));
1793     $repeat_column_names = $repeat_columns->getNames();
1794   }
1795 
1796   $terms = array(
1797       'M.room_name',
1798       'M.room_admin_email',
1799       'M.area_id',
1800       'A.area_name',
1801       'A.area_admin_email',
1802       'M.disabled AS room_disabled',
1803       'A.disabled AS area_disabled',
1804       'A.enable_periods',
1805       '(end_time - start_time) AS duration'
1806     );
1807 
1808   foreach ($columns as $column)
1809   {
1810     switch ($column->name)
1811     {
1812       // these fields only exist in the entry table
1813       case 'entry_type':
1814       case 'repeat_id':
1815       case 'ical_recur_id':
1816       case 'allow_registration':
1817       case 'registrant_limit':
1818       case 'registrant_limit_enabled':
1819       case 'registration_opens':
1820       case 'registration_opens_enabled':
1821       case 'registration_closes':
1822       case 'registration_closes_enabled':
1823         array_push($terms, $column->name);
1824         break;
1825 
1826       case 'timestamp':
1827         array_push($terms, db()->syntax_timestamp_to_unix("timestamp") . " AS last_updated");
1828         break;
1829 
1830       case 'info_time':
1831       case 'info_user':
1832       case 'info_text':
1833         if ($series)
1834         {
1835           array_push($terms, $column->name . " AS repeat_" . $column->name);
1836         }
1837         else
1838         {
1839           array_push($terms, $column->name . " AS entry_" . $column->name);
1840         }
1841         break;
1842 
1843       default:
1844         // These are (a) all the standard fields which are common to the entry
1845         // and repeat tables and (b) all the custom fields, which should be
1846         // common to the two tables (we will do a check to make sure)
1847         if (!$series && !in_array($column->name, $repeat_column_names))
1848         {
1849           // If this is the entry table then check that the custom field also
1850           // exists in the repeat table
1851           Errors::fatalError("Custom fields problem, '" . $column->name . "' exists in entry table but not in repeat table");
1852         }
1853 
1854         array_push($terms, "T." . db()->quote($column->name));
1855         break;
1856     }
1857   }
1858 
1859   $sql = "SELECT " . implode(", ",$terms)."
1860             FROM $table T, " . _tbl('room') . " M, " . _tbl('area') . " A
1861            WHERE T.room_id = M.id
1862              AND M.area_id = A.id
1863              AND T.id=?";
1864 
1865   try
1866   {
1867     $res = db()->query($sql, array($id));
1868   }
1869   catch (DBException $e)
1870   {
1871     // Not sure why we've got the silent option in here.  Need to revisit this sometime.
1872     trigger_error(db()->error(), E_USER_WARNING);
1873     if ($silent)
1874     {
1875       return false;
1876     }
1877     else
1878     {
1879       throw $e;
1880     }
1881   }
1882 
1883   $row = $res->next_row_keyed();
1884   unset($res);
1885 
1886   if (!is_array($row) || (!is_visible($row['room_id'])))
1887   {
1888     // It's quite possible that the id will have disappeared, eg if somebody
1889     // else has deleted or edited the entry, or if the back button is pressed
1890     // after deleting an entry.
1891     if ($silent)
1892     {
1893       return false;
1894     }
1895     else
1896     {
1897       Errors::fatalError(($series ? get_vocab("invalid_series_id") : get_vocab("invalid_entry_id")));
1898     }
1899   }
1900 
1901   // Cast the columns to their intended types
1902   row_cast_columns($row, ($series) ? 'repeat' : 'entry');
1903   // These two columns need special casting as they have been renamed
1904   if (isset($row['entry_info_time']))
1905   {
1906     $row['entry_info_time'] = intval($row['entry_info_time']);
1907   }
1908   if (isset($row['repeat_info_time']))
1909   {
1910     $row['repeat_info_time'] = intval($row['repeat_info_time']);
1911   }
1912 
1913   $row['area_id'] = intval($row['area_id']); // Necessary for some databases
1914   $row['enable_periods'] = boolval($row['enable_periods']);
1915 
1916   // Turn the last_updated column into an int (some MySQL drivers will return a string,
1917   // and it won't have been caught by row_cast_columns as it's a derived result).
1918   $row['last_updated'] = intval($row['last_updated']);
1919 
1920   // Fix a problem in earlier versions of MRBS that caused the end time for periods bookings
1921   // that crossed a DST boundary in areas with a single period to be incorrectly recorded in
1922   // the database (see GitHub Issue #3628).  Round the endtime down to the end of the nearest
1923   // valid period.
1924   // TODO: This is only a temporary fix.  We should really do a one-off clean-up of the database
1925   // TODO: via an upgrade, but this will probably have to wait until the roles branch is
1926   // TODO: reintegrated.
1927   if ($row['enable_periods'])
1928   {
1929     $period_names = get_period_names();
1930     $n_periods = count($period_names[$row['area_id']]);
1931     $area_details = get_area_details($row['area_id']);
1932     $end_date = new DateTime('now', new DateTimeZone($area_details['timezone']));
1933     $end_date->setTimestamp($row['end_time']);
1934     $hour = $end_date->getHour();
1935     // If the time is between midnight and the start of the first period, then
1936     // wind the end date back to the end of the previous day.
1937     if ($hour < 12)
1938     {
1939       $end_date->setTime(23, 59);
1940       $end_date->modify('-1 day');
1941     }
1942     // And if the time is now past the end of the last period, then wind it
1943     // back to that point and adjust the end time.
1944     $end_last_period = clone $end_date;
1945     $end_last_period->setTime(12, $n_periods);
1946     if ($end_date > $end_last_period)
1947     {
1948       $row['end_time'] = $end_last_period->getTimestamp();
1949     }
1950   }
1951 
1952   // Now get the duration.
1953   // Don't translate the units at this stage.   We'll translate them later.
1954   $d = get_duration($row['start_time'], $row['end_time'], $row['enable_periods'], $row['area_id'], false);
1955   $row['duration'] = $d['duration'];
1956   $row['dur_units'] = $d['dur_units'];
1957 
1958   // Translate the status field into a set of booleans
1959   unpack_status($row);
1960 
1961   // Get some extra information
1962   $row['registrants'] = get_registrants($id, $series);
1963 
1964   if ($series)
1965   {
1966     $row['entry_info_time'] = '';
1967     $row['entry_info_user'] = '';
1968     $row['entry_info_text'] = '';
1969   }
1970   else
1971   {
1972     // Get the repeat information
1973     if (!isset($row['repeat_id']))
1974     {
1975       $row['repeat_info_time'] = '';
1976       $row['repeat_info_user'] = '';
1977       $row['repeat_info_text'] = '';
1978     }
1979     else
1980     {
1981       $sql = "SELECT rep_type, end_date, rep_opt, rep_interval, month_absolute, month_relative,
1982                      info_time AS repeat_info_time, info_user AS repeat_info_user,
1983                      info_text AS repeat_info_text
1984                 FROM " . _tbl('repeat') . "
1985                WHERE id=?
1986                LIMIT 1";
1987       $res = db()->query($sql, array($row['repeat_id']));
1988 
1989       if (!$extra_row = $res->next_row_keyed())
1990       {
1991         if (!$res)
1992         {
1993           trigger_error(db()->error(), E_USER_WARNING);
1994         }
1995         if ($silent)
1996         {
1997           return false;
1998         }
1999         else
2000         {
2001           Errors::fatalError(get_vocab("invalid_series_id"));
2002         }
2003       }
2004 
2005       // Cast the columns to their intended types
2006       row_cast_columns($extra_row, 'repeat');
2007 
2008       $row['repeat_info_time'] = $extra_row['repeat_info_time'];
2009       $row['repeat_info_user'] = $extra_row['repeat_info_user'];
2010       $row['repeat_info_text'] = $extra_row['repeat_info_text'];
2011       unset($res);
2012     }
2013   }
2014 
2015   // Add the repeat information
2016   $repeat_rule = new RepeatRule();
2017   if (!$series && !isset($row['repeat_id']))
2018   {
2019     $repeat_rule->setType(RepeatRule::NONE);
2020   }
2021   else
2022   {
2023     $repeat_row = ($series) ? $row : $extra_row;
2024     $repeat_rule->setType($repeat_row['rep_type']);
2025     $end_date = new DateTime();
2026     $end_date->setTimestamp($repeat_row['end_date']);
2027     $repeat_rule->setEndDate($end_date);
2028     $repeat_rule->setInterval($repeat_row['rep_interval']);
2029     $repeat_rule->setDaysFromOpt($repeat_row['rep_opt']);
2030     if ($repeat_row['rep_type'] == RepeatRule::MONTHLY) {
2031       if (isset($repeat_row['month_absolute'])) {
2032         $repeat_rule->setMonthlyType(RepeatRule::MONTHLY_ABSOLUTE);
2033         $repeat_rule->setMonthlyAbsolute($repeat_row['month_absolute']);
2034       }
2035       else {
2036         $repeat_rule->setMonthlyType(RepeatRule::MONTHLY_RELATIVE);
2037         $repeat_rule->setMonthlyRelative($repeat_row['month_relative']);
2038       }
2039     }
2040   }
2041 
2042   $row['repeat_rule'] = $repeat_rule;
2043 
2044   // TODO: remove temporary code when the transition to RepeatRule is complete
2045   $row = RepeatRule::fixUp($row);
2046 
2047   return $row;
2048 }

2334 
2335 // Adds an area, returning the new id, or FALSE on failure with the
2336 // error in $error
2337 function mrbsAddArea($name, &$error)
2338 {
2339   global $area_defaults, $boolean_fields;
2340 
2341   // First of all check that we've got a name
2342   if (!isset($name) || ($name === ''))
2343   {
2344     $error = "empty_name";
2345     return false;
2346   }
2347 
2348   // Truncate the name field to the maximum length as a precaution.
2349   $name = mb_substr($name, 0, maxlength('area.area_name'));
2350 
2351   // Insert the area into the database.   We insert the area name that we have
2352   // been given, together with the default values for the per-area settings.
2353 
2354   // Build arrays of data to be inserted into the table
2355   $sql_params = array();
2356   $sql_col = array();
2357   $sql_val = array();
2358   // Get the information about the fields in the room table
2359   $fields = db()->field_info(_tbl('area'));
2360   // Loop through the fields and build up the arrays
2361   foreach ($fields as $field) {
2362     $key = $field['name'];
2363     switch ($key) {
2364       case 'area_name':
2365       case 'sort_key':
2366         $sql_col[] = $key;
2367         $sql_val[] = "?";
2368         $sql_params[] = $name;
2369         break;
2370       case 'periods':
2371         $sql_col[] = $key;
2372         $sql_val[] = "?";
2373         $sql_params[] = json_encode($area_defaults[$key]);
2374         break;
2375       default:
2376         if (array_key_exists($key, $area_defaults)) {
2377           $sql_col[] = $key;
2378           $sql_val[] = "?";
2379           if (in_array($key, $boolean_fields['area'])) {
2380             $sql_params[] = ($area_defaults[$key]) ? 1 : 0;
2381           }
2382           else {
2383             $sql_params[] = $area_defaults[$key];
2384           }
2385         }
2386         break;
2387     }
2388   }
2389 
2390   try {
2391     $sql = "INSERT INTO " . _tbl('area') . " (" . implode(', ', $sql_col) . ")
2392                  VALUES (" . implode(', ', $sql_val) . ")";
2393     db()->command($sql, $sql_params);
2394     $area_id = db()->insert_id(_tbl('area'), 'id');
2395   }
2396   catch (DBException $e) {
2397     // Check whether the area name is unique and if not return an
2398     // appropriate error
2399     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*)
2400               FROM " . _tbl('area') . "
2401              WHERE area_name=?
2402              LIMIT 1";
2403     if (db()->query1($sql, array($name)) > 0)
2404     {
2405       $error = "invalid_area_name";
2406       return false;
2407     }
2408     // Otherwise re-throw the exception
2409     throw $e;
2410   }
2411 
2412   return $area_id;
2413 }

2415 
2416 // Adds a room, returning the new id, or FALSE on failure with the
2417 // error in $error
2418 function mrbsAddRoom($name, $area, &$error, $description='', $capacity='', $room_admin_email='')
2419 {
2420   // First of all check that we've got a name
2421   if (!isset($name) || ($name === '')) {
2422     $error = "empty_name";
2423     return FALSE;
2424   }
2425 
2426   // Truncate the name and description fields to the maximum length as a precaution.
2427   $name = mb_substr($name, 0, maxlength('room.room_name'));
2428   $description = mb_substr($description, 0, maxlength('room.description'));
2429 
2430   if (empty($capacity))
2431   {
2432     $capacity = 0;
2433   }
2434 
2435   try {
2436     // Insert the room into the database
2437     $sql = "INSERT INTO " . _tbl('room') . " (room_name, sort_key, area_id, description, capacity, room_admin_email)
2438             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
2439     db()->command($sql, array($name, $name, $area, $description, $capacity, $room_admin_email));
2440     $room_id = db()->insert_id(_tbl('room'), 'id');
2441   }
2442   catch (DBException $e) {
2443     // Check whether the room name is unique within the area and
2444     // if not return an appropriate error
2445     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*)
2446             FROM " . _tbl('room') . "
2447            WHERE room_name=? AND area_id=?
2448            LIMIT 1";
2449     if (db()->query1($sql, array($name, $area)) > 0) {
2450       $error = "invalid_room_name";
2451       return false;
2452     }
2453     // Otherwise re-throw the exception
2454     throw $e;
2455   }
2456 
2457   return $room_id;
2458 }

2483 
2484 // Makes bookings
2485 //    $bookings     an array of bookings
2486 //    $id           the id of the current booking when editing an existing entry
2487 function mrbsMakeBookings(array $bookings, ?int $id=null, bool $just_check=false, bool $skip=false, ?int $original_room_id=null, bool $send_mail=false, bool $edit_series=false)
2488 {
2489   global $max_rep_entrys, $enable_periods, $resolution, $mail_settings;
2490   global $auth;
2491 
2492   // All the data, except for the status and room id, will be common
2493   // across the bookings
2494   $common = $bookings[0];
2495   // Work out the duration in seconds, but adjust it for DST changes so that
2496   // the user will still see, for example, "24 hours" when a booking goes from
2497   // 1200 one day to 1200 the next, crossing a DST boundary.
2498   $duration_seconds = $common['end_time'] - $common['start_time'];
2499   $duration_seconds -= cross_dst($common['start_time'], $common['end_time']);
2500   // Now get the duration, which will be needed for email notifications
2501   // (We do this before we adjust for DST so that the user sees what they expect to see)
2502   $duration = $duration_seconds;
2503   $date = getdate($common['start_time']);
2504   if ($enable_periods)
2505   {
2506     $period = (($date['hours'] - 12) * 60) + $date['minutes'];
2507     toPeriodString($period, $duration, $dur_units, FALSE);
2508   }
2509   else
2510   {
2511     toTimeString($duration, $dur_units, FALSE);
2512   }
2513 
2514   // Expand a series into a list of start times:
2515   if ($bookings[0]['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE)
2516   {
2517     $reps = $bookings[0]['repeat_rule']->getRepeatStartTimes($common['start_time'], $max_rep_entrys);
2518   }
2519 
2520   // When checking for overlaps, for Edit (not New), ignore this entry and series:
2521   if (isset($id))
2522   {
2523     $ignore_entry_id = $id;
2524     $repeat_id = get_repeat_id($id);
2525   }
2526   else
2527   {
2528     $ignore_entry_id = null;
2529     $repeat_id = null;
2530   }
2531 
2532   // Validate the booking for (a) conflicting bookings and (b) conformance to policy rules
2533   $valid_booking = true;
2534   $conflicts  = array();                      // Holds a list of all the conflicts
2535   $violations = array('notices' => array(),   // Holds an array of the policy rules that have been broken
2536                       'errors'  => array());  // classified by 'notices' and 'errors'
2537   $skip_lists = array();    // Holds a 2D array of bookings to skip past.  Indexed
2538                             // by room id and start time
2539 
2540   // Check for selection of multiple rooms.
2541   // The only question is whether this a notice or an error.  If the user is an ordinary user
2542   // in more than one of the rooms, then it's an error, otherwise a notice.
2543   if ($auth['only_admin_can_select_multiroom'] && (count($bookings) > 1))
2544   {
2545     $violation_status = 'notices';
2546     $non_admin_rooms = 0;
2547     foreach($bookings as $booking)
2548     {
2549       if (!is_book_admin($booking['room_id']))
2550       {
2551         $non_admin_rooms++;
2552         if ($non_admin_rooms > 1)
2553         {
2554           $violation_status = 'errors';
2555           $valid_booking = false;
2556           break;
2557         }
2558       }
2559     }
2560     $violations[$violation_status][] = get_vocab('multiroom_not_allowed');
2561   }
2562 
2563   // Check for any schedule conflicts in each room we're going to try and
2564   // book in; also check that the booking conforms to the policy
2565   foreach ($bookings as $booking)
2566   {
2567     $skip_lists[$booking['room_id']] = $booking['skip_list'] ?? [];
2568     if ($booking['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE && !empty($reps))
2569     {
2570       if(count($reps) < $max_rep_entrys)
2571       {
2572         for ($i = 0; $i < count($reps); $i++)
2573         {
2574           // Ignore conflicts in the booking's skip list, because they won't be made.
2575           if (isset($booking['skip_list']) && in_array($reps[$i], $booking['skip_list']))
2576           {
2577             continue;
2578           }
2579           // Calculate diff each time and correct where events cross DST
2580           $diff = $duration_seconds;
2581           $diff += cross_dst($reps[$i], $reps[$i] + $diff);
2582 
2583           $this_booking = $booking;
2584           $this_booking['start_time'] = $reps[$i];
2585           $this_booking['end_time'] = $reps[$i] + $diff;
2586 
2587           // Check that this entry doesn't overlap with the next in the series.
2588           // (This can happen if people mistake the end date for the repeat end date.)
2589           if (isset($reps[$i+1]) && ($this_booking['end_time'] > $reps[$i+1]))
2590           {
2591             $valid_booking = false;
2592             $conflicts[] = get_vocab('conflicts_with_self');
2593             break;
2594           }
2595 
2596           $tmp = mrbsCheckFree($this_booking, $ignore_entry_id, $repeat_id);
2597 
2598           $skip_this_booking = FALSE;
2599           if (!empty($tmp))
2600           {
2601             // If we've been told to skip past existing bookings, then add
2602             // this start time to the list of start times to skip past.
2603             // Otherwise it's an invalid booking
2604             if ($skip)
2605             {
2606               $skip_lists[$this_booking['room_id']][] = $this_booking['start_time'];
2607               $skip_this_booking = TRUE;
2608             }
2609             else
2610             {
2611               $valid_booking = FALSE;
2612             }
2613             // In both cases remember the conflict data.   (We don't at the
2614             // moment do anything with the data if we're skipping, but we might
2615             // in the future want to display a list of bookings we've skipped past)
2616             $conflicts = array_merge($conflicts, $tmp);
2617           }
2618           // If we're not going to skip past this booking, check that the booking
2619           // conforms to the booking policy.  (If we're going to skip past this
2620           // booking then it doesn't matter whether or not it conforms to the policy
2621           // because we're never going to make it)
2622           if (!$skip_this_booking)
2623           {
2624             $violations_this_booking = mrbsCheckPolicy($this_booking, $ignore_entry_id, $repeat_id);
2625             foreach (array('notices', 'errors') as $key)
2626             {
2627               $violations[$key] = array_merge($violations[$key], $violations_this_booking[$key]);
2628             }
2629             if (!empty($violations_this_booking['errors']))
2630             {
2631               $valid_booking = FALSE;
2632             }
2633           }
2634         } // for
2635       }
2636       else
2637       {
2638         if (is_book_admin($booking['room_id']))
2639         {
2640           $violation_status = 'notices';
2641         }
2642         else
2643         {
2644           $violation_status = 'errors';
2645           $valid_booking = false;
2646         }
2647         $violations[$violation_status][] = get_vocab("too_many_entries", $max_rep_entrys - 1);
2648       }
2649     }
2650     else
2651     {
2652       $tmp = mrbsCheckFree($booking, $ignore_entry_id);
2653       if (!empty($tmp))
2654       {
2655         $valid_booking = FALSE;
2656         $conflicts = array_merge($conflicts, $tmp);
2657       }
2658       // check that the booking conforms to the booking policy
2659       $violations_this_booking = mrbsCheckPolicy($booking, $ignore_entry_id, 0);
2660       foreach (array('notices', 'errors') as $key)
2661       {
2662         $violations[$key] = array_merge($violations[$key], $violations_this_booking[$key]);
2663       }
2664       if (!empty($violations_this_booking['errors']))
2665       {
2666         $valid_booking = FALSE;
2667       }
2668     }
2669 
2670   } // end foreach bookings
2671 
2672   // If we are editing an existing booking then we need to check that we are
2673   // allowed to delete it
2674   if (isset($id))
2675   {
2676 
2677     if ($edit_series)
2678     {
2679       $old_bookings = get_bookings_in_series($repeat_id);
2680     }
2681     else
2682     {
2683       $old_bookings = array();
2684       $old_booking = get_entry_by_id($id);
2685       if (isset($old_booking))
2686       {
2687         $old_bookings[] = $old_booking;
2688       }
2689     }
2690 
2691     foreach ($old_bookings as $old_booking)
2692     {
2693       $violations_this_booking = mrbsCheckPolicy($old_booking, null, null, true);
2694       foreach (array('notices', 'errors') as $key)
2695       {
2696         $violations[$key] = array_merge($violations[$key], $violations_this_booking[$key]);
2697       }
2698       if (!empty($violations_this_booking['errors']))
2699       {
2700         $valid_booking = FALSE;
2701       }
2702     }
2703 
2704   }
2705 
2706   // Tidy up the lists of conflicts and rules broken, getting rid of duplicates
2707   $conflicts = array_values(array_unique($conflicts));
2708   foreach (array('notices', 'errors') as $key)
2709   {
2710    $violations[$key] = array_values(array_unique($violations[$key]));
2711   }
2712 
2713   $result = array();
2714   $result['valid_booking'] = $valid_booking;
2715   $result['violations'] = $violations;
2716   $result['conflicts'] = $conflicts;
2717   // If we've just been asked to check the bookings, or if it wasn't a valid
2718   // booking, then stop here and return the results
2719   if ($just_check || !$valid_booking)
2720   {
2721     return $result;
2722   }
2723 
2724 
2725   // Otherwise we go on to commit the booking
2726 
2727   $new_details = array(); // We will pass this array in the Ajax result
2728   $rooms = array();
2729   foreach ($bookings as $booking)
2730   {
2731     $rooms[] = $booking['room_id'];
2732   }
2733   foreach ($bookings as $booking)
2734   {
2735     // We need to work out whether this is the original booking being modified,
2736     // because, if it is, we keep the ical_uid and increment the ical_sequence.
2737     // We consider this to be the original booking if there was an original
2738     // booking in the first place (in which case the original room id will be set) and
2739     //      (a) this is the same room as the original booking
2740     //   or (b) there is only one room in the new set of bookings, in which case
2741     //          what has happened is that the booking has been changed to be in
2742     //          a new room
2743     //   or (c) the new set of rooms does not include the original room, in which
2744     //          case we will make the arbitrary assumption that the original booking
2745     //          has been moved to the first room in the list and the bookings in the
2746     //          other rooms are clones and will be treated as new bookings.
2747 
2748     if (isset($original_room_id) &&
2749         (($original_room_id == $booking['room_id']) ||
2750          (count($rooms) == 1) ||
2751          (($rooms[0] == $booking['room_id']) && !in_array($original_room_id, $rooms))))
2752     {
2753       // This is an existing booking which has been changed.   Keep the
2754       // original ical_uid and increment the sequence number.
2755       $booking['ical_sequence']++;
2756     }
2757     else
2758     {
2759       // This is a new booking.   We generate a new ical_uid and start
2760       // the sequence at 0 - unless there already are uid and sequence
2761       // numbers, for example when importing an iCalendar file
2762       if (empty($booking['ical_uid']))
2763       {
2764         $booking['ical_uid'] = generate_global_uid($booking['name']);
2765       }
2766       if (empty($booking['ical_sequence']))
2767       {
2768         $booking['ical_sequence'] = 0;
2769       }
2770     }
2771 
2772     if ($booking['repeat_rule']->getType() == RepeatRule::NONE)
2773     {
2774       $booking['entry_type'] = (isset($repeat_id)) ? ENTRY_RPT_CHANGED : ENTRY_SINGLE;
2775       $booking['repeat_id'] = $repeat_id;
2776     }
2777     // Add in the list of bookings to skip
2778     if (!empty($skip_lists) && !empty($skip_lists[$booking['room_id']]))
2779     {
2780       $booking['skip_list'] = $skip_lists[$booking['room_id']];
2781     }
2782     // The following elements are needed for email notifications
2783     $booking['duration'] = $duration;
2784     $booking['dur_units'] = $dur_units;
2785 
2786     if ($booking['repeat_rule']->getType() != RepeatRule::NONE)
2787     {
2788       $details = mrbsCreateRepeatingEntrys($booking);
2789       $new_id = $details['id'];
2790       $is_repeat_table = $details['series'];
2791       asort($details['start_times']);
2792       $result['start_times'] = $details['start_times'];
2793     }
2794     else
2795     {
2796       // Make sure the keys below are set properly for a single entry (they might not
2797       // be if we've been editing a series and changed its repeat type to "none").
2798       $booking['repeat_id'] = null;
2799       $booking['entry_type'] = ENTRY_SINGLE;
2800       // Create the entry
2801       $new_id = mrbsCreateSingleEntry($booking);
2802       // Update the participants table
2803       if (isset($id))
2804       {
2805         update_participants($id, $new_id);
2806       }
2807 
2808       $is_repeat_table = FALSE;
2809       $result['start_times'] = array($booking['start_time']);
2810     }
2811     $new_details[] = array('id' => $new_id, 'room_id' => $booking['room_id']);
2812     $booking['id'] = $new_id;  // Add in the id now we know it
2813 
2814     // Send an email if necessary, provided that the entry creation was successful
2815     if ($send_mail && !empty($new_id))
2816     {
2817       // Only send an email if (a) this is a changed entry and we have to send emails
2818       // on change or (b) it's a new entry and we have to send emails for new entries
2819       if ((isset($id) && $mail_settings['on_change']) ||
2820           (!isset($id) && $mail_settings['on_new']))
2821       {
2822         require_once "functions_mail.inc";
2823 
2824         // Get room name and area name for email notifications.
2825         $sql = "SELECT R.room_name, A.area_name
2826                   FROM " . _tbl('room') . " R, " . _tbl('area') . " A
2827                  WHERE R.id=? AND R.area_id = A.id
2828                  LIMIT 1";
2829         $res = db()->query($sql, array($booking['room_id']));
2830         $row = $res->next_row_keyed();
2831         $booking['room_name'] = $row['room_name'];
2832         $booking['area_name'] = $row['area_name'];
2833 
2834         // If this is a modified entry then get the previous entry data
2835         // so that we can highlight the changes
2836         if (isset($id))
2837         {
2838           if ($edit_series)
2839           {
2840             $mail_previous = get_booking_info($repeat_id, TRUE);
2841           }
2842           else
2843           {
2844             $mail_previous = get_booking_info($id, FALSE);
2845           }
2846         }
2847         else
2848         {
2849           $mail_previous = array();
2850         }
2851         // Send the email
2852         // TODO: The email notifications really need to be moved to a later point in edit_entry_handler.php
2853         // TODO: so that they are outside the transaction block.  There are two reasons for this.  The first is
2854         // TODO: that if one of the bookings fails for some reason the transaction will be rolled back, but
2855         // TODO: the email notifications will already have been sent.  The second is that they are inside a
2856         // TODO: lock and so if the email notifications take a while, it will keep the lock longer than
2857         // TODO: necessary.  (This isn't as much of a problem as it used to be now that notifyAdminOnBooking()
2858         // TODO: only adds a message to a queue, and the actual sending of the email is performed on shutdown,
2859         // TODO: but can still be a problem if, for example, email addresses have to be looked up on a remote
2860         // TODO: server, eg an LDAP server, and the query takes a while.
2861         notifyAdminOnBooking($booking, $mail_previous, !isset($id), $is_repeat_table, $result['start_times']);
2862       }
2863     }
2864   } // end foreach $bookings
2865 
2866   $result['new_details'] = $new_details;
2867   $result['slots'] = intval(($common['end_time'] - $common['start_time'])/$resolution);
2868 
2869   return $result;
2870 }
2871 
2872 
2873 function get_bookings_in_series(?int $repeat_id) : array
2874 {
2875   $bookings = array();
2876 
2877   if (isset($repeat_id))
2878   {
2879     $sql = "SELECT *
2880               FROM " . _tbl('entry') . "
2881              WHERE repeat_id = ?";
2882     $res = db()->query($sql, array($repeat_id));
2883 
2884     while (false !== ($row = $res->next_row_keyed()))
2885     {
2886       // Cast the columns to their correct types
2887       row_cast_columns($row, 'entry');
2888       // Unpack the status bits
2889       unpack_status($row);
2890       $bookings[] = $row;
2891     }
2892   }
2893 
2894   return $bookings;
2895 }

 212 function get_field_custom(array $data, string $key) : Field
 213 {
 214   $var = "match_$key";
 215   global $$var;
 216 
 217   global $field_natures, $field_lengths;
 218 
 219   $name = $var;
 220   $label = get_loc_field_name(_tbl('entry'), $key);
 221 
 222   // Output a radio group if it's a boolean or integer <= 2 bytes (which we will
 223   // assume are intended to be booleans)
 224   if (($field_natures[$key] == 'boolean') ||
 225       (($field_natures[$key] == 'integer') && isset($field_lengths[$key]) && ($field_lengths[$key] <= 2)) )
 226   {
 227     $options = array(BOOLEAN_MATCH_BOTH  => get_vocab('both'),
 228                      BOOLEAN_MATCH_TRUE  => get_vocab('with'),
 229                      BOOLEAN_MATCH_FALSE => get_vocab('without'));
 230     $value = (isset($$var)) ? $$var : BOOLEAN_MATCH_BOTH;
 231     $field = new FieldInputRadioGroup();
 232     $field->setAttribute('id', "div_$name")
 233           ->setLabel($label)
 234           ->addRadioOptions($options, $name, $value, true);
 235   }
 236   else
 237   {
 238     $params = array('label' => $label,
 239                     'name'  => $name,
 240                     'value' => (isset($$var)) ? $$var : null,
 241                     'field' => "entry.$key");
 242     $field = get_field_report_input($params);
 243   }
 244 
 245   return $field;
 246 }

 248 
 249 // Generates a text input field of some kind.   If $select_options or $datalist_options
 250 // is set then it will be a datalist, otherwise it will be a simple input field
 251 //   $params  an array indexed by 'label', 'name', 'value' and 'field'
 252 function get_field_report_input(array $params) : Field
 253 {
 254   global $select_options, $datalist_options;
 255 
 256   // If $select_options is defined we want to force a <datalist> and not a
 257   // <select>.  That's because if we have options such as
 258   // ('tea', 'white coffee', 'black coffee') we want the user to be able to type
 259   // 'coffee' which will match both 'white coffee' and 'black coffee'.
 260   if (isset($params['field']))
 261   {
 262     if (!empty($select_options[$params['field']]))
 263     {
 264       $options = $select_options[$params['field']];
 265     }
 266     elseif (!empty($datalist_options[$params['field']]))
 267     {
 268       $options = $datalist_options[$params['field']];
 269     }
 270   }
 271 
 272   if (isset($options))
 273   {
 274     // Remove any element with an empty key.  This will just be associated with a
 275     // required select element and the value will be meaningless for a search.
 276     unset($options['']);
 277     // Remove any elements with an empty value.   These will be meaningless for a search.
 278     $options = array_diff($options, array(''));
 279     $field = new FieldInputDatalist();
 280     // We force the values to be used and not the keys.   We will convert
 281     // back to values when we construct the SQL query.
 282     $field->addDatalistOptions($options, false);
 283   }
 284   else
 285   {

 481 // Converts a string from the standard MRBS character set to the character set
 482 // to be used for CSV files
 483 function csv_conv(string $string) : string
 484 {
 485   $in_charset = mb_strtoupper(get_charset());
 486   $out_charset = mb_strtoupper(get_csv_charset());
 487 
 488   if ($in_charset == $out_charset)
 489   {
 490     return $string;
 491   }
 492 
 493   if (($in_charset == 'UTF-8') && (str_starts_with($out_charset, 'UTF-16')))
 494   {
 495     $suffix = substr($out_charset, strlen('UTF-16'));
 496 
 497     switch ($suffix)
 498     {
 499       case '':
 500         $endianness = null;
 501         break;
 502       case 'BE':
 503         $endianness = System::BIG_ENDIAN;
 504         break;
 505       case 'LE':
 506         $endianness = System::LITTLE_ENDIAN;
 507         break;
 508       default:
 509         throw new Exception("Unsupported charset '$out_charset'.");
 510         break;
 511     }
 512 
 513     // iconv() will add in a BOM if the output encoding requires one, but as we are only
 514     // dealing with parts of a file we don't want any BOMs because we add them separately
 515     // at the beginning of the file.  So strip off anything that looks like a BOM.
 516     return (new Utf8String($string))->toUtf16($endianness, true);
 517   }
 518 
 519   throw new Exception("Cannot convert from '$in_charset' to '$out_charset'");
 520 }
 521 
 522 
 523 // Escape a string for output
 524 function escape(string $string) : string
 525 {
 526   global $output_format;
 527 
 528   switch ($output_format)
 529   {
 530     case OUTPUT_HTML:
 531       $string = mrbs_nl2br(escape_html($string));
 532       break;
 533     case OUTPUT_CSV:
 534       $string = str_replace('"', '""', $string);
 535       break;
 536     default:  // do nothing
 537       break;
 538   }
 539 
 540   return $string;
 541 }

 544 // Wraps $string in a span with a data-type value of $data_type - but only for HTML output
 545 function type_wrap(string $string, string $data_type) : string
 546 {

 548 
 549   if ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML)
 550   {
 551     return '<span class="normal" data-type="' . $data_type . '">' . $string . '</span>';

 555     return $string;

 575 // Gets the indices of the columns that should be sorted
 576 function get_sort_columns(string $sortby) : array
 577 {
 578   global $field_order_list;
 579 
 580   $indices = [];
 581   $i = 0;
 582   $keys = ['area_name', 'room_name', 'start_time'];
 583 
 584   foreach ($field_order_list as $field)
 585   {
 586     if (in_array($field, $keys))
 587     {
 588       $indices[$field] = $i;
 589     }
 590 
 591     if (count($indices) == 3)
 592     {
 593       break;  // We've got all of them
 594     }
 595 
 596     $i++;
 597     // End_time is a special case because it uses up two columns: one for
 598     // the end time, and another for the duration.
 599     if ($field == 'end_time')
 600     {
 601       $i++;
 602     }
 603   }
 604 
 605   switch($sortby)
 606   {
 607     case 'r':
 608       return [$indices['area_name'], $indices['room_name'], $indices['start_time']];
 609       break;
 610     default:
 611       return [$indices['start_time'], $indices['area_name'], $indices['room_name']];
 612       break;
 613   }
 614 }

 617 // Output the first row (header row) for CSV reports
 618 function report_header() : void
 619 {
 620   global $output_format, $is_ajax;
 621   global $custom_fields;
 622   global $approval_somewhere, $confirmation_somewhere, $registration_somewhere;
 623   global $field_order_list, $booking_types;
 624 
 625   // Don't do anything if this is an Ajax request: we only want to send the data
 626   if ($is_ajax)
 627   {
 628     return;
 629   }
 630 
 631   // Build an array of values to go into the header row
 632   $values = array();
 633 
 634   foreach ($field_order_list as $field)
 635   {
 636     // We give some columns a type data value so that the JavaScript knows how to sort them
 637     // TODO: the 'title-*' plugins are now deprecated in DataTables.  Use the replacement.
 638     // TODO: is 'string' really necessary or does DataTables auto-detect? (But it is necessary
 639     // TODO: if there's HTML.)
 640     switch ($field)
 641     {
 642       case 'name':
 643         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("namebooker"), 'string');
 644         break;
 645       case 'area_name':
 646         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("area"), 'string');
 647         break;
 648       case 'room_name':
 649         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("room"), 'string');
 650         break;
 651       case 'start_time':
 652         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("start_date"), 'title-numeric');
 653         break;
 654       case 'end_time':
 655         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("end_date"), 'title-numeric');
 656         $values['duration'] = type_wrap(get_vocab("duration"), 'title-numeric');
 657         break;
 658       case 'description':
 659         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("fulldescription_short"), 'string');
 660         break;
 661       case 'type':
 662         if (isset($booking_types) && (count($booking_types) > 1))
 663         {
 664           $values[$field] = get_vocab("type");
 665         }
 666         break;
 667       case 'allow_registration':
 668         if ($registration_somewhere)
 669         {
 670           $values[$field] = get_vocab("registered");
 671         }
 672         break;
 673       case 'create_by':
 674         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("createdby"), 'string');
 675         break;
 676       case 'confirmation_enabled':
 677         if ($confirmation_somewhere)
 678         {
 679           $values[$field] = get_vocab("confirmation_status");
 680         }
 681         break;
 682       case 'approval_enabled':
 683         if ($approval_somewhere)
 684         {
 685           $values[$field] = get_vocab("approval_status");
 686         }
 687         break;
 688       case 'last_updated':
 689         $values[$field] = type_wrap(get_vocab("lastupdate"), 'title-numeric');
 690         break;
 691       default:
 692         // the custom fields
 693         if (array_key_exists($field, $custom_fields))
 694         {
 695           $values[$field] = get_loc_field_name(_tbl('entry'), $field);
 696         }
 697         break;
 698     }  // switch
 699   }  // foreach
 700 
 701 
 702   // Find out what the non-breaking space is in this character set
 703   $charset = get_charset();
 704   $nbsp = html_entity_decode('&nbsp;', ENT_NOQUOTES, $charset);
 705   foreach($values as $key => $value)
 706   {
 707     if ($output_format != OUTPUT_HTML)
 708     {
 709       // Remove any HTML entities from the values
 710       $value = html_entity_decode($value, ENT_NOQUOTES, $charset);
 711       // Trim non-breaking spaces from the string
 712       $value = trim($value, $nbsp);
 713       // And do an ordinary trim
 714       $value = trim($value);
 715       // We don't escape HTML output here because the vocab strings are trusted.
 716       // And some of them contain HTML entities such as &nbsp; on purpose
 717       $values[$key] = escape($value);
 718     }
 719 
 720   }
 721 
 722   $head_rows = array();
 723   $head_rows[] = $values;
 724   output_head_rows($head_rows, $output_format);
 725 }

 800 // Output a table row.
 801 function output_row(array $values, int $output_format, bool $body_row = true) : void
 802 {
 803   global $json_data, $is_ajax, $csv_col_sep, $csv_row_sep;
 804 
 805   if ($is_ajax && $body_row)
 806   {
 807     $json_data['aaData'][] = $values;
 808   }
 809   else
 810   {
 811     if ($output_format == OUTPUT_CSV)
 812     {
 813       $line = '"';
 814       $line .= implode("\"$csv_col_sep\"", $values);
 815       $line .= '"' . $csv_row_sep;
 816       $line = csv_conv($line);
 817     }
 818     elseif ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML)
 819     {
 820       $line = '<tr>';
 821       foreach ($values as $key => $value)
 822       {
 823         $line .= ($body_row) ? '<td>' : '<th id="'. escape_html("col_$key") . '">';
 824         $line .= $value;
 825         $line .= ($body_row) ? '</td>' : '</th>';
 826         $line .= "\n";
 827       }
 828     }
 829     echo $line;
 830   }
 831 }

 845     {
 846       echo "<col>";
 847     }
 848     echo "</colgroup>\n";

 851   foreach ($rows as $row)

 892 
 893 function report_row(&$rows, $data)
 894 {
 895   global $output_format, $is_ajax, $ajax_capable;
 896   global $custom_fields, $field_natures, $field_lengths;
 897   global $approval_somewhere, $confirmation_somewhere, $registration_somewhere;
 898   global $select_options, $booking_types;
 899   global $field_order_list;
 900   global $include_registered_by, $include_registrant_username;
 901   global $datetime_formats;
 902 
 903   // If we're capable of delivering an Ajax request and this is not Ajax request,
 904   // then don't do anything.  We're going to save sending the data until we actually
 905   // get the Ajax request;  we just send the rest of the page at this stage.
 906   if (($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML) && $ajax_capable && !$is_ajax)
 907   {
 908     return;
 909   }
 910 
 911   $values = array();
 912 
 913   foreach ($field_order_list as $field)
 914   {
 915     $value = $data[$field];
 916 
 917     // Some fields need some special processing to turn the raw value into something
 918     // more meaningful
 919     switch ($field)
 920     {
 921       case 'create_by':
 922         $create_by = $value; // We will need it later
 923         $value  = get_compound_name($create_by);
 924         break;
 925       case 'end_time':
 926         // Calculate the duration and then fall through to calculating the end date
 927         // Need the duration in seconds for sorting.  Have to correct it for DST
 928         // changes so that the user sees what he expects to see
 929         $duration_seconds = $data['end_time'] - $data['start_time'];
 930         $duration_seconds -= cross_dst($data['start_time'], $data['end_time']);
 931         $d = get_duration($data['start_time'], $data['end_time'], $data['enable_periods'], $data['area_id']);
 932         $d_string = $d['duration'] . ' ' . $d['dur_units'];
 933         $d_string = escape($d_string);
 934       case 'start_time':
 935         if ($data['enable_periods'])
 936         {
 937           // If we've fallen through from 'end_time' we need to set previous_period to TRUE
 938           // so that we get the name of the previous period, not this one.
 939           $date =  period_date_string($value, $data['area_id'], ($field == 'end_time'));
 940         }
 941         else
 942         {
 943           $date = datetime_format($datetime_formats['date_and_time_report'], $value);
 944         }
 945         $value = $date;
 946         break;
 947       case 'type':
 948         $value = get_type_vocab($value);
 949         break;
 950       case 'confirmation_enabled':
 951         // Translate the status field bit into meaningful text
 952         if ($data['confirmation_enabled'])
 953         {
 954           $value = ($data['tentative']) ? get_vocab('tentative') : get_vocab('confirmed');
 955         }
 956         else
 957         {
 958           $value = '';
 959         }
 960         break;
 961       case 'approval_enabled':
 962         // Translate the status field bit into meaningful text
 963         if ($data['approval_enabled'])
 964         {
 965           $value = ($data['awaiting_approval']) ? get_vocab('awaiting_approval') : get_vocab('approved');
 966         }
 967         else
 968         {
 969           $value = '';
 970         }
 971         break;
 972       case 'last_updated':
 973         $value = datetime_format($datetime_formats['date_and_time_report'], $value);
 974         break;
 975       case 'allow_registration':
 976         if ($data['allow_registration'])
 977         {
 978           $value = implode(', ', auth()->getRegistrantsDisplayNames($data, $include_registered_by, $include_registrant_username));
 979         }
 980         else
 981         {
 982           $value = get_vocab('na');
 983         }
 984         break;
 985       default:
 986         // Custom fields
 987         if (array_key_exists($field, $custom_fields))
 988         {
 989           // Output a yes/no if it's a boolean or integer <= 2 bytes (which we will
 990           // assume are intended to be booleans)
 991           if (($field_natures[$field] == 'boolean') ||
 992               (($field_natures[$field] == 'integer') && isset($field_lengths[$field]) && ($field_lengths[$field] <= 2)) )
 993           {
 994             $value = empty($value) ? get_vocab("no") : get_vocab("yes");
 995           }
 996           // Otherwise output a string
 997           elseif (isset($value))
 998           {
 999             // If the custom field is an associative array then we want
1000             // the value rather than the array key (provided the key is not
1001             // an empty string)
1002             if (isset($select_options["entry.$field"]) &&
1003                 is_assoc($select_options["entry.$field"]) &&
1004                 array_key_exists($value, $select_options["entry.$field"]) &&
1005                 ($value !== ''))
1006             {
1007               $value = $select_options["entry.$field"][$value];
1008             }
1009           }
1010           else
1011           {
1012             $value = '';
1013           }
1014         }
1015         break;
1016     }
1017     $value = escape(strval($value ?? ''));
1018 
1019     // For HTML output we take special action for some fields
1020     if ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML)
1021     {
1022       switch ($field)
1023       {
1024         case 'create_by':
1025           $text = $value;
1026           // Add a mailto: link if we can and only if the current user is an admin (for privacy reasons)
1027           if (is_admin())
1028           {
1029             $user = auth()->getUser($create_by);
1030             if (isset($user->email) && ($user->email !== ''))
1031             {
1032               $value = '<a href="mailto:' . escape_html($user->email) . '">' . "$text</a>";
1033             }
1034           }
1035           // Put an invisible <span> at the beginning for sorting.
1036           // $text and $value are already escaped.
1037           // TODO Use orthogonal data
1038           $value = "<span>$text</span>$value";
1039           break;
1040         case 'name':
1041           // Add a link to the entry and also a data-id value for the Bulk Delete JavaScript
1042           $href = multisite('view_entry.php?id=' . intval($data['id']));  // Cast to int as a precaution
1043           // Put an invisible <span> at the beginning for sorting.
1044           // TODO This should really be done by putting a data-order attribute in the <td> element,
1045           // TODO but we can't do that with Ajax loading.  The solution is to switch to use DataTables'
1046           // TODO orthogonal data.
1047           $value = "<span>$value</span>" .
1048                    '<a href="' . escape_html($href) . '"' .
1049                    ' data-id="' . intval($data['id']) . '"' .  // Cast to int as a precaution
1050                    $value . '">' . $value . '</a>';  // $value already escaped
1051           break;
1052         case 'end_time':
1053           // Process the duration and then fall through to the end_time
1054           // Include the duration in a seconds as a title in an empty span so
1055           // that the column can be sorted and filtered properly
1056           $d_string = '<span title="' . intval($duration_seconds) . '"></span>' . $d_string;  // Cast to int as a precaution
1057         case 'start_time':
1058         case 'last_updated':
1059           // Include the numeric time as a title in an empty span so
1060           // that the column can be sorted and filtered properly
1061           $value = '<span title="' . intval($data[$field]) . '"></span>' . $value;
1062           break;
1063         case 'area_name':
1064           // TODO Use orthogonal data instead of a span
1065           $value = '<span>' . escape_html($data['area_sort_key']) . '</span>' . $value;
1066           break;
1067         case 'room_name':
1068           // TODO Use orthogonal data instead of a span
1069           $value = '<span>' . escape_html($data['room_sort_key']) . '</span>' . $value;
1070           break;
1071         default:
1072           break;
1073       }
1074     }
1075 
1076     // Add the value to the array.   We don't bother with some fields if
1077     // they are going to be irrelevant
1078     if (($confirmation_somewhere || ($field != 'confirmation_enabled')) &&
1079         ($approval_somewhere || ($field != 'approval_enabled')) &&
1080         ($registration_somewhere || ($field != 'allow_registration')) &&
1081         ((isset($booking_types) && (count($booking_types) > 1)) || ($field != 'type')))
1082     {
1083       $values[] = $value;
1084     }
1085 
1086     // Special action for the duration
1087     if ($field == 'end_time')
1088     {
1089       $values[] = $d_string;
1090     }
1091 
1092   }  // foreach
1093 
1094   $rows[] = $values;
1095 }

1098 function get_sumby_name_from_row(array $row) : string
1099 {

1120 // Increments a two-dimensional array by $increment
1121 function increment_count(&$array, $index1, $index2, $increment)
1122 {
1123   if (!isset($array[$index1]))
1124   {
1125     $array[$index1] = array();
1126   }
1127   if (!isset($array[$index1][$index2]))
1128   {
1129     $array[$index1][$index2] = 0;
1130   }
1131   $array[$index1][$index2] += $increment;
1132 }
1133 
1134 // Collect summary statistics on one entry.
1135 // This also builds hash tables of all unique names and rooms. When sorted,
1136 // these will become the column and row headers of the summary table.
1137 function accumulate_summary($row, &$count, &$hours, $report_start, $report_end,
1138                             &$room_hash, &$name_hash)
1139 {
1140   global $output_format, $periods;
1141 
1142   $periods_per_day = count($periods);
1143 
1144   // Use brief description, created by or type as the name:
1145   $name = get_sumby_name_from_row($row);
1146   // Area and room separated by break (if HTML):
1147   $room = escape($row['area_name']);
1148   $room .= ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML) ? "<br>" : '/';
1149   $room .= escape($row['room_name']);
1150   // Accumulate the number of bookings for this room and name:
1151   increment_count($count, $room, $name, 1);
1152   // Accumulate hours/periods used, clipped to report range dates:
1153   if ($row['enable_periods'])
1154   {
1155     // We need to set the start and end of the report to the start and end of periods
1156     // on those days.   Otherwise if the report starts or ends in the middle of a multi-day
1157     // booking we'll get all those spurious minutes before noon or between the end of
1158     // the last period and midnight
1159 
1160     // Need to use the MRBS version of DateTime to get round a bug in modify()
1161     // in PHP before 5.3.6.  As we are in the MRBS namespace we will get the MRBS version.
1162     $startDate = new DateTime();
1163     $startDate->setTimestamp($report_start)->modify('12:00');
1164 
1165     $endDate = new DateTime();
1166     $endDate->setTimestamp($report_end)->modify('12:00');
1167     $endDate->sub(new DateInterval('P1D'));  // Go back one day because the $report_end is at 00:00 the day after
1168     $endDate->add(new DateInterval('PT' . $periods_per_day . 'M'));
1169     $increment = get_period_interval(
1170       max($row['start_time'], $startDate->getTimestamp()),
1171       min($row['end_time'], $endDate->getTimestamp()),
1172       $row['area_id']
1173     );
1174     $room_hash[$room] = MODE_PERIODS;
1175   }
1176   else
1177   {
1178     $increment = (min((int)$row['end_time'], $report_end) -
1179                   max((int)$row['start_time'], $report_start)) / SECONDS_PER_HOUR;
1180     $room_hash[$room] = MODE_TIMES;
1181   }
1182   increment_count($hours, $room, $name, $increment);
1183   $name_hash[$name] = 1;
1184 }

1187 // Format an entries value depending on whether it's destined for a CSV file or
1188 // HTML output.   If it's HTML output then we enclose it in parentheses.
1189 function entries_format($str)
1190 {
1191   global $output_format;
1192 
1193   if ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML)
1194   {
1195     return "($str)";
1196   }
1197   else
1198   {
1199     return $str;
1200   }
1201 }

1204 // Output the summary table (a "cross-tab report"). $count and $hours are
1205 // 2-dimensional sparse arrays indexed by [area/room][name].
1206 // $room_hash & $name_hash are arrays with indexes naming unique rooms and names.
1207 function do_summary($count, $hours, &$room_hash, &$name_hash)
1208 {
1209   global $output_format, $csv_col_sep;
1210   global $times_somewhere, $periods_somewhere;
1211 
1212   // Sort the room and name arrays
1213   ksort($room_hash);
1214   ksort($name_hash);
1215   // Initialise grand total counters
1216   foreach (array(MODE_TIMES, MODE_PERIODS) as $m)
1217   {
1218     $grand_count_total[$m] = 0;
1219     $grand_hours_total[$m] = 0;
1220   }
1221 
1222 
1223   // TABLE HEAD
1224   // ----------
1225   $head_rows = array();
1226   $row1_cells = array('');
1227   $row2_cells = array('');
1228 
1229   foreach ($room_hash as $room => $mode)
1230   {
1231     $col_count_total[$room] = 0;
1232     $col_hours_total[$room] = 0.0;
1233     $mode_text = ($mode == MODE_TIMES) ? get_vocab("mode_times") : get_vocab("mode_periods");
1234     $row1_cells[] = $room;
1235     $row1_cells[] = '';  // The cell before is really spanning two columns.   We'll sort it out with JavaScript
1236     $row2_cells[] = get_vocab("entries");
1237     $row2_cells[] = ($mode == MODE_PERIODS) ? get_vocab("periods") : get_vocab("hours");
1238   }
1239 
1240   // Add the total column(s) onto the end
1241   if ($times_somewhere)
1242   {
1243     $row1_cells[] = get_vocab("total") . " (" . get_vocab("mode_times") . ")";
1244     $row1_cells[] = '';
1245     $row2_cells[] = get_vocab("entries");
1246     $row2_cells[] = get_vocab("hours");
1247   }
1248   if ($periods_somewhere)
1249   {
1250     $row1_cells[] = get_vocab("total") . " (" . get_vocab("mode_periods") . ")";
1251     $row1_cells[] = '';
1252     $row2_cells[] = get_vocab("entries");
1253     $row2_cells[] = get_vocab("periods");
1254   }
1255 
1256   // Add the rows to the array of header rows, for output later
1257   $head_rows[] = $row1_cells;
1258   $head_rows[] = $row2_cells;
1259 
1260 
1261   // TABLE BODY
1262   // ----------
1263   $body_rows = array();
1264   foreach ($name_hash as $name => $is_present)
1265   {
1266     foreach (array(MODE_TIMES, MODE_PERIODS) as $m)
1267     {
1268       $row_count_total[$m] = 0;
1269       $row_hours_total[$m] = 0;
1270     }
1271     $cells = array();
1272     $cells[] = $name;
1273     foreach ($room_hash as $room => $mode)
1274     {
1275       if (isset($count[$room][$name]))
1276       {
1277         $count_val = $count[$room][$name];
1278         $hours_val = $hours[$room][$name];
1279         $cells[] = entries_format($count_val);
1280         $format = ($mode == MODE_TIMES) ? FORMAT_TIMES : FORMAT_PERIODS;
1281         $cells[] = sprintf($format, $hours_val);
1282         $row_count_total[$mode] += $count_val;
1283         $row_hours_total[$mode] += $hours_val;
1284         $col_count_total[$room] += $count_val;
1285         $col_hours_total[$room] += $hours_val;
1286       }
1287       else
1288       {
1289         $cells[] = ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML) ? "&nbsp;" : '';
1290         $cells[] = ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML) ? "&nbsp;" : '';
1291       }
1292     }
1293     // Add the total column(s) onto the end
1294     if ($times_somewhere)
1295     {
1296       $cells[] = entries_format($row_count_total[MODE_TIMES]);
1297       $cells[] = sprintf(FORMAT_TIMES, $row_hours_total[MODE_TIMES]);
1298     }
1299     if ($periods_somewhere)
1300     {
1301       $cells[] = entries_format($row_count_total[MODE_PERIODS]);
1302       $cells[] = sprintf(FORMAT_PERIODS, $row_hours_total[MODE_PERIODS]);
1303     }
1304     $body_rows[] = $cells;
1305     foreach (array(MODE_TIMES, MODE_PERIODS) as $m)
1306     {
1307       $grand_count_total[$m] += $row_count_total[$m];
1308       $grand_hours_total[$m] += $row_hours_total[$m];
1309     }
1310   }
1311 
1312 
1313   // TABLE FOOT
1314   // ----------
1315   $foot_rows = array();
1316   $cells = array();
1317   $cells[] = get_vocab("total");
1318   foreach ($room_hash as $room => $mode)
1319   {
1320     $cells[] = entries_format($col_count_total[$room]);
1321     $format = ($mode == MODE_TIMES) ? FORMAT_TIMES : FORMAT_PERIODS;
1322     $cells[] = sprintf($format, $col_hours_total[$room]);
1323   }
1324   // Add the total column(s) onto the end
1325   if ($times_somewhere)
1326   {
1327     $cells[] = entries_format($grand_count_total[MODE_TIMES]);
1328     $cells[] = sprintf(FORMAT_TIMES, $grand_hours_total[MODE_TIMES]);
1329   }
1330   if ($periods_somewhere)
1331   {
1332     $cells[] = entries_format($grand_count_total[MODE_PERIODS]);
1333     $cells[] = sprintf(FORMAT_PERIODS, $grand_hours_total[MODE_PERIODS]);
1334   }
1335   $foot_rows[] = $cells;
1336 
1337 
1338   // OUTPUT THE TABLE
1339   // ----------------
1340   if ($output_format == OUTPUT_HTML)
1341   {
1342     // <tfoot> has to come before <tbody>
1343     output_head_rows($head_rows, $output_format);
1344     output_foot_rows($foot_rows, $output_format);
1345     output_body_rows($body_rows, $output_format);
1346   }
1347   else
1348   {
1349     output_head_rows($head_rows, $output_format);
1350     output_body_rows($body_rows, $output_format);
1351     output_foot_rows($foot_rows, $output_format);
1352   }
1353 }

1355 
1356 function get_match_condition(string $full_column_name, ?string $match, array &$sql_params) : string
1357 {
1358   global $select_options, $field_natures, $field_lengths;
1359 
1360   $sql = '';
1361 
1362   // First simple case: no match required
1363   if (!isset($match) || $match === '')
1364   {
1365     return $sql;
1366   }
1367 
1368   // Get the table name and alias
1369   $aliases = array('area'  => 'A',
1370                    'entry' => 'E',
1371                    'room'  => 'R');
1372 
1373   list($table_alias, $column) = explode('.', $full_column_name, 2);
1374   $table = array_search($table_alias, $aliases);
1375 
1376   // Next simple case: for tables other than the entry table we are not going to
1377   // bother with complicated things such as custom fields or select_options
1378   if ($table != 'entry')
1379   {
1380     // syntax_caseless_contains() modifies the SQL params array too
1381     $sql .= " AND " . db()->syntax_caseless_contains("$full_column_name", $match, $sql_params);
1382     return $sql;
1383   }
1384 
1385   // More complicated cases:
1386 
1387   // (1) Associative arrays (we can't just test for the string, because the database
1388   // contains the keys, not the values.   So we have to go through each key testing
1389   // for a possible match)
1390   if (isset($select_options["$table.$column"]) &&
1391       is_assoc($select_options["$table.$column"]))
1392   {
1393     $sql .= " AND ";
1394     $or_array = array();
1395     foreach($select_options["$table.$column"] as $option_key => $option_value)
1396     {
1397       // We have to use strpos() rather than stripos() because we cannot
1398       // assume PHP5
1399       if (($option_key !== '') &&
1400           (mb_strpos(mb_strtolower($option_value), mb_strtolower($match)) !== FALSE))
1401       {
1402         $or_array[] = "$full_column_name=?";
1403         $sql_params[] = $option_key;
1404       }
1405     }
1406     if (count($or_array) > 0)
1407     {
1408       $sql .= "(". implode( " OR ", $or_array ) .")";
1409     }
1410     else
1411     {
1412       $sql .= "FALSE";
1413     }
1414   }
1415   // (2) Booleans (or integers <= 2 bytes which we assume are intended to be booleans)
1416   elseif (($field_natures[$column] == 'boolean') ||
1417           (($field_natures[$column] == 'integer') && isset($field_lengths[$column]) && ($field_lengths[$column] <= 2)) )
1418   {
1419     if (($match != BOOLEAN_MATCH_BOTH) && ($match !== ''))
1420     {
1421       $sql .= " AND ($full_column_name ";
1422       $sql .= ($match == BOOLEAN_MATCH_TRUE) ? "IS NOT NULL AND $full_column_name != 0" : "IS NULL OR $full_column_name = 0";
1423       $sql .= ")";
1424     }
1425   }
1426   // (3) Integers
1427   elseif (($field_natures[$column] == 'integer') &&
1428            isset($field_lengths[$column]) &&
1429            ($field_lengths[$column] > 2))
1430   {
1431     $sql .= " AND $full_column_name=" . $match;
1432   }
1433   // (4) Strings
1434   else
1435   {
1436     // syntax_caseless_contains() modifies the SQL params array too
1437     $sql .= " AND " . db()->syntax_caseless_contains("$full_column_name", $match, $sql_params);
1438   }
1439 
1440   return $sql;
1441 }

1443 // Work out whether we are running from the command line
1444 $cli_mode = is_cli();
1445 
1446 if ($cli_mode)
1447 {
1448   // Need to set include path if we're running in CLI mode

1450   // than the directory from which the script was called)

1454 $default_from_time = mktime(0, 0, 0, $month, $day, $year);

1457 $default_to_date = date(DateTime::ISO8601_DATE, $default_to_time);

1459 // Get non-standard form variables

1468 $output_format = get_form_var('output_format', 'int', (($cli_mode) ? OUTPUT_CSV : OUTPUT_HTML));
1469 $typematch = get_form_var('typematch', 'array');
1470 $sortby = get_form_var('sortby', 'string', $default_sortby ?? FALLBACK_SORTBY);  // $sortby: r=room, s=start date/time.
1471 $sumby = get_form_var('sumby', 'string', $default_sumby ?? FALLBACK_SUMBY);  // $sumby: d=by brief description, c=by creator, t=by type.
1472 $match_approved = get_form_var('match_approved', 'int', BOOLEAN_MATCH_BOTH);

1476 $datatable = get_form_var('datatable', 'int');  // Will only be set if we're using DataTables
1477 
1478 // Validate form variables
1479 if (!in_array($sortby, ['r', 's']))
1480 {
1481   trigger_error("Unknown sort code '$sortby'; using '" . FALLBACK_SORTBY . "'.", E_USER_NOTICE);
1482   $sortby = FALLBACK_SORTBY;

1485 if (!in_array($sumby, ['c', 'd', 't']))
1486 {
1487   trigger_error("Unknown sumby code '$sumby'; using '" . FALLBACK_SUMBY ."'.", E_USER_NOTICE);
1488   $sumby = FALLBACK_SUMBY;

1491 $is_ajax = is_ajax();
1492 
1493 if ($cli_mode)
1494 {
1495   // If we're running in CLI mode we're passing the parameters in from the command line
1496   // not the form and we want to go straight to Phase 2 (producing the report)
1497   $phase = 2;
1498 }
1499 else
1500 {
1501   // Check the CSRF token if this is Phase 2
1502   if ($phase == 2)
1503   {
1504     Form::checkToken(true);
1505   }
1506 
1507   // Check the user is authorised for this page.
1508   if ($report_unauthenticated_get_enabled && is_get_request() && ($phase == 2))
1509   {
1510     if ($report_keys_enabled)
1511     {
1512       $key = get_form_var('key', 'string');
1513       if (!in_array($key, $report_keys))

1515         http_response_code(403);
1516         exit;
1517       }
1518     }
1519   }
1520   else
1521   {
1522     checkAuthorised(this_page());
1523     $mrbs_user = session()->getCurrentUser();
1524   }

1527 // Set up for Ajax.   We need to know whether we're capable of dealing with Ajax
1528 // requests, which will only be if the browser is using DataTables.  We also need
1529 // to initialise the JSON data array.
1530 $ajax_capable = $datatable;

1532 if ($is_ajax)
1533 {
1534   $json_data['aaData'] = array();

1537 $private_somewhere = some_area('private_enabled') || some_area('private_mandatory');
1538 $approval_somewhere = some_area('approval_enabled');
1539 $confirmation_somewhere = some_area('confirmation_enabled');
1540 $registration_somewhere = registration_somewhere();
1541 $times_somewhere = times_somewhere();
1542 $periods_somewhere = periods_somewhere();

1545 // Build the report search field order
1546 $report_presentation_fields = array('output', 'output_format', 'sortby', 'sumby');
1547 
1548 foreach ($report_presentation_fields as $field)
1549 {
1550   if (!in_array($field, $report_presentation_field_order))
1551   {
1552     $report_presentation_field_order[] = $field;

1554 }
1555 
1556 // Build the report search field order
1557 $report_search_fields = array('report_start', 'report_end',
1558                               'areamatch', 'roommatch',
1559                               'typematch', 'namematch', 'descrmatch', 'creatormatch',
1560                               'match_private', 'match_confirmed', 'match_approved');
1561 
1562 foreach ($report_search_fields as $field)
1563 {
1564   if (!in_array($field, $report_search_field_order))
1565   {
1566     $report_search_field_order[] = $field;
