/upgrade.inc

   1 <?php
   2 declare(strict_types=1);
   3 namespace MRBS;
   4 
   5 use MRBS\DB\DB;
   6 use MRBS\DB\DBException;
   7 use MRBS\DB\DBFactory;
   8 use MRBS\Errors\Errors;
   9 use MRBS\Form\ElementFieldset;
  10 use MRBS\Form\FieldInputPassword;
  11 use MRBS\Form\FieldInputSubmit;
  12 use MRBS\Form\FieldInputText;
  13 use MRBS\Form\Form;
  14 
  15 // This file checks to see whether the database schema versions (both global and local)
  16 // are up-to-date, and if not performs the necessary upgrades.
  17 
  18 
  19 // Get all the sub-site configuration files in this installation.  Returns an array of site
  20 // names indexed by configuration file.  (We do it this way round in case the site names are
  21 // integer-like, eg "1", "2", "3", etc., which will cause difficulties with PHP associative arrays.)
  22 function get_site_config_files() : array
  23 {
  24   global $multisite;
  25 
  26   $result = [];
  27 
  28   if ($multisite)
  29   {
  30     $sites_dir = 'sites';
  31     if (!is_readable($sites_dir))
  32     {
  33       trigger_error("The directory '$sites_dir' either does not exist or is not readable.", E_USER_WARNING);
  34       return $result;
  35     }
  36     // Use scandir() rather than the DirectoryIterator in order to ensure that
  37     // the sites are sorted.
  38     $dirs = array_diff(scandir($sites_dir), array('.', '..'));
  39     foreach ($dirs as $dir)
  40     {
  41       // Ignore anything that's not a directory
  42       if (!is_dir($sites_dir . '/' . $dir))
  43       {
  44         continue;
  45       }
  46       // And ignore any directory that doesn't have a site config file
  47       $site_config = $sites_dir . '/' . $dir . '/config.inc.php';
  48       if (!is_readable($site_config))
  49       {
  50         continue;
  51       }
  52       $result[$site_config] = $dir;
  53     }
  54   }
  55 
  56   return $result;
  57 }
  58 
  59 
  60 // Get the database config settings for a given $site_config.
  61 // A NULL argument gets the main site config settings.
  62 // Returns an array of settings.
  63 function get_db_config(?string $site_config=null) : array
  64 {
  65   $result = [];
  66   $vars = ['dbsys', 'db_host', 'db_database', 'db_port', 'db_schema', 'db_tbl_prefix', 'db_options'];
  67 
  68   // Include the site's config files.  No need to include areadefaults.inc.php as it doesn't contain DB settings.
  69   include 'systemdefaults.inc.php';
  70   include 'config.inc.php';
  71   if (isset($site_config))
  72   {
  73     include $site_config;
  74   }
  75 
  76   foreach ($vars as $var)
  77   {
  78     $result[$var] = $$var ?? null;
  79   }
  80 
  81   return $result;
  82 }
  83 
  84 
  85 // Upgrade between database schema versions.
  86 // Returns FALSE on error, TRUE if successful
  87 // $local is a boolean specifying whether the upgrades are global MRBS ones ($local === false)
  88 // or local upgrades ($local === true);
  89 // $upgrade_handle is the database handle to use for the upgrade.   It will typically
  90 // have admin rights (eg CREATE and ALTER).  [NB: the variable $upgrade_handle is used in
  91 // the upgrade/*/post.inc files, so do not rename it without also editing those files.]
  92 function upgrade_tables(bool $local, int $from, int $to, DB $upgrade_handle) : bool
  93 {
  94   global $dbsys;
  95 
  96   $sql_type = $dbsys;
  97   if ($sql_type == 'mysqli')
  98   {
  99     $sql_type = 'mysql';
 100   }
 101 
 102   for ($ver = ($from+1); $ver <= $to; $ver++)
 103   {
 104     echo "<p>\n";
 105     $tag = ($local) ? get_vocab('upgrade_to_local_version') : get_vocab('upgrade_to_version');
 106     echo get_vocab($tag) . ": $ver<br>\n";
 107 
 108     if ($local)
 109     {
 110       $filename = "upgrade/local/$ver/$sql_type.sql";
 111       $php_filename = "upgrade/local/$ver/post.inc";
 112     }
 113     else
 114     {
 115       $filename = "upgrade/$ver/$sql_type.sql";
 116       $php_filename = "upgrade/$ver/post.inc";
 117     }
 118     $handle = fopen($filename, 'r');
 119     if (!$handle)
 120     {
 121       // No need to localise, should never happen!
 122       echo "Fatal error: Failed to open '$filename' for reading.\n";
 123       return false;
 124     }
 125     $file_size = filesize($filename);
 126     $sql = (!empty($file_size)) ? fread($handle, filesize($filename)) : '';
 127     fclose($handle);
 128 
 129     // PostgreSQL databases can have multiple schemas and so need a qualified
 130     // table name when referring to the table name.  However the table prefix is also
 131     // used to make, for example, constraint, index and trigger names unique.  These
 132     // are unique within the schema and do not need to be schema-qualified.  Also, when
 133     // the tables were created from tables.pg.sql they would just have had "mrbs_"
 134     // replaced by the unqualified table prefix.
 135     $sql = str_replace('%DB_TBL_PREFIX%', _tbl('', true), $sql);
 136     $sql = str_replace('%DB_TBL_PREFIX_SHORT%', _tbl('', false), $sql);
 137 
 138     foreach (explode(";", $sql) as $query)
 139     {
 140       // Skip any empty query (so that last semicolon doesn't run
 141       // an empty query)
 142       if (preg_match("/\S/", $query))
 143       {
 144         $res = $upgrade_handle->query($query);
 145       }
 146     }
 147 
 148     if ($ver > 1)
 149     {
 150       $variable_name = ($local) ? "local_db_version" : "db_version";
 151       $upgrade_handle->command("UPDATE " . _tbl('variables') . " SET variable_content = ? ".
 152         "WHERE variable_name = ?", array($ver, $variable_name));
 153     }
 154 
 155     // Now execute the PHP file if there is one
 156     if (is_readable($php_filename))
 157     {
 158       include($php_filename);
 159     }
 160 
 161     echo get_vocab('ok');
 162     echo "</p>\n";
 163   }
 164   return true;
 165 }
 166 
 167 
 168 // Upgrades the database tables defined by the current config context
 169 function do_upgrade(DB $upgrade_handle) : bool
 170 {
 171   $result = true;
 172 
 173   if (!$upgrade_handle->table_exists(_tbl('entry')))
 174   {
 175     echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('no_tables_found')) . "</p>\n";
 176   }
 177   else
 178   {
 179     $current_db_schema_version = db_schema_version($upgrade_handle);
 180     $current_db_schema_version_local = db_schema_version($upgrade_handle, true);
 181 
 182     // Do any MRBS upgrades first
 183     if ($result && ($current_db_schema_version < DB::DB_SCHEMA_VERSION))
 184     {
 185       $result = $result && upgrade_tables(false, $current_db_schema_version, DB::DB_SCHEMA_VERSION, $upgrade_handle);
 186     }
 187     else
 188     {
 189       echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('already_at_version', $current_db_schema_version)) . "</p>\n";
 190     }
 191     // Then any local upgrades
 192     if ($result && ($current_db_schema_version_local < DB::DB_SCHEMA_VERSION_LOCAL))
 193     {
 194       $result = $result && upgrade_tables(true, $current_db_schema_version_local, DB::DB_SCHEMA_VERSION_LOCAL, $upgrade_handle);
 195     }
 196   }
 197 
 198   return $result;
 199 }
 200 
 201 
 202 function upgrade_site(array &$admin_handles, ?string $config_file=null) : bool
 203 {
 204   global $dbsys, $db_host, $db_database, $db_port, $db_schema, $db_tbl_prefix, $db_options;
 205   global $db_admin_username, $db_admin_password;
 206 
 207   // Get the site's DB config settings
 208   $settings = get_db_config($config_file);
 209   foreach ($settings as $var => $value)
 210   {
 211     $$var = $value;
 212   }
 213 
 214   // Form the new DSN
 215   $dsn = DBFactory::createDsn($dbsys, $db_host, $db_database, $db_port ?? null);
 216   // Try and get a handle for the site
 217   if (!isset($admin_handles[$dsn]))
 218   {
 219     // Try and get a new connection using the login details we've already been given
 220     try {
 221       $admin_handle = DBFactory::create(
 222         $dbsys,
 223         $db_host,
 224         $db_admin_username,
 225         $db_admin_password,
 226         $db_database,
 227         false,
 228         $db_port,
 229         $db_options
 230       );
 231       $admin_handles[$dsn] = $admin_handle;
 232     }
 233     catch (DBException $e) {
 234       // Don't do anything: we were only trying to see if we could connect using the same details
 235     }
 236   }
 237   if (isset($admin_handles[$dsn]))
 238   {
 239     return do_upgrade($admin_handles[$dsn]);
 240   }
 241 
 242   echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('no_connection')) . "</p>\n";
 243 
 244   return false;
 245 }
 246 
 247 
 248 function upgrade_report(bool $main_site_result, array $failed_sites) : void
 249 {
 250   global $multisite;
 251 
 252   // Summarise
 253   if (!$multisite)
 254   {
 255     // Just report on success.  Failure will be obvious.
 256     if ($main_site_result) {
 257       echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('upgrade_completed')) . "</p>\n";
 258     }
 259   }
 260   else
 261   {
 262     echo "<h2>" . escape_html(get_vocab('upgrade_summary')) . "</h2>\n";
 263 
 264     if ($main_site_result && empty($failed_sites)) {
 265       echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('upgrade_completed')) . "</p>\n";
 266     }
 267     else {
 268       // Report on the main site
 269       if (!$main_site_result) {
 270         echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('main_site_failed')) . "</p>\n";
 271       }
 272 
 273       // Report on failed sub-sites
 274       if (!empty($failed_sites)) {
 275         echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('failed_sites')) . "</p>\n";
 276         echo "<ul>\n";
 277         foreach ($failed_sites as $failed_site) {
 278           echo "<li>" . escape_html($failed_site) . "</li>\n";
 279         }
 280         echo "</ul>\n";
 281       }
 282 
 283       // Advice on what to do next
 284       echo "<p>" . escape_html(get_vocab('retry_from_failing')) . "</p>\n";
 285     }
 286   }
 287 }

 290 // Get a database username and password
 291 function db_get_userpass() : void
 292 {
 293   print_header();
 294 
 295   $form = new Form(Form::METHOD_POST);
 296   $form->setAttributes(array('class'  => 'standard',
 297     'id'     => 'db_logon',
 298     'action' => multisite(this_page())));
 299 
 300   $fieldset = new ElementFieldset();
 301   $fieldset->addLegend(get_vocab('database_login'));
 302 
 303   // The username field
 304   $field = new FieldInputText();
 305   $field->setLabel('Database username')
 306     ->setControlAttributes(array('id'       => 'form_username',
 307       'name'     => 'form_username',
 308       'required' => true));
 309   $fieldset->addElement($field);
 310 
 311   // The password field
 312   $field = new FieldInputPassword();
 313   $field->setLabel('Database password')
 314     ->setControlAttributes(array('id'   => 'form_password',
 315       'name' => 'form_password'));
 316   $fieldset->addElement($field);
 317 
 318   // The submit button
 319   $field = new FieldInputSubmit();
 320   $field->setControlAttributes(array('value' => get_vocab('login')));
 321   $fieldset->addElement($field);
 322 
 323   $form->addElement($fieldset);
 324 
 325   $form->render();
 326 
 327   // Print footer and exit
 328   print_footer(true);
 329 }
 330 
 331 
 332 // Sanity check:  check that we can access the MRBS tables.  If we can't, it's
 333 // either because they don't exist or we don't have permission.
 334 if (!db()->table_exists(_tbl('entry')))
 335 {
 336   Errors::fatalError(get_vocab('fatal_no_tables'));
 337 }
 338 
 339 // Check the database schema versions
 340 $current_db_schema_version = db_schema_version(db());
 341 $current_db_schema_version_local = db_schema_version(db(), true);
 342 
 343 // Although we could check whether the database schema version is higher than
 344 // that expected by MRBS, we don't.  That's because if we do it prevents us
 345 // performing backwards compatible database upgrades in the background, because
 346 // the production site will stop working unnecessarily once the database has
 347 // been upgraded.
 348 
 349 // If either of the database schema version numbers are out of date, then
 350 // upgrade the database - provided of course that the entry table exists.
 351 if (($current_db_schema_version < DB::DB_SCHEMA_VERSION) ||
 352     ($current_db_schema_version_local < DB::DB_SCHEMA_VERSION_LOCAL))
 353 {
 354   // Upgrade needed
 355 
 356   // Upgrades can take some time, so turn on implicit flushing so that status
 357   // updates appear as they happen.  Also turn off output compression because
 358   // that will involve some buffering.
 359   // Note that this won't always result in streamed output as (a) the web server
 360   // (b) the browser may implement their own buffering.  Solution: use Ajax calls?
 361   ini_set('zlib.output_compression', '0');
 362   ob_end_flush();
 363   ob_implicit_flush();
 364 
 365   // Just use a simple header as the normal header may (a) use features
 366   // which are not available until after the database upgrade or (b) use
 367   // functions which are not available until after dbsys has run.
 368   print_simple_header();
 369 
 370   echo '<h1>' . get_vocab('mrbs') . "</h1>\n";
 371   echo '<p><strong>' . get_vocab('upgrade_required') . "</strong></p>\n";
 372 
 373   $admin_handle = null;
 374 
 375   // We need to open a connection to the database with a database
 376   // username that has admin rights.
 377   // TODO: The while loop isn't doing anything.  Ideally we want to offer the user a
 378   // TODO: chance to try a new username and password after a connection failure.
 379   while (empty($admin_handle))
 380   {
 381     $db_admin_username = get_form_var('form_username', 'string');
 382     $db_admin_password = get_form_var('form_password', 'string');
 383     if (!isset($db_admin_username) || !isset($db_admin_password))
 384     {
 385       // Get a username and password if we haven't got them
 386       echo '<p>' . get_vocab('supply_userpass') . "</p>\n";
 387       echo '<p>' . get_vocab('contact_admin', $mrbs_admin) . "</p>\n";
 388       db_get_userpass();
 389     }
 390     else
 391     {
 392       try {
 393         $admin_handle = DBFactory::create(
 394           $dbsys,
 395           $db_host,
 396           $db_admin_username,
 397           $db_admin_password,
 398           $db_database,
 399           false,
 400           $db_port,
 401           $db_options
 402         );
 403       }
 404       catch (DBException $e) {
 405         trigger_error($e->getMessage(), E_USER_NOTICE);
 406         Errors::fatalError(get_vocab('no_connection'));
 407       }
 408     }
 409   }
 410 
 411   // Check the CSRF token before we make any changes
 412   Form::checkToken();
 413 
 414   // If we're using multisite then the various sites could be using different databases, or even
 415   // different database systems (MySQL or PostgreSQL).  In that case we'll need different
 416   // handles to access them, so we store the handles indexed by DSN (which will give enough detail
 417   // to distinguish them).
 418   $dsn = DBFactory::createDsn($dbsys, $db_host, $db_database, $db_port);
 419   $admin_handles = [$dsn => $admin_handle];
 420 
 421   // Get all the sub-site config files in this installation
 422   $site_config_files = get_site_config_files();
 423 
 424   // Upgrade each of the sub-sites
 425   $failed_sites = [];
 426   foreach ($site_config_files as $site_config_file => $dir)
 427   {
 428     // Do the upgrade for the sub-site
 429     echo "<h2>" . escape_html(get_vocab('upgrading_site', $dir)) . "</h2>\n";
 430     if (!upgrade_site($admin_handles, $site_config_file))
 431     {
 432       $failed_sites[] = $dir;
 433     }
 434   }
 435 
 436   // Then upgrade the main site
 437   // We only need this heading if we're in multi-site mode
 438   if ($multisite)
 439   {
 440     echo "<h2>" . escape_html(get_vocab('upgrading_main_site')) . "</h2>\n";
 441   }
 442   $main_site_result = upgrade_site($admin_handles);
 443 
 444   // Report on the upgrade
 445   upgrade_report($main_site_result, $failed_sites);
 446 
 447   // Close the database connections that have admin rights
 448   foreach ($admin_handles as $admin_handle)
 449   {
 450     unset($admin_handle);
 451   }
 452 
 453   // Restore the DB config settings for the site we're supposed to be running
 454   $settings = get_db_config('site_config.inc');
 455   foreach ($settings as $var => $value)
 456   {
 457     $$var = $value;
 458   }
 459 
 460   echo '<p class="upgrade_nav"><a href="' . escape_html(multisite('index.php')) . '">' . get_vocab('returncal') . '</a>.</p>';
 461   print_footer(true);
 462 }
